chapters.title: Chapter 1
chapters.html:
Exotic pets aren’t an uncommon thing here in Amphoreus, ever since the Garden of Life managed to bring back the excellent little helpers from ancient times. Many tourists were astonished at the sight of a chimera leisurely walking around the city, performing little tasks like picking up litter or making sure people didn’t cross the road while the crossing signal was red. Because the chimeras were a product of alchemy and genetic alteration and modification, owning one as a pet were out of the question.

Unfortunately, because of how chimeras were created there bound to be some crazy scientist trying to create some kind of new creature or an abomination with those ancient DNAs. While many had tried and failed then ended up in jail, one mad man had managed to create a hybrid. At the cost of his wife’s life. That man was Eurypon. The death of his wife was ignored by the city’s counsel, thinking it was simply due to complication during childbirth. They sent Eurypon their regards and condolences and went on with their life. The only person that was suspicious of the scientist was Krateros.

Two decades went by in a blink and no one seemed to remember about the man named Eurypon. Until his name made it to the headline, stating his immediate arrest followed by a death sentence. His crimes were as followed: a charge of homicide, multiple charges of malicious use of DNA modification, animal abuse, child abuse and neglect, illegal human imprisonment. All the information given to the public stopped at that, the details about why Eurypon was charged with so many crimes were left out. Only those from the special investigation force, Chrysos Heirs, knew what the despicable and evil man had created. That day, the Chrysos Heirs welcomed a new member to their team. Mydeimos, the chimera human hybrid.

Aglaea had to went through a lengthy meeting with the city’s council to take Mydeimos into her custody. Anaxa and Hyacine worked together to create a birth certificate and a new identity for Mydeimos. While hybrids do exist, with Cipher being a cat hybrid, putting “chimera hybrid” down in Mydeimos’ birth certificate would be a stupid idea. The man could pass as a Komodo dragon hybrid as long as he convinced people that he dyed his tail orange and reined in his feline instincts. Anaxa was quite intrigued as to how Mydeimos' DNA worked, the man had an orange tail of a chimera yet he had no horns, just a normal pair of human ears. Castorice and Tribios were in charge of teaching and showing Mydeimos about the Chrysos Heir’s mission and responsibly.

Phainon, no longer the newbie of the group, had tasked himself with the mission of convincing Mydeimos that love at first sight exist. The wolf hybrid was ensnared and hypnotized by Mydeimos’ beautiful golden eyes when he broke down the door to Eurypon secret lab. The fight that followed was the most thrilling experience Phainon ever had. Mydeimos somehow managed to maintain a body that was carved by the gods themselves while being imprisoned his entire life. That tail, that beautiful and chonky tail covered in smooth orange scales, Phainon wanted to hug it to sleep because of how smooth and cool the appendance that almost broke his ribs was.

He couldn’t even put into words the thrill that ran down his spine when Mydeimos snarled at him, baring those deathly feline fangs at the wolf. That was the first time Phainon needed to use all his strength and power in a fight, and it was the best two hours of his life. The two hybrids could brawl for ten days straight if it Anaxa didn’t intervene with a sedative shot. The anesthesia took effect immediately making Mydeimos collapse on top of Phainon. The wolf moved to hand to catch the sedated man. Maybe it was the will of the god or the work of some miracle, Phainon’s hand was pressed against Mydeimos’s chest instead of the man’s stomach like Phainon had planned.

“O-Oh… I think I know where the goat feature is” Phainon informed Anaxa, his face was as red as a tomato when he looked at the green haired male. Screw the fantasy of hugging Mydeimos’s tail to sleep, Phainon wanted to sleep on those pillow-y and soft mounds. Anaxa could only let out a tired sigh while rubbing his temple, the stupid dopey smile and the wagging tail were enough to tell that Phainon just got bombarded with a storm of arrows from Cupid.

---

Out of all the Chrysos Heirs, Castorice and Hyacine were closest to Phainon due two all three studying under Anaxa for a while. This was the first time the two girls saw Phainon wagged his tail at someone. The only time that white tail moved because of excitement was when Phainon caught the smell of his dinner.

To be fair, Phainon looked like he wanted to have Mydeimos for dinner.

Cipher lost the bet against Anaxa and Aglaea. They were betting on whether or not Phainon’s behavior was because he finally had an equal opponent, or the wolf was actually in love. Cipher dropped down on her hands in despair the moment she smelled Phainon’s faint scent on Mydeimos. Tribios was worried that Mydeimos wasn’t aware of what Phainon was trying to do, the poor thing was imprisoned in a lab for his entire life after all. She asked the chimera hybrid about how he felt when Phainon was sticking around him all day and the answer he gave was interesting.

“The wolf? He makes a lot of sounds. I like his tail though, it’s fluffy and energetic like him. But I wish he would stop giving me his meat” Castorice, who was noting down what Mydeimos said, turned to look at him with her face flushed a light pink and asked him to clarify about the meat.

“Its thick, but he kept giving it to me raw. I appreciate his effort in bringing me my dinner, but I prefer a plate of cooked meals over raw meat. My stomach can’t handle a slap of raw ribeye every night”

Phainon was scolded by Tribios for feeding Mydeimos an unbalanced dinner. She explained that since Mydeimos was a chimera hybrid it’s best to give him a balanced meal consisting of meat and vegetables. What Tribios didn’t expect was Phainon looking extremely distraught and one second away from crying. As fate would have it, Mydeimos just happened to walk in the kitchen, where Tribios and Phainon were chatting. Like a child who just fell, Phainon started sniffling the moment he saw Mydeimos looking at him. The chimera hybrid was tackled to the ground before he could ask Phainon what was wrong. His confusion only increased when Phainon began sobbing into his chest while apologizing for giving Mydeimos a bad courting gift.

“Courting gift? What’s that?” Mydeimos asked as he ran his fingers through the lock of silver hair on his chest, tilting his head when Phainon looked up at him in shock. The sweet, beautiful and innocent Mydeimos had no idea Phainon was trying to court him, the poor thing didn’t even understand the concept of courting. Phainon was experiencing an early onset mid-life crisis, his affection wasn’t even recognized as affection. The wolf was brought back from his shock by a rough sandpaper-like texture on his face. Mydeimos was licking away his tears, the chimera then moved to Phainon’s fluffy ears. Phainon’s strong and gorgeous crush was grooming the fur on his ears.

“Mydeimos, do you know what you’re doing to Phainon?” Tribios asked, trying to help Phainon with his doomed love life. The Chrysos Heirs still unsure about what that crazy scientist had taught Mydeimos during his twenty years living in that underground lab or what he knew about the world outside. The chimera immediately froze and looked up at the red head with a mix of confusion and panic in his eyes. Thankfully, Tribios explained what she meant with her question. Mydeimos relaxed when the woman told him that he wasn’t doing anything bad.

“His tail wags a lot when I do this, so I thought it might cheer him up” Mydeimos explained and Phainon’s heart just took another Cupid arrow. Just like the blonde had said, the wolf's tail began wagging when he heard that.

“That’s make sense… Lions are just giant deathly cat” Tribios mumbled to herself. “Is there any other reason why you do that to Phainon? Cipher is a cat hybrid; she’s most likely going to reciprocate your attempt to build a social bond”

“I haven’t talk to her that much. And I like it when the wolf had my scent on him” Phainon immediately stood up with his tail furiously wagging behind him and started running around their headquarter. The sound of his voice yelling “I have a chance” echoing off the walls. Mydeimos just let out a small chuckle and winked at Tribios with his index finger on his lips.

Their newbie was a little minx, Tribios thought to herself. At least she doesn’t have to spend much time teaching Mydeimos so he could integrate and acclimate into the outside world. The Chrysos HQ is going to be a much livelier place with Phainon trying to woo his crush, with Mydeimos very much aware of his affection. Now she needs to rope everyone into a new bet. Who’s going to pounce first? The hardworking and energetic wolf with his openly affectionate gestures or the playful chimera who reciprocating the other’s loving gestures under faux innocent?

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 2
chapters.html:
The Chrysos Heir HQ had become much livelier after Mydeimos somewhat hinted that he liked Phainon.

The wolf had been seen visiting Anaxa and Tribios more and more often for lessons about animal behavior. Cipher was interrogated daily by a very determined Phainon on what she had ate for dinner, while Aglaea had to avoid Phainon because he would beg her to let him take Mydeimos to the city center for a date. 

Hyacine and Castorice were luckier than the rest thanks to Mydeimos hanging out with them. Phainon was determined to court the beautiful chimera hybrid, so he only showed himself in front of Mydeimos after he made sure that his fluffy tail and outfits were in pristine condition. Another reason Phainon didn’t bother them was because they were playing at his informant, gathering information about things that Mydeimos likes and dislikes.

The two girls were essentially playing the role of a double agent as Mydeimos also asked them about Phainon’s related stuff. The chimera looked extremely happy and pleased when they told him Phainon never wagged his tail at someone other than his dinner before. A bonus for hanging out with Mydeimos was that they had front row seats to Phainon’s attempts to woo the chimera and seeing said chimera teasing him but also reciprocating the courting in his own subtle ways.

Phainon’s attempt #1: Flowers

After Hyacine taught Mydeimos how to make bread, Phainon barged in the kitchen with a bouquet of flowers in hand. Phainon, in his attempt to be a romantic, plucked out a rose from the bouquet to put it in Mydeimos’s golden hair. Only for the chimera hybrid to bite off the rose bud when it came near his face, chewing the petals while innocently tilting his head at Phainon. The wolf was frozen in place, he obviously did not expect that to happen as his ears drooped down while he stared at the flower stem.

The Chrysos team almost lost their healer that day

Mydeimos, after enjoying his snack, grabbed the bouquet from Phainon. As the chimera turned away, his tail moved to wrap around Phainon’s wrist, pulling the wolf along with him. Mydeimos told Phainon about what he and Hyacine were about to do as he pointed to the ball of dough on the counter. The chimera hybrid’s eyes started sparkling with amazement as his hand sunk into the dough and he began kneading it like a cat making biscuits. Hyacine hasn’t told Mydeimos how to handle the dough yet, that was just pure Mydeimos instinct. Hyacine almost died from the cuteness.

Phainon mourned the feeling of Mydeimos’s tail curled around his wrist. Only to have to physically restrain himself from jumping on the dough kneading chimera. His reptilian tail was curled around Phainon’s waist and pulled him against the other’s back. The wolf had to use his arms to prevent him from falling on top of Mydeimos, effectively caging the chimera against the counter. Mydeimos being Mydeimos, “innocently” put Phainon’s hands in his to show the wolf how to knead the dough. That was when Phainon noticed that the other was literally kneading the dough like a cat, so he mustered all his courage and prayed to the gods above that he wouldn’t scare Mydeimos with his next action.

Phainon told the hybrid in front of him that he was doing it wrong and moved their hands so now he was holding Mydeimos’s. It took him a few seconds to begin showing the chimera how to work the bread dough, his brain was trying to memorize how soft his crush’s hands were. Because of their position, Phainon couldn’t see the slight blush and a pleased smile on Mydeimos’s face. Hyacine silently snapped a picture of the two and sent it to the “Phainon vs Mydeimos: Who’s gonna jump the other first?” or the “Phaidei: WGJTOF?” group chat.

chapters.title: Chapter 3
chapters.html:
Phainon’s attempt #2: Hair brushing

Phainon was practically skipping towards Mydeimos’ temporary room (aka the HQ’s quarantine room) a hair comb one hand and a bottle of moisturizer in the other.

Cipher had traded the information that feline groomed each other as a way to build trust and intimacy for a week without Phainon holding a pen and paper noting down what she had eaten for dinner. Aglaea bought Phainon a bottle of moisturizer specially made for scales maintenance, so he would stop pestering her about his future dates with Mydeimos.

Mydeimos had been retreating to his temporary room after breakfast every day since he got here two weeks ago. Phainon was quite surprised when he entered the room, and the chimera was nowhere to be seen. His drooping tail started wagging again when he saw his best attempt at trying out pottery sitting on the table.

Phainon gave Mydeimos a vase with a giant paw print in the middle. The vase was bumpy, the sides weren’t symmetrical, and the gaze wasn’t perfect showing its maker inexperience in making it. Castorice was convinced that Phainon got scammed and bought a fake antique until Phainon proudly showed it to Mydeimos stating that he made it himself. The chimera hybrid was staring at the vase as if it had personally offended him, but his eyes softened immediately when he heard Phainon make it for him. Mydeimos baked him a loaf of bread as thanks and Phainon almost cried (tears of joy) because of it.

The wolf was too busy recalling the way his crush’s cute little tongue poking out when he was concentrating on kneading the dough to notice the sound of the door opening. Phainon only realized that there was another presence in the room when his nose picked up the familiar scent of pomegranate shower gel. The smile on his face dropped instantly when he turned around and saw the object of his affection holding a bouquet of flowers, flowers that Phainon didn’t give him. Mydeimos recognized the ugly feeling that is rising inside Phainon the moment their eyes met. The chimera hybrid titled his head at Phainon, with faux confusion – then he walked past the wolf and put the flowers inside the abomination that was Phainon’s vase.

The tail, that had been on Phainon’s mind more often than it should have, tickled at his ankles and patted the empty space next to where Mydeimos was sitting on the floor. Phainon did dream of a future where Mydeimos is his wife way too often, so might as well practice and get used to listening to his future wife’s every wish.

Phainon’s almost jumped out of his chest when Mydeimos climbed on top of him and straddled his legs. The wolf was still like a statue when the other, without any hesitation, began licking the fur on his ears. Having Mydeimos groom his fur wasn’t a rare thing to happen, the chimera hybrid seemed to make it a part of his daily routine. Phainon started having butterflies in his stomach when he recalled what Mydeimos had said the other day.

“I like it when the wolf had my scent on him”

Helicopter blades had nothing against the speed that Phainon tail was moving as his mind vividly replayed the way Mydeimos’ lips pronounced every single syllable of that sentence. Then, he remembered why he was looking for Mydeimos in the first place. Phainon grabbed on to the chimera’s arms and pushed him away so he could see that beautiful golden eyes blinked at him with confusion.

“Mydeimos, let me brush your hair please!” Phainon held out the hair comb in front of Mydeimos, presenting it to the chimera hybrid. Mydeimos had to mentally restrain himself to not lay his head down on Phainon’s lap like a house cat when those ocean blue eyes pleadingly looked at him. The blonde didn’t realize how long he had been staring at the hair comb without moving or uttering a single sound. Only when he heard a small whine from Phainon did he realize that he hadn’t given the wolf an answer.

Mydeimos turned around and sat down on Phainon’s lap as if it was his rightful place. It was a redundant task because Mydeimos had already taken care of his hair before he left his room, but he liked having Phainon around too much to say no. That was probably the best decision Mydeimos had made that day, the way Phainon ran his fingers through his hair was heavenly. He was purring before he even realized it himself.

“Ahhh I can’t take this anymore! I’m sorry Mydeimos!” The chimera hybrid didn’t even have time to process what Phainon just said before his face was aggressively licked by the wolf. Phainon didn’t expect the string of beautiful melody that was Mydeimos’ laughter to grace his ears. His crush was ticklish and Phainon immediately put that information into the Mydeimos folder in his brain. On the brighter side, Mydeimos’ hair was a bit ruffled after he was rolling around laughing because of Phainon. The wolf was once again blessed with the sound of purring as he brushed through the chimera’s hair.

---

Castorice walked into an interesting sight. She was planning on asking if Mydeimos wanted anything for lunch because she was heading to the city for some gardening supplies. When the door to Mydeimos’ room opened, she saw the chimera hybrid meticulously combing through the white fur of Phainon’s tail while Phainon looked like he was constipated with his fists balled up and his brows furrowed.

Turned out Phainon was fighting an internal battle to keep the tail that constantly wagging when he was near Mydeimos as still as possible.

“Hmm, I should ask Lady Aglaea to get you some white clothes. Your black hoodie is covered in white fur, Mydeimos” Castorice had offered to buy the blonde a few lint rollers to remove Phainon’s fur, but he told her it was fine. Later that night when the purple-haired girl stopped by Mydeimos’ room to drop off his new clothes, she saw him fast asleep hugging the hoodie he was wearing in the morning.

The next day, everyone saw Phainon walking toward Mydeimos’ room with his untamed bedhead and tail, looking way too happy for someone who was not a morning person.

chapters.title: Chapter 4
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Warning: slight description of violence and wounds; blood.

Phainon’s attempt #3:

The dust covered training area was more beat up than it had ever been before. Broken training dummy piling in a corner, shooting targets pierced through with arrows and knifes. The sturdy metal walls now had dents and claw marks on them looking like a wild animal had completely torn through and destroyed the room.

In truth, “wild” was the perfect word to describe the state that Phainon and Mydeimos were in.

Anaxa watched on as the two hybrids, that were lovingly-but-in-a-we-are-friends-but-still-a-bit-intimate-kinda-way grooming each other in the lounge, sparred like they wanted to kill the other. The hands that were gently brushing out Mydeimos’ hair were clawing at the tail coiled around his neck. Mydeimos’ tongue that was grooming the tuff on fur on Phainon’s ear was licking away the blood dripping from his lips. The deeper Phainon dug in claws into the flesh of Mydeimos’ tail, the tighter those muscles coiled around his neck.

“Alright you two break it up. Mydeimos wins this time” Anaxa’s words flew pass both Phainon and Mydeimos’ ears as Phainon lunged forward to try and pin the chimera hybrid down. Only to be thrown across the room by the orange tail.

The pained cry from Mydeimos’ lips broke Phainon out of his adrenaline high, then came Anaxa’s voice frantically calling for Hyacine through his phone. Because of how Phainon’s claws were digging into the chimera’s tail, it tore a deep wound on the flesh when the wolf was flung away. Phainon’s entire world collapsed when he saw Mydeimos holding his tail and frantically licking at the bleeding wound. Under his tail was a small puddle of blood, with a few orange scales dotted in it.

Mydeimos had hissed at the figure that approached him, his golden pupils had sharpened into slits because of the pain. The sting in his tail was forgotten temporarily as Mydeimos saw Phainon’s tear stained face. Before the blonde could try to comfort the crying wolf, Phainon took of his white T-shirt in a blink. Mydeimos bit back a pained cry as Phainon pressed his shirt on the bleeding wound, applying steady pressure to help stop the bleeding.

Judging from how fast Phainon’s shirt was turning crimson, the cut from Phainon’s claws had to be severe. Hyacine ran as fast as she could with Castorice and Cipher behind her, she knew the wound was bad by the panic in Anaxa’s voice. All of them let out an audible gasp as they entered the room. That was the first time the three had seen Phainon cry. The wolf hybrid was showing signs of distress, ears flattened, his body trembling as he tried and stopped the bleeding. Mydeimos was leaning into the crook of Phainon’s neck, Cipher could tell that he was trying to hold back his voice. Any more signs of pain or distress from Mydeimos could cause panic in Phainon.

When Hyacine was finally able to stop the bleeding and bandaged up Mydeimos’ tail, Phainon carried him to the infirmary before Hyacine could ask him to.

When Phainon gently put Mydeimos on the infirmary bed, what happened next was as the chimera hybrid had expected. Phainon was kneeling on the floor between the blonde’s legs as he buried his face into Mydeimos’ stomach, ears flattened, tail glued to the ground. Muffled sobbing sounds filled the room as the chimera gently petted Phainon’s hair.

“I’m sorry… I’m so sorry…”

“There’s nothing to be sorry for, Phainon. I was the one that thrown you away knowing very well that your claws were holding on to my tail. It was my fault to begin with. We were having a friendly spar; I was the one that couldn’t control my instinct and turned it into deathly fight between us.” Mydeimos said, his voice soft and soothing in Phainon’s ear.

It was the truth, his carnivore instincts got out of control when he saw Phainon growling and baring his fangs. It was also the goat instinct in his DNA that made him cower in fear when Phainon lunged at him, his body froze while his tail tried to distance him from the source of his fear. Phainon could never know about the latter part, which was something that Mydeimos was determined to take to his grave.

“But I hurt you!” Phainon looked up at his crush, his eyes heavy with guilt and tears.

“Phainon, you were trying to pull my tail away. My tail was around your neck for god’s sake! I could’ve killed you, you stupid wolf”

Before Phainon could make use of his “10 times debate champion” tittle to use, the door to the infirmary opened. Hyacine walked inside followed by Aglaea and Tribios. The red hair woman was clearly worried as she ran over to Mydeimos, inspecting his tail while Aglaea was looking at them with her stern expression. Phainon knew that punishment was waiting for him, but he couldn’t care less about it. There was nothing that could be worst than the feeling of guilt eating away at him right now.

At least that was what Phainon had thought.

“I have reviewed the footage in the training room. Mydeimos, I have come to a decision that until you can control all three of the different animals’ instinct in your DNA, I cannot let you stay at the Chrysos Heir’s headquarters. Please understand that I have nothing against your hybrid blood. After your wound healed, Mr. Krateros – a close friend and colleague of your late mother, will help you learned how to control your instincts. He will take care of your new accommodation”

Aglaea’s words hit Phainon like a ton of brick.

“I understand, Lady Aglaea. Thank you for all your hospitality these past weeks, I’m sorry for the trouble that I have caused everyone” was Mydeimos’ calm response.

chapters.title: Chapter 5
chapters.html:
After Aglaea dropped the news of Mydeimos’ departure, Phainon wasn’t himself that day. The wolf glued himself to Mydeimos, not leaving him out of his sight for one second. He still smiled at everyone, but none of it reached his eyes. Everyone thought that he was still distraught and upset over Mydeimos’ punishment and needed some time to collect himself. The HQ atmosphere turned heavy and dark minutes after what Aglaea had said in the infirmary.

And that atmosphere was not going to disappear anytime soon, not after Mydeimos had left without saying a word to Phainon or anyone else. He should’ve stayed next to Mydeimos that night, he should’ve slept right outside Mydeimos’ door. Phainon continued to yell at himself.

None of the others in the Chrysos team anticipated how bad Phainon was dealing with Mydeimos’ absence. None were aware of how Mydeimos’ gentleness and kindness reminded Phainon of the warmth his family gave him back in Aedes Elysiae. Those golden eyes were as beautiful as the golden wheat field of his hometown; his laughter was as melodic as the windchime hanging by the window of his childhood room. Everything about Mydeimos reminds Phainon of his hometown. So much so that Phainon was frightened by it.

And just like Aedes Elysiae, Mydeimos was gone before he even knew it.

---

Mydeimos’ decision on leaving so sudden was not without a reason.

Twenty years of isolation, twenty years of looking at the world outside through a TV screen, twenty years of loneliness, twenty years of wishing that he could one day feel the love and affection that he read in books and fairy tales. The day that Phainon broke into his life (literally) was the day Mydeimos learnt what it was like to have a ray of hope illuminating his empty life.

The feeling of having an equal opponent, who could match him blows for blows was exhilarating. His muscles burned in a way that those combat droids could never come close to recreating it. Combat droids were designed by Castrum Kremnos’ military, yet they all have the same weakness that all machines running on a set of codes had. They were predictable, all their movements were calculated on the same algorithm. But Phainon was hard to figure out, the way he moved and fought were a perfect and harmonious mix between human and animal. He knew when to parry and when to advance, but when Mydeimos thought he had figured out what the other would do, Phainon threw wildcards after wildcards at him.

Phainon was the chaos that Mydeimos’ monotonous life needed. Phainon was the blue sky that Mydeimos yearned to see within the white walls of the lab.

His heart was filled with so much warmth and happiness when he realized that Phainon also saw him as an equal. His entire body was on fire when he felt the affection that Phainon willingly gave him.

Mydeimos knew better than anyone that he was selfish and possessive. Reciprocating Phainon’s loving gestures with a subtlest hint of affection from him, all to keep Phainon wanting more and more every time. To keep Phainon undying love all to himself.

Mydeimos hated the way Hyacine and Castorice were so close to Phainon, but he slowly warmed up and came to enjoy their conversations. Mydeimos hated how Phainon was so willing to follow orders from Aglaea, but he slowly came to respect and saw her as a selfless leader. Mydeimos was wary of Anaxa (to be fair he did shoot him in their fist meeting) but he eventually saw him as a questionable teacher. Tribios and Cipher were the only ones along with Phainon that Mydeimos felt comfortable being around in their first meeting. The two women brought him a sense of safety, the kind of safety from a mother’s embrace.

Mydeimos’ possessiveness towards Phainon dwindled slowly as he slowly accepted everyone’s kindness into his heart.

Mydeimos, the only chimera hybrid in the entire world, finally found his family. The one that truly loved him.

That’s why he chose to leave without giving anyone a goodbye, out of fear that he wouldn’t be able to step foot out of the place if he saw their face. Out of fear that his heart would break if he saw the sadness in Phainon’s eyes again.

But Mydeimos wasn’t a cruel person. Phainon had gave him hope, it was only natural that he gave his wolf something to look forward to in the times that he will be gone.

In the garden at the Chrysos HQ, a patch of white lilies appeared overnight and next to it was a book about how to take care of them. A note written in beautiful handwriting was stuck on the cover.

“For Amphoreus biggest drama queen (Phainon) <3”

The text below was that written the ancient Kremnoan with a small doodle of a chimera next to it

chapters.title: Chapter 6
chapters.html:
As Castorice had expected, Phainon had been staying inside Mydeimos’ room for the past few days. His emotions were too unstable for Aglaea to sent him on missions, out of concern that he would uproot every single building in Okhema to find Mydeimos. Everyone was worried about him, especially Tribios. Phainon was acting like he did when she first found him, when his entire family and hometown were gone.

Castorice and Hyacine had been trying to strike up a conversation with Phainon, to keep him from spiraling into the husk of a man that he was in the past. After a lot of talking and convincing, the two managed to make some progress. Phainon had agreed to leave the room and go outside for a breath of fresh air. The sunlight did somewhat help the wolf’s pale complexion, warming up his body as he stood under the ray of lights. At least Phainon looked like he was a living wolf hybrid again.

Phainon’s ears perked up at both Hyacine and Castorice collective gasp. One of Cas’s flower beds was trampled, and something had knocked over the bird feeder Hyacine had set up and ate all of the food in it. Phainon was the one that found a small track of tiny footprint leading to an unfamiliar flower bed under Aglaea’s apple tree. Castorice looked around the area and found no more traces of the little troublemaker. Thankfully, the culprit decided to show itself.

“Awooo…”

Six eyes looking up to see two looking down.

There was a chimera loafing on one of the tree branches.

An orange chimera.

Phainon, a wolf hybrid who hadn’t climbed a tree in a decade, suddenly gained the agility of a leopard. The chimera that was loafing on a tree branch one moment and the next it was cradled safely in Phainon’s arms. Cipher would be proud if she saw how fast the wolf had scaled Aglaea’s apple tree.

Cerulean blue stared at the small creature that was playing with the string of his hoodie.

“Why is there a chimera here?” Phainon asked the question that all of them shared. Why does it share such a similar color scheme with Mydeimos? Phainon thought to himself. The small thing was strangely friendly towards Phainon after it had hissed at both of the girl. Hyacine was a little heartbroken, but then she noticed that the chimera had been nuzzling against Phainon’s hoodie. She swore she had seen that hoodie somewhere before.

“Phainon, are you wearing Mydeimos’ hoodie?” The way Phainon clutched the piece of clothing with a melancholy look in his eyes answered Castorice’s question. It was the same hoodie that she accidentally saw Mydeimos cuddling to sleep at night. The little chimera was bumping its head against Phainon’s chin then it suddenly decided to bite the hand that was cradling it. Phainon let out a yelp but still holding onto the orange ball in his arms. He eventually set the thing down when it’s tried to struggle out of his hold. The chimera bolted towards the flower bed that Phainon didn’t recognize, looking back at him as if wanting the wolf hybrid to follow it.

---

Somewhere in the countryside of Castrum Kremnos

Mydeimos stood in front of an old mansion, the fence outside was covered in vines and flora. Other than that, the place looked well-kept as if someone had been taking care of it. The chimera hybrid looked at Krateros with his eyes brimming with childlike curiosity. He immediately went to explore his new accommodation when Krateros gave him a nod.

The old man told Mydeimos that he needed to take care of some business and asked the chimera hybrid to unpack after he was done with exploring the place. Krateros then drove to a tiny hill not too far from the mansion, where a pomegranate tree was planted on the top. The old man placed down a bouquet of peony at the trunk and let out a tired sigh.

“Good news, Lady Gorgo. Your son is alive and healthy. I’m sorry that I couldn’t free him after all these years. Remember Aglaea? Your old friend back in college? Her team had brought Eurypon to justice and the young master no longer lived as his most successful experiment. He now carried the name that you always wanted him to have, Mydeimos. You can rest well now, Lady Gorgo. I swear on my pride as the butler of the Strife family, I will protect young master Mydeimos with my life.”

Krateros gave one last bow at the tree, then made his way back to the mansion.

To his surprise, the young master had already made himself dinner. Well, a single loaf of bread didn’t exactly count as dinner in Krateros’s book, but nonetheless Mydeimos knew how to make food for himself. There were a lot of questions running though the old man’s brain, but he chose the most important one at that moment.

“Young-… Mydeimos, pardon my rudeness but what are you wearing?”

“Oh this? The wolf hybrid gave it to me; he said that he couldn’t keep it because Aglaea checked his wardrobe bi-monthly. Professor Anaxa told me that I need to keep and protect these pants from Aglaea.” Mydeimos pointed at the purple pants dotted with dromas prints all over it. Krateros let out a sigh of relief when the chimera hybrid said that the outfit was temporary because he got hungry before he could unpack his clothes. The butler chose not to ask why Mydeimos packed the horrendous combination of bright yellow and purple separate from the clothes that Aglaea bought him. Mydeimos looked better than the version of him that came looking for Krateros in the middle of the night. Those lifeless eyes now have some light back in them, if wearing those clothes cheer him up even just a little, the old man was willing turn a blind eye to the questionable and borderline offensive piece of fashion in front of him.

Even though Mydeimos seemed content enough with his slowly baking in the oven loaf of bread, the butler wasn’t about to let him eat bread for dinner. Krateros opened the fridge to take out some ingredients for a simple pot of soup, and a piece of scrap meat for the dog. Wait a minute, a dog?! The butler thought he was hallucinating due to old age but there it was, a white fluffy dog was sitting right next to Mydeimos, staring at the loaf of bread inside the oven with him.

“Mydeimos, where did you find that dog?”

“He was sleeping in one of the dried-up fountains and I accidentally woke him up while walking around, I guess? Anyway, he barked at me, I slapped him with my tail and now he kept following me”

“… I guess we have a pet now”

---

Back in Okhema

“He called me a WHAT?!”

That was the most expressive Phainon had ever been after his Mydeimos left. All because of the text that took Anaxa an hour to translate, more like an hour to look for the dictionary in the Grove’s grand library. The chimera that Phainon had abducted against its will gave him an “awoo” that Phainon swore the cute orange thing was laughing at him. For a creature that was suddenly kidnapped by a wolf hybrid ten times its size, the chimera looked quite relaxed and calmed in his arms.

“Wow that was loud, I’m glad the little wolf had returned to his usual non-depressed self” Cipher walked into the lounge while rubbing at her ears with Aglaea behind her. Both women froze when they saw the chimera in Phainon’s arm.

“Goodness me, is that Mydeimos’ illegitimate child? I was so sure that Phainon was his first love” Unfortunately Phainon didn’t catch on that Cipher was joking, his mind stopped working after he heard the first sentence and completely ignored the fact that Cipher just straight up told him that his feelings for the chimera hybrid was mutual.

Thanks to Cipher’s mouth, Phainon had rolled himself into a burrito blanket rocking himself back and forth on the couch. Aglaea hit the cat’s head with the back of her hand, while Anaxa contemplated when did he went wrong in teaching Phainon. They say love is blind but when it comes to Phainon, love also made him stupid.

chapters.title: Chapter 7
chapters.html:
Training was an interesting experience for Mydeimos. From what Krateros had told him after a full day of sparring, despite being a chimera hybrid all that Mydeimos had utilized from his mix of three animal genes was the lion. He fought with pure strength, using his blows to tire out his opponent. Mydeimos believed that pure strength could lead him to victory, that’s why he rarely used his tail for combat. Which turned his very noticeable tail into one of his weaknesses. Because of how Eurypon had been “raising” the chimera hybrid, all he knew was fought with his fists.

Mydeimos returned to his room with bruises forming on his body. The old man was a tough opponent, but he couldn’t bring that rush of adrenaline that Mydeimos felt when he sparred with Phainon. All Krateros had been doing the past few days was tying Mydeimos’ hands behind him and proceeded to fight the chimera with his full strength. The hybrid flopped down on top of the hoodie that he stole borrowed from Phainon after the wolf destroyed his shirt during one of their friendly spars.

It had been a week since he left Okhema, Mydeimos missed his family. He missed the conversations with Cipher and Aglaea. He missed the small trivia from Tribios. He missed the nonsensical strings of numbers that Anaxa liked to write on random pieces of paper. He missed gardening and bird watching with Castorice and Hyacine.

He missed the constant yapping of a certain white-haired wolf hybrid. He missed the gentle way Phainon brushed through his hair every morning. He missed Phainon’s smiles and silly jokes. Mydeimos turned his head to look at the vase that Phainon had gifted him. If it was given to anyone else, they would have rejected it. But Mydeimos gladly accepted it, he accepted Phainon’s courting gift pretending that he wanted a vase in his temporary room. It was both a blessing and a curse that Phainon blindly believed that Mydeimos had no knowledge about romance and courting.

Mydeimos had to come clean about it when he was able to return to the Chrysos’ HQ. If Phainon hated him because of it, Mydeimos wouldn’t blame him at all. If that happened, he would ask Aglaea to let him stay in the rooms on the opposite side of the HQ and probably avoid the other for the rest of time.

Speaking of Phainon, the fluffy ball of white fur that picked Mydeimos as its new owner trotted inside his room. The dog started wagging its tail and barked at Mydeimos when he saw the chimera was home. The resemblance was scarily similar.

“Did you go and play near the fences again? I just bathe you yesterday and now you’re covered in grass and vines” The dog seemingly realized that he was getting scolded, lowered its head to look up at Mydeimos with those guilty puppy eyes. Mydeimos would’ve carried the thing to the bathroom if Krateros hadn’t absolutely floored him in their spars.

“Go bark at Krateros until he gave you another bath. We’re not cuddling until your fur is spotless Pienon” The resemblance was uncanny, both in appearance and personality. You couldn’t even blame Mydeimos for naming him “Pienon”. The fact that the white fluff ball actually left the room to go find Krateros made Mydeimos question if Phainon somehow learned to shapeshift.

The thought was discarded when Mydeimos realized Phainon was a wolf hybrid, not a dog hybrid. With the way he acted around Mydeimos, no one would suspect that the ball of sunshine dancing around the chimera hybrid 24/7 was a wolf.

The chimera hybrid decided to get up after burying his nose into Phainon’s hoodie and reached over to the bottle of moisturizer that was also a gift from the white-haired man. The wounds from that time had already healed, now Mydeimos just needed to wait to shed the old skin of his tail, and it would look like nothing had ever happened to it. He looked at the slim bottle in his hand then to his tail and had a eureka moment.

Whether or not he could execute it tomorrow was a problem for his future self. Mydeimos wanted to eat something first.

---

Back at the Chrysos’ HQ, Phainon was starting to believe that the chimera he found in the garden was Mydeimos’ baby. Because taking care of it was akin to taking care of a toddler, the little thing was way too energetic for Phainon. Everyone had to watch their steps carefully thanks to how the chimera was running around. Anaxa accidentally stepped on its tail one morning and it cried until Phainon showed up, still in his pajamas, to pick up his(?) crying child(?). The way it nuzzled the top of its head against Phainon’s chin reminded the wolf of how Mydeimos would nuzzle against his face after the chimera hybrid was done grooming the tuff on his ear.

The orange chimera’s crime against his beauty sleep was temporarily forgotten as Phainon reminisced about his crush. The small chimera was put in its timeout crate (courtesy of Castorice) when it bit the hand that was about to give it chin scratches. Having the chimera around somewhat help Phainon with his yearnmaxxing for Mydeimos, but the team would often see Phainon napping against Aglaea’s apple tree, right next to the bed of white lily that Mydeimos had planted.

From the Chrysos team’s perspective, Phainon was making it look like Mydeimos had gone off to war and the wolf hybrid was left at home, waiting day after day for his love to return from the battlefield. Like a maiden trapped in a tower looking out at the setting sun praying and hoping for a glimpse of shining armor.

The lonely maiden(lol) woke up from the sound of his own stomach protesting, as he stretched and stood up, Phainon saw his adopted chimera child running toward him. With trouble right behind the small creature, Hyacine was chasing after it. The wolf soon figured out why after he picked on the creature by the scruff. The chimera was holding one of Hyacine’s recipe notes in its mouth, it only let Phainon grab the paper after he threatened to stop cuddling it to sleep. The orange ball of cuteness clung to Hyacine’s leg while letting out pitiful awoo noises. The girl was not able to resist those large teary honeyed yellow eyes looking up at her, so after taking a picture of her recipe she gave the chimera the piece of paper.

The chimera let out happy purrs and awoo after Hyacine put the recipe down in front of it. It kept looking at Phainon while jumping up and down tapping its paws on the picture of the dessert on the paper. Both Hyacine and Phainon swore they saw the thing rolled its eyes after the wolf wrongly guessed what its was trying to communicate three times. It sat down on its hindlegs and tapped the picture with its tail.

“Fig stew?” The chimera let out an high pitch awoo, then it continued to tap the picture a couple more times before using its tail to tap at his body.

“You want fig stew for dinner?” Phainon pretty sure he saw the same expression the chimera was giving him on Anaxa’s face after he gave him the wrong answer to an obvious question.

“Your name is Fig Stew?” Hyacine spoke up and the chimera was overjoyed. It jumped into her arms and gave her kisses and nuzzled against her face.

“Great, the devil incarnate has a cute name” Phainon said tiredly.

chapters.title: Chapter 8
chapters.html:
One step right

Jump back

He’s winding up a strike

Focus, Mydeimos. Focus your strength on your glutes.

One…

Two…

THREE!

Krateros was caught completely off guard at Mydeimos’ movement. Their training spar was falling into the usual rhythm, with Krateros on the offense while Mydeimos on the defense because his hands were tied behind him. Just when the old man thought the hybrid was about to lost balance, the younger man focused his strength to his thighs and tail in order to create enough force to help him jumped over Krateros’s head. When the butler swung his body around for another strike, Mydeimos leaned his body weight on his tail, using it to keep himself from falling as he pulled his legs back. Thanks to how his tail supported Mydeimos’ entire body, Krateros’s punch missed because the hybrid was lower to the ground. Careful not to break any bones, Mydeimos’ kicked with both his legs, sending Krateros tumbling back a few meters.

The old man gathered his strength to stand up immediately, bracing himself to a hit from the hybrid. Yet nothing happened. He opened his eyes to see Mydeimos standing exactly where he had kicked the old man, posture calm and relax, his eyes devoid of the murderous glint but filled with focused, no more rapid breathing of a raging beast.

---

It took weeks for Mydeimos to learn to take advantage of the agility and gravity defying adaptation of his goat DNA. He learned about it thanks to Krateros unlocking his addiction to pomegranate.

On a beautiful sunny day, Mydeimos spent hours looking up at those ripe purple fruits hanging on the tree branches, hoping for some would fall. The urge to climb the tree was strong but disappeared immediately when Krateros told him that Gorgo planted this tree when she was pregnant. The dog that inserted himself into Mydeimos’ life didn’t have the same sentiment and quickly climbed the pomegranate tree and got himself stuck. Mydeimos’ body moved on its own when he heard Pienon’s pitiful whines and cries. One moment he was on the ground, the next moment his legs took him to where the shaking white ball of fur was on.

“Shh Shh you’re okay now, I got you” Mydeimos tried to comfort the scared puppy clinging on to his shoulders. That was when the chimera hybrid realized that he was standing on the tree trunk, like how mountain goat stood on the cliff surface.

After practicing day after day, Mydeimos finally got the hang of it and used his new ability to climb to the mansion’s roof to gaze at the stars with Pienon comfortably resting his snout on the hybrid’s lap. Krateros almost got a heart attack when he opened the door to the hybrid’s room to find no traces of both hybrid and dog, only an open window. Another headache that came with Mydeimos new ability was the young man now have an escape from Krateros training area. The hybrid simply used the walls to walk out of the place when he didn’t feel like getting bruised and battered.

(Krateros threatened to lock Pienon outside at night if Mydeimos pulled that stunt again)

Mydeimos discovered his goat-like adaptation through trying to recuse his pet dog, a very anime protagonist style. On the other hand, the way the chimera hybrid trained his tail to grip and hold different items was through malicious acts of stealing late night snack from the pantry.

The butler had noticed that the food stored in the pantry was slowly dwindling, so he decided to set up a camera to catch the perpetrator. The night passed to make way for the shining sun, Krateros sent Mydeimos on a grocery trip. Naturally, Pienon trotted towards the blonde with his harness in his mouth. The old man scolded the younger one for carrying Pienon in his arms everywhere and getting fur on his clothes, so now the dog had a collection of collars and harnesses.

Enough sidetrack about Pienon, back to Krateros’s camera footage.

The camera recorded nothing for the first few hours of the night. The butler was about to turn off the video when the camera spotted movement near the edge of the camera’s range. There was no way he wouldn’t recognize that walking ball of fur. Pienon was seen walking towards the pantry door and sniffing at it, until the dog suddenly turned around and made direct contact with the camera. After that the footage was pitch black.

On the following day, Krateros decided to set up another camera in the corner of the kitchen, that night the camera caught something new. Mydeimos was walking towards the kitchen, carrying Pienon in his arms like one would carry a fat cat. With one arm supporting the puppy’s hind legs and the other acting as support for the puppy’s paws.

Krateros watched in astonishment as Mydeimos used his tail to open the cabinet and carefully fished out a cup with the tip of his tail hooked on the handle. The chimera managed to pour himself a cup of water with his tail, while he himself was busy pressing kisses on Pienon’s head and snout. Krateros didn’t know what to think of Mydeimos’ attachment to the stray dog, wasn’t the chimera hybrid had some sort of situationship or romantic attachment with someone back at the Chrysos’ HQ?

[No need to worry Krateros, that someone back at the Chrysos’ HQ is slowly growing attached to his adopted chimera child]

The pantry food thief remained a mystery till this day.

---

Three months had passed since that night, time for Mydeimos to pack up and return to see if his flowers were still alive.

Just as Mydeimos was able to get into the car, he heard rapid footsteps approaching him. A pair of gray-haired twins were calling out for him. Mydeimos had a hunch about what they were here for, judging by the rolled-up paper one of them was holding. The chimera opened up the rear door with his tail, Pienon jumped down to sit in front of the hybrid’s foot staring up at him with those big doe eyes.

“SNOWY!!!” Mydeimos was correct with his hunch. The dog was way too well-behaved to be a stray. The blonde crouched down to remove the blue collar on the dog, then point to the twins standing behind it. The dog cutely tilted his head at the gesture then turned around to stare at the twins.

“I’m guessing that you two are his owner?” The chimera asked, a light and friendly smile on his face. He kept his voice low on purpose so he wouldn’t accidentally flash his feline fangs and ruined his false identity as a Komodo dragon hybrid.

The paper the boy was holding was the adoption paper for Pie- Snowy, with both their names and signature on it. Mydeimos was waiting for Snowy to recognize its owner and ran into their arms, but to his and the twins’ surprise, the dog ran behind Mydeimos and squeezed his face in between his legs. The blonde was able to pick up the dog and deposit him in one of the twins arms when he heard more rapidly approaching footsteps. The middle-aged man had impressive stamina and speed for someone that age.

“You… two shouldn’t… suddenly ran away… like that!” The man said between breaths. He introduced himself after Krateros made sure he wouldn’t pass out. The man’s name was Welt, the twins’ guardian. He explained that half a year ago, he and the twins were staying in Kremnos for a vacation, the rascals sneaked out one day and somehow managed to adopt the dog. Welt had to take them back to the dog shelter to return the dog, the place let them keep the adoption paper because the twins were crying and begging Welt to let them have it.

“When we arrived here yesterday, the twins went to see if anyone had adopted him and was informed that it had ran away 3 months ago. Thankfully, before they could make a scene from their tears, an employee said that he was seen with a man with orange tail” Welt gestured towards Mydeimos’ tail.

Turned out the twins weren’t there to take Pienon back with them, they just wanted to give him a few pets before the dog moved to Okhema with Mydeimos.

“I hope Phainon is getting along with the chimera that kept calling me mama” Mydeimos voiced his thoughts after Pienon had fallen asleep on his lap.

“There’s a chimera at the Chrysos’ place? Aglaea never mention hiring one” Krateros followed.

“I don’t think she knew that Fig Stew had been hiding in the garden for a few months before I found him. The little one was trained to be an emotional support chimera, but it ran away because the scholar at the Garden of Life was giving it pellets without any taste for every meal. I gave Fig Stew a apple tart and it started calling me mama”

chapters.title: Chapter 9
chapters.html:
Phainon had turned into a pet parent is the best summary for what had happened in the past three months without Mydeimos.

The day after the team learned the chimera name, Fig Stew had been somewhat more well behaved compared to the week that he was involuntarily adopted by Phainon. Fig Stew had been seen walking with Hyacine when she went out to refill the bird feeder in the morning. At noon, the small creature could be found in three spots, napping next to the bed of white lily next to aglaea’s apple tree, curled up in a corner in Anaxa’s reading corner or contently buried under Aglaea’s pile of scrap fabric. All three spots shared the same feature: warm, cozy and quiet, which is why Fig Stew avoided Phainon like the plague when it wanted to nap.

In the afternoon, specifically after Phainon had finished whatever task Tribios and Aglaea had given him, Fig Stew was either following Phainon around or playing with (distracting) the wolf hybrid while said person was trying to work out. The orange cutie somehow found a way to entertain itself with whatever set Phainon was doing that day. Whenever it was legs day, the wolf’s tail was Fig Stew’s toy, wrestling and tugging at the fur. It even joined Phainon on the treadmill for cardio, the hybrid often switched to walking mode when the chimera wanted to jump on the track.

A month after Fig Stew had stayed with Phainon, the wolf started getting a bit mischievous towards the creature. He started recording videos and posted them on a social media account he made named Fig_Stew, and the only thing in the description was “I found a chimera in the garden on a sunny day”. The account originally was Phainon’s pictures and videos archive, so he could show Mydeimos when they met each other again someday. He didn’t expect to gain a small community of followers from his badly filmed videos and silly pictures of Fig Stew.

When there was the trend of fake crying in front of your pet, Phainon uploaded security footage, and it went viral. So much so that he had to take the video down and switch the account to private. The video started out with Phainon in the HQ’s shared kitchen, in a grey hoodie with a black box edited over his face for anonymity, holding a jar of freshly cut onions and taking a generous whiff. Tears started running down Phainon’s face, he then hid the jar and slumped over the kitchen island. Not even half a minute after he began fake sobbing, Fig Stew was running towards him. The small thing was sprinting so fast that when it tried to stop, it slid across the floor for a good half meter.

“Fig Stew *sniffle* I missed Mydeimos so much *sob*, I should have confessed *cough* my feelings sooner. What if he returned *sniff* with another handsome man by his side? *sob*” Phainon looked at the chimera and returned to slump over the counter again, this time bawling louder. (Rest assured, Phainon made sure that his voice was edited to sound distorted and censored out Mydeimos’ name). Fig Stew was making all kinds of cute noises to cheer him up, Phainon had to hold himself back to not reach down and coo at the chimera.

What had made the video viral was the footage of Fig Stew walking towards the fridge and trying its hardest to open the freezer compartment. The little orange ball finally managed to open the door after a while and once again tried to pull out one of the freezer drawers. Phainon watched with his jaw on the ground, all that playing during his work out was on purpose? The wolf managed to duck his head down when Fig Stew turned around to check on him.

“Mydeimos… wahhh ૮₍˶ ╥ ‸ ╥ ⑅₎ა” [He wasn’t even pretending at this point lol]

Fig Stew made a happy noise when it finally opened a freezer drawer, the one that Phainon hid his stash of fruit popsicle in. The chimera watched Phainon like a hawk stalking its prey when it managed to drag a popsicle to the wolf. Fig Stew then dragged Phainon by his pants leg towards Cipher’s beanbag and awoo at him till he sat down on it. Phainon did not expect Fig Stew to climb on his head and started licking at the tuff of fur on his ears. Phainon wanted to cry for real this time but held back and picked Fig Stew up in his arms.

The chimera slapped Phainon with its paws so hard that it left a paw print on his cheek after Fig Stew saw the poorly hidden jar of onions.

Somewhere in the middle of the second month, Fig Stew decided to play in the dirt on a beautiful day, its orange fur turned into light brown after rolling around in the garden. Phainon was given firsthand experience, for future parenting, on how impossible it was to bathe a toddler that was unwilling to be cleaned. With the toddler having the speed and agility of a chimera.

“Oh you gotta be kidding me, HOW are you standing on a 90 surface?!”

“Interesting… Never would have expected a chimera could do that, that got to be the goat DNA”

“Professor Anaxa! Don’t just stand there, help me with the child!” The team started calling Fig Stew Phainon’s adopted child unironically and now all of them couldn’t stop referring to the chimera as that, including Phainon.

“That’s Anaxagoras to you. And what do you expect me to do? Shoot your adopted child with a sedative shot like how I shoot your dear Mydeimos?”

“Okay you right you right” Phainon raised his hand in mock surrender.

Fig Stew was captured after being lured with the promise of dessert and sweets for dinner.

Parenting life wouldn’t be parenting life if the parent didn’t experience fear and panic.

Phainon woke up without Fig Stew cuddling up against his side. He didn’t give much thought to it at first, the chimera could’ve woken up earlier and went for a walk around the HQ. Castorice said that she saw Fig Stew where the white lily was, so Phainon assumed the chimera had munched on some of the apples there for breakfast. But when it was lunch time, Phainon couldn’t find Fig Stew anywhere, he checked all the napping spots and even checked Mydeimos’ room for the little creature and still couldn’t find it. When everyone else said that they hadn’t seen it at all today, panic started to set in.

The Chrysos team all pitched in to help Phainon find his chimera child, they searched all over the HQ, every single crack and crevasse that Fig Stew could crawl into, but no one could find even a tuff of fur or a single orange scale. It was already late afternoon when Cipher found a dug-out hole under the garden’s fence, the team hadn’t seen that much panic in Phainon’s eyes since the incident with Mydeimos’ tail. The wolf hybrid jumped over the fence and ran toward the road leading to the outskirts of Okhema.

“FIG STEW! Where are you?!”

“This isn’t funny you little rascal…” Tears started welling up in Phainon’s eyes, his voice began trembling.

“Please… not you too… just because you look like him… doesn’t mean that you have to leave me too…” Salty droplets were pouring out from Phainon’s eyes as the wolf kept trying to look for the small chimera, his voice trembling and shaking every time he called out for it. As his tears hit the ground, raindrops were beginning to pour down.

The night had already set when Algaea found Phainon sitting on the side of the road with his head down, completely soaked from head to toe from the pouring rain. The rain had lessened when Phainon arrived back at the HQ’s door. Hyacine immediately ushered him near the heater and wrapped him in a giant towel. The rain stopped not long after that, leaving the only droplets pouring down was Phainon’s tears.

“Hey… Phainon, how about we go check the garden one more time? Maybe Fig Stew had ran back when it started raining.” Castorice tried to comfort him, offering Phainon a hand to stand up.

“Chimeras are smart creatures. Fig Stew should have no problem finding it way back. Let go check where the white lily is” Hyacine chimed in.

“I’ll come with you three. If that small thing decided to run, I’ll catch it like how I catch runaway criminals” Cipher stood up and stretched.

“They’re right, Phainon. Why don’t you go check the garden one last time?” Tribios gave him a bright smile. To be exact, the entire team all had a knowing smile on their face, Phainon was too stuck in his own spiral of sadness to notice it. The wolf didn’t even notice that the team stopped walking with him when they entered Aglaea’s orchard.

Phainon stopped in his track when a ball of white fur came running at his feet. That was when the wolf hybrid decided to look up. Fig Stew was curled up and sleeping soundly next to the white lily, which had finally bloomed.

The cloud cleared, giving way to the silver moonlight shining down on the figure standing in front of the blooming white lilies. The smell of rain made way for the sweet and floral scent of the flowers. As Phainon slowly approached the figure, his nose picked up on the scent that he swore on his life that he would never forget. The moonlight casted a beautiful glow on golden blonde hair, the light reflected on orange scale, giving the tail an angelic shine. Soft, gentle golden eyes that remind Phainon of the wheat field of Aedes Elysiae met with his own cerulean blue, reminiscence of the clear summer sky.

Phainon ran as fast as he could, to fall into the embrace of the person that reminded him of his own home.

“Not going to give me a welcome home?” The blonde chuckled as he returned the hug.

“Not until you apologized for leaving so suddenly. And- *sniff* I won’t settled for a s- single I’m sorry from you” Phainon’s voice trembled slightly as tears fall from his face, he had been crying a lot today, but the wolf couldn’t hold them back when he finally see the one plaguing this dream all this time.

“It’s been three months Phainon. You’re being a drama queen”

“Three months for you, but it feel like 30 million years for me! Now you have to apologize for leaving me and for calling me a drama queen!” Mydeimos let out a hum, seemingly thinking about what to do to humor the man burying his face in his neck. The chimera hybrid let go of their hugs and smile at Phainon’s pouty face. The wolf wasn’t prepare or even expect Mydeimos to lean in and press a quick kiss on his nose.

“That ugly, but in an endearing way, vase that you gave me back then. I accept it as your courting gift. I accept all of your advances to court me in the past.”

“W- wait… what?!” Phainon was so shocked that he forgot he was crying a few seconds ago. There were questions running in his brain, Mydeimos being the benevolent person that he was answered them without Phainon even asking.

“I… was aware of your advances in the past. But because of my own selfishness, I want you to continue to shower me with your affection. So, I kept leading you on, for that I’m sorry. Resent me all you want after this, but please know that I have genuine romantic feelings for you, they never went away but only grew stronger in the past three months” Mydeimos gave Phainon another kiss on his forehead, then picked Fig Stew up in his arms and headed towards the HQ building with the ball of white fur following him.

The chimera hybrid wasn’t able to go far before Phainon grabbed his arm to turn him around. The wolf hybrid quickly took Fig Stew out of the other’s arms and put the thing down on the ground. Phainon grabbed Mydeimos’ waist and pulled the blonde against his body.

Mydeimos’ froze when he felt a pair of lips against his, but relaxed and returned the kiss not long after. To Phainon’s surprise, the chimera hybrid wrapped his arms around his neck to pull him into a deeper kiss. The two only let go when they heard Cipher whistle at their intimacy, the cat gave Phainon a thumb up as she received her share of cash from winning the bet against Aglaea, Tribios and Hyacine.

“Oh Mydeimos, I like so much that you could light the entire city on fire, and I would still cuddle and kiss you every night. I accept your apologies for leading me on, but I want compensation for all the mental and physical torture that your child had put me through these past months”

Fig Stew let out a happy awoo at Phainon’s words

“Sure, whatever you want. Prepare for more troubles in the future, you have another child to take care of now” Mydeimos joked, laughing at Phainon’s horrified look as he stared at Fig Stew and Pienon.

/// Time for the domestic fluff chapters!///

Chapter End Notes

Warning: Author got emotionally attached to Fig Stew and Pienon after this chapter

chapters.title: Chapter 10
chapters.html:
The Chrysos HQ now have a walking sun in their custody, aka Phainon. After Mydeimos had returned the wolf hybrid had his shining smile cemented on his face 24/7. Post-training Mydeimos was a pleasant surprise for everyone. Anaxa now has a reading buddy, with how often the chimera hybrid was seen in his reading corner. Castorice’s flower garden now has plenty of flower seeds that are native to Castrum Kremnos. Hyacine was more than thrilled to learn that Mydeimos could speak chimera, and his large physique made him into a chimera magnet. The pink haired girl hypothesized that the chimeras saw him as their mother thanks to Fig Stew kept calling him mama. Cipher had been eating dinner with everyone rather than taking it back to her room, all due to Mydeimos’ unlocking his master chef skill during his time in Kremos.

Aglaea had been unintentionally trying to murder Phainon, according to the victim himself. Mydeimos became Aglaea new model because she wanted to personally tailor new clothes for the blonde. Totally not because she saw the purple dormas pants that Phainon and Anaxa were trying to keep hidden from her scissors. Phainon only learned about it when he almost fainted from his nose bleed upon entering Mydeimos’ room. Red looked extremely good on Mydeimos, Phainon had no idea what the other was wearing but he knew for a fact that he wasn’t letting him walk around with almost his entire chest exposed. As the wolf scanned his eyes up and down Mydeimos’ clothing, having to swallow his own saliva when he saw the thigh strap above the golden legs amor. Phainon could feel something rising and it’s not just his appreciation for Mydeimos’ sinful body.

Another attempt at Phainon’s life was done by Cipher. Upon hearing the Mydeimos was making his famous golden honeycake, Phainon and both his “children” ran toward the kitchen. There they found Mydeimos sieving flour into a bowl. Fig Stew and Pienon were fixated on the box of chimera cookies on the counter while Phainon stared at Mydeimos’ pink frilly apron, making eye contact with the cat face stretched over the blonde’s chest. Phainon later learned that Cipher gifted it to Mydeimos.

[Phainon’s guide on the quickest way to lose your portion of honeycake: “I can’t tell if it’s the apron or your chest had actually gotten bigger”]

None of the team questioned why Mydeimos intentionally skipped over Phainon’s plate when giving out his honeycakes. Not because they didn’t care, they simply don’t want to suffer the same fate as Phainon honeycake-less ass. The Chrysos team watched in amusement as Phainon pout turned into a frown when he saw his boyfriend gave Fig Stew and Pienon their own tiny stack of honeycakes. Apparently, Phainon was being pathetic enough over one plate of golden honeycake that his pathetic-ness transform into cuteness that could only be perceived by Mydeimos’ eyes. Imagined a samyoed, with its ears drooping down, its big sad puppy eyes staring at an empty plate, that’s what Phainon’s looked like through Mydeimos’ eyes.

Phainon sulked all the way back to his room when Mydeimos clicked his tongue at him. Upon opening the door, the delicious smell of a steaming hot plate of golden honeycake hit his nose. Phainon immediately went for a bite, melting at the sweet and fluffiness of the honeycake. His tail was wagging so fast that it could generate a wind current, his ahoge twisted into a love heart at the warm and fuzziness in his stomach, thinking about Mydeimos making another batch of honeycakes and bringing it to his room. Phainon was so focus on the plate of food that he didn’t notice Fig Stew running out of his room.

Mydeimos was cleaning up the dishes when his chimera child returned to report his findings.

“Awooo”

“He’s that happy over a plate of golden honeycakes?” Mydeimos chuckled fondly “What a simple man. I guess that just part of your papa’s charm”

Fig Stew looked extremely offended that Mydeimos called Phainon his papa. Before it could make anymore chimera noise, the blonde picked it up and cradled it in his arms. Just like how one would cradle a newborn baby in their arms. Thankfully, a certain wolf hybrid wasn’t there to feel jealous at the way Fig Stew nuzzled into his mama’s chest. The chimera let out content grumble and purr when Mydeimos began licking at its fur, grooming the orange ball of cuteness. Pienon let out a bark, protesting the lack of attention it was receiving.

Later that night, Phainon was skipping towards Mydeimos’ room with the intent of cuddling and sleeping with his boyfriend. Only to find out his spot was taken by Fig Stew, curling into a ball right next to his object of affection. Not one to return to his room Mydeimos-less, Phainon, like a good Fig Stew papa that he was, picked up the chimera and put it on the ground, next to Pienon. The devil incarnate, according to Phainon, was jostled awake to see it was now on the floor and Phainon was happily spooning Mydeimos to sleep. Living to Phainon nickname for Fig Stew, the chimera climbed back on the bed and started crying, waking the chimera hybrid up instantly.  

After Mydeimos finally coaxed Fig Stew back to sleep, this time putting the chimera on the dog bed to cuddle with Pienon. The blonde turned to give Phainon his disappointed parent stare, with his arms crossed, clearly waiting for Phainon to explain himself.

Two can play at that game, Phainon thought to himself when he looked at Fig Stew. Putting all his undercover experience to use, Phainon successfully put on his innocent defenseless crying face, lips trembling, hugging his tail while looking at Mydeimos with his large puppy eyes. Mydeimos’ stern expression dropped when he heard Phainon sniffling.

All according to keikaku, Phainon smugly grinned when Mydeimos pulled him into a hug. Knowing the other was weak to his handsomeness and cuteness, Phainon closed his eyes and slightly jut out his lips. On the outside Mydeimos was smiling at Phainon’s cuteness, inside he was screaming at his boyfriend’s adorable face asking for a kiss. The two lovers shared a tender kiss, falling into bed without breaking it.

“Goodnight, my beautiful blue sky”

“Sweet dream, my world”

chapters.title: Chapter 11
chapters.html:
When Mydeimos returned, Phainon thought he finally have the chance to do the more boy-ish activity with his boyfriend, like fishing, working out together, mushroom foraging etc. Apparently, his sweet angel was part of the girlies.

The wolf was planning on asking Mydeimos out on a fishing date but before he could open his mouth, Cipher had already joink his boyfriend on a trip to the fish market. Phainon was fine with it since later that day the two hybrids brought back some fresh fish for sashimi.

On the morning that Phainon wanted to head to the nearby mountain for some mushrooms, he woke up to a cold empty bed. Mydeimos didn’t give him a good morning kiss that day, because Phainon would have woken up the moment he felt those soft inviting lips on his forehead. During breakfast, he learned that Castorice had been researching mycelium for quite a while, and she managed to grow some oyster mushroom in her small garden shed. Mydeimos and Castorice were playing around with some mycelium cultures that Krateros had given them. The mushroom stew that night was delightful, so Phainon forgave Mydeimos for his lack of morning kisses.

Since Mydeimos was occupied during those times, the responsibility of taking care of Fig Stew and Pienon fell into Phainon’s hands. The Samoyed, Pienon was understandably co-operative with Phainon, given the latter was a wolf hybrid. Fig Stew, on the other hand, was acting like a spoiled brat after Mydeimos return. 

“I can’t believe I cried for you” Phainon said while rubbing the bridge of his nose and shaking his head. All he received was a very sassy awoo from the chimera perching on the Aglaea’s apple tree. The small creature bolted straight to the tree when Phainon took the kiddy pool and the pet shampoo out. Pienon, being a good boy, was already sitting inside the empty pool, waiting for Phainon to bathe him.

“Look, I know you prefer Mydeimos bathing you. I’m aware of how feline bathe each other and there is no way in hell I’m letting my boyfriend tongue near that dirty coat of yours. Do you want your mama to get sick, Fig Stew?” That last sentence finally convinced Fig Stew to climb down the tree and obediently yet defiantly let Phainon bathe it with water and soap. The wolf hybrid was covered in soap after he was done with Fig Stew. Pienon, on the other hand, was an absolute angel, staying still for Phainon to lather soap over his white coat.

The chimera is a good kid. It, for some reason, suddenly developed a dislike towards Phainon after Mydeimos got back. The small chimera, who used to eat anything that Phainon gave it turned into a picky eater, refusing to eat anything that the wolf hybrid gave it. The energetic child who tried to get Phainon to play with it in the past now didn’t even spare the jingly toy in Phainon’s hand a single glance.

Even Anaxa, who usually doesn’t care about anything other than his research, also noticed the strange change in Fig Stew’s behavior. Taking Tribios’ advice, Phainon brought the problem to Hyacine for consultation. 

The pink haired girl was silent for a good minute after hearing Phainon’s trouble with Fig Stew. She asked the wolf to recount what he and Mydeimos had been doing in front of Fig Stew. Everything Phainon told her wasn’t anything new from how the two were acting pre Mydeimos-less arc. Except they were more intimate than before but still normal Phaidei stuffs: grooming, eating/feeding each other, watching movies… the kisses were new, but it shouldn’t affect Fig Stew in anyway. Hyacine furrowed her brows to try and think about what had caused the chimera that used to cling to Phainon to act that way. A light bulb appeared on her head, indicating a thought in a cartoony and comical way.

“Sibling jealousy?!”

“Yes, Fig Stew must now see you as a new sibling striving for Mydeimos’ attention. As Fig Stew is still considered a baby chimera, it’s not uncommon for it to feel left out if Mydeimos simply didn’t pay attention to it for a few hours. Fig Stew’s young age could probably be why it called Mydeimos mama. The chimera is a bit larger than normal, that’s why I didn’t realize that Fig Stew was a baby.”

“… Do I need to ask Mydeimos to put his chimera baby on a diet?” Fortunately for Fig Stew, a diet wasn’t necessary as it was simply larger than the normal size chimera, not fat. The orange creature would hate him more if it found out Phainon was the reason for the lack of dessert from Mydeimos.

But the problem right now is…

How in Kephale’s balls do Phainon convince Fig Stew that he is papa isn’t the chimera’s sibling?

As much as Phainon hated the idea, he brought it up to Mydeimos. The wolf immediately regretted his action when the hand that was brushing his tail stopped. He turned around to see Mydeimos staring into space with his index finger resting against his chin. The chimera hybrid broke out from his thoughts when Phainon licked his face, whining because his boyfriend stopped brushing his tail. No wonder Fig Stew developed a case of sibling rivalry with Phainon, not even Pienon was that desperate for Mydeimos’ attention. [Probably because the puppy got three entire months of Mydeimos' undivided attention]

Phainon.exe stopped working when Mydeimos took advantage of his opened mouth and sneaked his tongue inside. Love hearts were flying around Phainon after he experienced their first make out session. Mydeimos let out a fond chuckle at Phainon dorky smile and red tinted face, he turned and headed towards the kitchen. Not without brushing his tail under Phainon’s chin, the wolf came to recognize that gesture was one of many wordless ways that Mydeimos flirted with him.

The two hybrids were in the kitchen preparing for dinner when Aglaea entered the kitchen, looking for Mydeimos. She handed the chimera hybrid a small gift bag, inside was the newest model of teleslate in the market. Phainon was thankful that he didn’t have to use his pocket money to get Mydeimos’ a teleslate as a gift but also just the slightest bit annoyed that he wasn’t able to give Mydeimos a teleslate as a gift.

It's not like Krateros refrained from calling Mydeimos “young master”, he did it on multiple occasions in front of the Chrysos team. It Phainon’s faut that he didn’t pay attention to the clue about his boyfriend’s wealthy family. The inheritance Gorgo left her son was more than enough to let Mydeimos live the rest of his life comfortably. Krateros just happened to double that amount in twenty years with investments and saving accounts. In short, Mydeimos is halfway to a billionaire without him even knowing it. [you can have my 30M credit Mydei, pls help me get E2S1 Phainon in less than 150 pulls]

Back to the Fig Stew being Phainon’s biggest hater problem:

The wolf hybrid could do nothing but sulked his way back to his own room because it was easier to coax Fig Stew to sleep with Pienon without Phainon in the room.

“It better to get him used to sleeping with Pienon, so he recognizes where his bed is. After a while, Fig Stew shouldn’t try to steal your spot on my bed” Mydeimos had told him and Phainon was sent off to his room for the night. The wolf was stubborn at first, but it was nothing that a few kisses in the hallway couldn’t solve. Phainon wanted to print out Mydeimos’ first “goodnight <3” text and framed it.

Phainon woke up in the next morning, a bit annoyed that he couldn't smell the pomegranate scent next to him. After a bit of stretching, the wolf hybrid went to freshen up and headed to the dining room/kitchen for breakfast, silently hoping Mydeimos made him honeycakes. The first thing he heard when stepping foot in the room was the sounds of Pienon and Fig Stew running around playing with each other. Phainon got his daily dose of domestic bliss as Mydeimos walked over to give him a good morning kiss, which the wolf returned with multiple smooches on the other’s face. Phainon finally let go of Mydeimos’ waist and ceased his kisses when Anaxa made a coughing sound at them.

The wolf hybrid was pulled towards the kitchen by Mydeimos’ tail, where the blonde handed him a feeding bottle full of milk. Phainon short-circuited as his eyes moved to stare at his boyfriend’s chest.
