Fun fact, cats and dogs cannot have cow milk because of its high amount of lactase, but they can have goat milk thanks to it having a lot less lactase.

“I can’t believe this man is my student” Anaxa mumbled in disbelief as he saw the gear turning in Phainon’s head. “Get your mind out of the gutter Phainon. I got Mydeimos some milk formula from the Garden of Life, this is a T-rated fic for heaven sakes” The chimera hybrid turned to give his tomato boyfriend a deadpan look while said boyfriend could only awkwardly laugh while scratching the back of his head.

“Wait… weren’t the milk formula for chimeras supposed to not be given out to the public?” Phainon tried to change the subject, turning his eyes away from Mydeimos’ piercing gaze.

“You are correct, my dear student. Other than the caretakers no one should be able to get their hands on those formula. Naturally, none of us should be able to get it. So, Cipher and I stole them for our nephew” Everyone was jokingly called Fig Stew Phainon’s adopted child, evolved into them calling Fig Stew his child, and now that Mydeimos’ returned, everyone started seeing Fig Stew (and Pienon) as their nephew. Phainon didn’t know how to feel about the development.

Before Phainon could continue his conversation with Anaxa, Mydeimos dropped Fig Stew in the wolf hybrid’s arm, with its back leaning against Phainon’s forearm. The chimera was fussing around at first because Phainon was the one cradling it but calmed down when it saw the feeding bottle. Bottle feeding Fig Stew was surprisingly relaxing, the way the chimera pawed at the bottle with its front legs was doing bad thing to Phainon’s heart. Never would he imagine how much bliss and warmth bottle feeding a baby chimera would bring him.

Anaxa isn’t one to believe in the miracle of the god nor does he pray to them. But upon seeing the gentle and loving expression on Phainon’s face, he prays that the wolf hybrid doesn’t get baby fever after this.

Phainon spent his entire day off, parent bonding (?) with Fig Stew. Giving the small chimera kisses while it was being held by Mydeimos, bottle feeding the creature during lunch and dinner, napping with both Pienon and Fig Stew. The sight of Phainon, Pienon and Fig Stew cuddling on a bean bag was endearing and cute. Mydeimos snapped a couple of pictures of his boyfriend, setting it as his new teleslate’s home screen.

“…Mydeimos” Phainon sleepily mumbled out, a loving smile plastered itself on his face when he saw his boyfriend. He tried to shuffle around to make room for the chimera hybrid, patting the empty space next to his as an invitation. Who can say no to cuddling your boyfriend for a nap? Mydeimos lay down on his side, his arm reached over to hug Phainon’s body. The wolf pressed a kiss on the other’s forehead, and they drifted off for a short nap.

Cipher was about to ask what the other was doing when Castorice motioned for her to be silent. The cat walked over to see what Tribios Hyacine and Castorice was looking at. The cat hybrid had to clench her jaw to not coo over the precious sight of their youngest members napping on the bean bag, looking not unlike a small family of four.

Chapter End Notes

If I get E2S1 Phainon, I'm writing a separate fic for this AU where both Phainon and Mydei experienced baby fever.

chapters.title: Chapter 12
chapters.html:
Normally Phainon didn’t mind having Mydeimos eyes on him, it meant that he could simply wink or blow a kiss and the blonde’s face would have the slightest tint of red on his cheek. Having a handsome face, and one that Mydeimos adored had its perk. Today was different, Mydeimos was clearly upset over something that Phainon did but wasn’t aware of. The tail that usually swaying in the air was thumping and flicking on the ground.

To make things even worse, it seemed like everyone, but Phainon knew what the chimera hybrid was mad about. None of them wanted to tell Phainon what was wrong with his darling angel, he couldn’t even buy the information from Cipher. He could feel those golden eyes burning a hole into his head while he was feeding Fig Stew its bottle. Phainon was willing to bet good money that Mydeimos’ wrath hasn’t descended on him was because of Fig Stew being cradled in his arms.

Oh Fig Stew, papa’s precious Fig Stew, Phainon silently thanked his adopted chimera child that no longer had sibling rivalry with him. The orange chimera after being burped, ran over to Mydeimos and made a lot of noises at him. The blonde picked the chimera up and walked towards the direction of his room, Fig Stew probably asked for a bath from him.

“Pie, go roll around in the dirt so Mydeimos have to also bathe you. Papa is on a mission to figure out why your mama is mad at me” Truly a father of the year Phainon was.

---

“Could it be that you roll around during your sleep and accidentally kicked him awake?” The gray-haired boy asked

“That wouldn’t be possible. He clings to me like second skin when we cuddled to sleep, and there’s no way I’m letting go of his soft body during my sleep!”

“Hmm did you go and adopt a dog without him knowing?” The girl with identical hair color to the other boy asked.

“No, he already has a dog why would I go—Did you two go adopt a dog without your guardian knowing?” Phainon looked down at the twins that he bumped into. The two saw how sad the wolf hybrid was and wouldn’t let him go without answers. The reason being he looked like Snowy, a pet Phainon had assumed.

“Hmmm Oh I know! You took too long to propose!” What kind of household did these two grew up in?

“That could be a valid reason, but we only dated for a month” Phainon started scanning the area for a middle-aged man missing two children and was actively looking for a set of twins wearing raccoon backpacks. The wolf didn’t have to wait for long as he saw a brown-haired man sprinting towards them from the corner of his eyes. The man thanked him for looking after the twins after scolding them about randomly running away again.

Phainon’s luck couldn’t be worse today. The white-haired male was planning on buying Mydeimos favorite strawberry cheesecake but when he arrived at the place the item was sold out. He was planning to head back when a newly opened store caught his eyes. A specialty perfume shop, cratered toward hybrids. The thought of non-hybrids smelling Phainon’s scent on Mydeimos was fueling the possessive side of Phainon. The wolf was looking between the two bottles on his hands, one with a chocolate-ty and smokiness of Vetiver with an underlying note of cinnamon and the other with a hint of warm woody scent of Patchouli mixed with the unmistakable floral scent of lilies.

The employee there saw Phainon was having a hard time choosing out a bottle and offered to help. They looked slightly disappointed upon hearing Phainon had a lover already but remained professional after that. The employee showed him a bottle of perfume and explained the ingredients and described the scent to him. Phainon still couldn’t figure out what “sensual” and “luminous” smell like. The employee sprayed a tiny amount on Phainon’s wrist for him to get a better smell. The wolf’s nose was hit with a pleasant scent of pomegranate and citrus then came the smell of sandalwood and the lingering floral scent.  [I have no idea what I’m doing here, all I know is that CK Euphoria Crystaline has pomegranate in it through a YT vid]   

---

From all the time spent with Mydeimos, Castorice and Hyacine knew he was a gentle and caring man. This was the first time they had seen Mydeimos this mad, he was furious the moment Phainon walked inside the room. They could hear the way Mydeimos tried his best not to growl out every single word as he asked them to leave. Phainon upon seeing how upset his boyfriend was, he walked over to the hissing chimera as the girl made their way out of the room. Hyacine and Castorice didn’t even make it out of the room when they heard a loud slap.

Phainon was frozen in place as he stared at the frustrated tears rolling down Mydeimos face. Fig Stew and Pienon were spooked from the action and ran under the bed while the girls moved to stand between the lovers. When Mydeimos heard the crying and whimpering sounds from both Fig Stew and Pienon, he closed his eyes to focus on deep breathing.

This is bad, I can’t fully calm down, Mydeimos thought while continuing to even his breathing. Fig Stew poked its head out from under the bed and saw what his mama was trying to do. The small chimera ran towards Mydeimos and pawing at his feet, asking to be held. The blonde’s expression softened when he saw Fig Stew and picked it up, letting the orange ball nuzzled and bump its head against Mydeimos’ face. Meanwhile, Pienon ran over to pull at Phainon’s pants asking the wolf to follow it. The puppy began pawing at the door of the bedside table, gesturing for Phainon to open it. Mydeimos’ reaction now made sense after Phainon saw what the items inside.

“Mydeimos, my love. Please let me explain. I-“ He was cut off as Mydeimos let Fig Stew down.

“Explain? There is no need for that Phainon. A tube of half used lipstick, and now you returned reeking of sweet perfume. Am I so boring that you went to find another lover after we’ve been together for just a month? Are you tired of m-“ Phainon surged forward to press a kiss on Mydeimos’ trembling lips and hugged him tight, as if Mydeimos would disappear if he let go. When Tribios taught him about this trick, he never thought he would result to using it, but Mydeimos was struggling to try to get out of his embrace.

Phainon used his strength to turn the chimera hybrid around. The wolf opened his mouth and bit down at the scruff of Mydeimos’ neck, as gently as he possibly could. The blonde went limp for a short moment, enough for Phainon to sat down on the bed and position Mydeimos to straddle him. Both Cas and Hyacine quickly left when Phainon gestured towards the door with an apologetic smile on his face.

“That was Aglaea’s lipstick, she planned to throw it away because she no longer like the its shade of red. I asked her for it a while ago because I wanted you to cover my face with your lips mark!” Phainon spoke as fast as he could, fearing Mydeimos would strangle him to get up.

“I didn’t know why you were upset at me today, so I went out to buy you a gift. You said you like that smell of pomegranate, right? Here, this is for you” Phainon took out a small box with a miniature perfume bottle inside. He took the bottle out and strayed it on Mydeimos’ wrist. The chimera hybrid’s face was bright red when he smelled the exact same scent that filled him with rage a moment ago. Mydeimos hugged Phainon tight, saying sorry over and over again when he realized his mistake. Apologizing for jumping into conclusion, frantically licking the red handprint on Phainon’s face.

“Oh Mydeimos, my baby mama-

Awoo!

Woof!             

-*ehem* Fig Stew and Pienon’s mama, my darling angel. I couldn’t say mad at you even if I tried, no need for anymore apologies, my love. But please, never ever think about the possibility that I’ll get tired of you. I know we only know each other for less than a year, but believed me when I say this:

I will never get tired of you. I will never stop loving you no matter how much time has passed. Not a year, not a decade; Hell, even if 30 million years have passed and we went through many lifetimes, I, Phainon K(h)aslana, will always love you in every lifetime, Mydeimos”

“Titans above, where did you learn to be this sappy?” Mydeimos chuckled after Phainon’s declaration and leaning in for a kiss. “I once read a fairytale about soulmates when I was young, I never believed in such a thing. Until one day, a handsome, capable, strong and loving wolf broke down the walls of my prison. That was when I realized that maybe that fairytale was right, and I finally met my soulmate. The one that opened the path to the freedom I had longed for.  

I love you too, Phainon K(h)aslana”

Awoooo! Awoo

Mydeimos let out a hearty laugher while Phainon gave Fig Stew the stink eyes.

“You lil’ rascal, can’t you see I’m having a moment with your mama?! Go find Hyacine or anyone else. They’re perfectly capable of giving you your bottle!”

Phainon: 0 - Fig Stew: 1

[idk what I’m keeping score for]

chapters.title: Chapter 13
chapters.html:
Phainon was overjoyed when Aglaea let him take Mydeimos out on a date. Well, a grocery run but there was only him and his boyfriend on this trip so it basically a date already.

In reality, Phainon had been so affectionate towards Mydeimos that the PDAs were getting a bit too much for the people in the same room as them. Mydeimos being the enabler did not help with the case. A slight brush of his tail under Phainon’s chin when the blonde passed by was enough for Phainon to active his tail-icopter. Even if the touch was accidental. Aglaea had enough of the love hearts floating around the place and sent the two outside for the day.

Phainon and Mydeimos bumped into some inconveniences during their outings. Phainon’s tail was wagging so much that a young cat hybrid thought it was a toy and pulled on his tail. The mother apologized profusely for her daughter’s misbehavior, while Mydeimos tried not to laugh at his boyfriend awkwardly reassuring the woman. Another problem relating to tail, just like back in Castrum Kremnos, Mydeimos’ orange tail was attracting too much attention, from both adults and children. While the chimera trying to pass as a Komodo dragon hybrid was used to the constant questions, Phainon was holding himself back from breaking an innocent civilian’s arm to stop them from touching his boyfriend’s tail.

Mydeimos, sensing the simmering murderous intent from Phainon, quickly excused himself and pulled the wolf towards the supermarket. On the entire way to their destination, Mydeimos’ tail was securely wrapped around the wolf’s arm. Phainon is a healthy and fit wolf hybrid but he’s going to die early if Mydeimos kept unknowingly killing him with his cuteness.

Scratch that, Phainon is going to die of cuteness. Mydeimos looked like a child in a candy store, eyes sparkling, lips tight trying to hold back his smile. The supermarket in Okhema was ten times the size of the grocery store near where Mydeimos was staying in Castrum Kremnos. Now it’s Phainon’s turn to hold Mydeimos’ hand, so the chimera hybrid wouldn’t wander off.

Mydeimos was staring at the giant aisle of pasta when Phainon tapped on his shoulder and popped a piece of sample food inside the other’s mouth. The swaying tail suddenly curved into a hook at the end was enough reasoning for Phainon to grab a few bags of the snack. The shopping cart was slowly piling up with things in the Chrysos team’s shopping list and stuff that Phainon grabbed because Mydeimos held the thing for more than 10 seconds.

“Phainon, they have pomegranate jam” Mydeimos stopped suddenly while they were walking through the jam aisle. Phainon turned to look at the very magenta corner of the shopping cart, filled with pomegranate flavored drinks and snacks, then looked at Mydeimos. The wolf was just calculating how much money they would need to pay, but his boyfriend misunderstood the look. The chimera got closer to Phainon and pulled him into a kiss and a smooch on his cheek when they separated.

“Please, sweetheart?” Phainon chuckled at Mydeimos’ words and scanned his eyes to see if there was anyone near them. He grabbed the jar that his lover was holding and pulled the man flushed against him. Phainon nosed at the expose collum of Mydeimos’ neck and pressed his lips against it, suckling lightly, leaving a red mark as he pulled back. The wolf pressed a light kiss on Mydeimos’ now very red face while grabbing the jam and putting it inside the cart.

“Sorry baby, there’s an asshole that kept staring and following you” The wolf hybrid looked behind Mydeimos, his eyes dark and cold staring at the man that kept eyeing up his lover.

“Let go home, I have enough of people trying to touch what’s mine” Mydeimos could only let himself be led along by Phainon’s hand on his back. On the outside his face was neutral, but on the inside his heart was running lap around his ribcage, and his mind kept rewinding back to that possessive look on Phainon’s face.

Titans that was hot as fuck, Mydeimos was screaming internally. The chimera was reminded that his lover was a wolf that could hold his ground against a military trained hybrid like him.

Meanwhile, Phainon was also screaming internally but over the thought that he may have scared his boyfriend off with his possessiveness, completely unaware that said boyfriend was having hearts in his eyes after the hickey.

Krateros came to pick the couple up after receiving Mydeimos’ text. Mainly because they bought too many things to carry back with their hands, and because the chimera hybrid had a sudden urge to groom Phainon’s fur.

“When you said Krateros is going to pick us up, you never mentioned that he’s going to drive a fucking limousine” Phainon stared in awe as the chauffer and Krateros put their plastic grocery bags inside a limousine. His rational side didn’t want to think about the prospect of Mydeimos being his sugar mommy/daddy, but the freaky side however…

Phainon snapped out of his daydream when a soft hand grabbed his. Mydeimos was smiling at him while cutely tilting his head, wondering why Phainon hadn’t got into the car yet. The wolf offered back his smile while gently squeezing his lover’s hand, letting him lead them into the limo. The interior was as fancy as expected, the seating was made from expensive high-quality leather that lined the wall in an L shape. The best thing, in Phainon opinion, in the limo was the mini fridge next to the build-in champagne bottle display [I made that up, idk if a limo actually has one].

The wolf had no idea what came over Mydeimos but he wasn’t complaining about the way his lover immediately climbed onto his lap when the door closed and started purring loudly while grooming his fur. Phainon was enjoying the attention and the comforting weight of Mydeimos on his lap when he heard the sound of a door sliding open.

“Pardon my intrusion, young master” Krateros opened the small window on the driver partition. Thankfully he did not comment on the way that Mydeimos was grooming the fur on Phainon’s ear. On the other hand, Phainon was as red as a tomato because his boyfriend was straddling his lap. He was getting a face-full of Mydeimos’ chest because the blonde was leaning forward to reach his fluffy ears. The young master turned to face Krateros, he switched from licking to nibbling on the tip of Phainon’s ear.  Krateros could hear the steam coming from Phainon head because the two lovers were sitting right next to the driver partition.

“I had forgot to hand you this when I dropped you off that the Chrysos HQ more than a month ago. My apologies, young master Mydeimos”

Phainon’s future of becoming Mydeimos’ sugar baby was rapidly becoming a reality. Krateros just handed, his darling boyfriend that take spoiling Phainon as his part-time job, a platinum card. The wolf was having a hard time believing that the chimera hybrid that purring in his arms and nibbling on his ear is a multi-millionaire.

“Phainon? Is there something wrong?” The blonde asked when he felt the arms around his waist tighten up. Phainon’s ears were drooping when he buried his face into the chimera’s chest, looking up at him with watery puppy dog eyes.

“You’re not gonna leave me and the others to chase the high-rise living right?” Mydeimos let out a fond sigh at his lover’s stupid thought. His hand moved to scratch the back of Phainon’s ears as he pulled the other into an embrace. If Phainon died because of suffocation between those mounds, he would die as a happy wolf.  

“You’re asking me if I would leave my current family to live alone in an apartment 30 floors above the ground? Of course not. I’m staying with you till the end of time, hks” Mydeimos squished the side of Phainon’s face with his hands, pressing a kiss on the wolf’s forehead.

“Besides, I’m having too much fun sneaking in the Garden of Life to steal milk formula for Fig Stew with Cipher”

“You WHAT?! That’s it I’m weening Fig Stew. No more crimes! Why is Aglaea turning a blind eye [*ehem] to this? WE are part of the police for titan’s sake!”

“Rest assures, Mr. Phainon. If the young master got caught, we have more than enough power and money to bail him and Ms. Cipher out” Krateros said from the other side of the partition.

“That’s not the point! Why don’t you just buy the formula? Surely you have connection for that right?” Phainon was close to losing it with his boyfriend who now had a criminal tendency and hung out with Cipher.

“Less talking, more kisses” Mydeimos nuzzled into Phainon’s neck, the wolf immediate shut up when he saw the lipstick in his lover's hand. 

The Chrysos team didn't even need to ask why the two was staying inside the car for 10 minutes. Mydeimos' proud smile and Phainon's face that covered in lips marks was telling enough. Cipher let out a whistle at the hickey on Mydeimos' neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 14
chapters.html:
The Chrysos team were hanging out in the lounge. Anaxa quietly reading his papers in his reading corner, Tribios and Aglaea were reading through reports. Hyacine was scrolling through social media with Fig Stew loafing on her lap. Castorice, Cipher and Mydeimos were doing their usual bonding routine. The two girls were helping Mydeimos applied his moisturizer on his tail since the scale there were showing sign of molting. In return, the chimera helped the girlies with their hair and nails. Cipher ran over to Hyacine to show off her new nails, while Tribios complimented Castorice new hair style. Everyone was enjoying the relaxing atmosphere when Fig Stew suddenly woke up and ran over to Mydeimos, asking for uppies. Cipher’s ears darted towards the entry way, then the cat hybrid ushered Castorice to the couch, making sure Hyacine legs were away from the floor.

Half a minute later, everyone could hear rapid footsteps coming from the hallway. A ball of white fur ran into the room followed by the hybrid with the same color hair. Seeing Phainon chasing the samyoed around wasn’t a rare sight because it was one of the many ways that the two played with each other. But this time, Phainon was holding a pet nail clipper in his hand.

Pienon was a good boy through and through. Never picky with his food, always eager to be bathed, potty trained, friendly and cute. Pienon didn’t even make a noise when he got his vaccines, but the puppy really hates getting his nails clipped. When his nail got too long, catching him was akin to trying to wrangle livestock with your barehand, lots of running and herding the pup into a corner to grab him. Phainon was in the running state, chasing the ball around the room. The samyoed saw Mydeimos holding Fig Stew in his arms and ran towards him, hiding behind his legs. The chase turned into a game of ring-around-the-rosie, with Phainon and Pienon running in circles around the chimeras. Mydeimos started rocking Fig Stew in his arms, comforting the scared baby.

Mydeimos had enough of Phainon and Pienon shenanigans when Fig Stew cried. Cradling the chimera in one arm, the blonde grabbed Phainon’s by the back of his shirt with his other. His tail quickly coiled around the samyoed, lifting it from the ground. After setting Fig Stew down in Castorice’s lap, Mydeimos dragged both dog and hybrid back to his room for a scolding.

“Am I the only who think that both Fig Stew and Pienon had a favorite parent?” Hyacine looked at the other two girls on the couch, reaching over to pet Fig Stew.

Meanwhile, in Mydeimos’ room

Woof

“Woof…”

“You’re a grown ass man, Phainon. Don’t bark at me with that pitiful voice”. Phainon was sitting on his knees with Pienon next to him, both looking sad and pitiful with their droopy ears and sad eyes. Mydeimos biggest weakness was Phainon’s puppy dog eyes, now that there were two of them… Naturally, he couldn’t stay mad at them for long. The blonde hybrid only let out a tired sigh before sitting down on the bed, scrolling and typing on his phone. The curious doggos trotted over to see what their favorite hybrid was doing, Phainon leaning over and anchoring his chin on Mydeimos’ shoulder while Pienon sat by his legs. Mydeimos placed an order for one of those scratching boards for dogs, Phainon was beyond happy when he saw it.

---

Aglaea was known for her incredible control over her facial expression, her face remained neural in all situations. While with the team, a soft smile here and a small chuckle there was not uncommon. But when she made her way into her orchard, she was dumbfounded at the sight in front of her, a spectacle of folly one would say. Phainon, Mydei and their adopted kids were enjoying their time together. The spectacle of tomfoolery began when Mydeimos hold out his hand in front of Pienon, the chimera hybrid said something to the samyoed but the puppy only titled his head confusingly at him. Mydeimos then tried again, but this time he held out his hand in front of Phainon. Aglaea could only shake her head and sigh when Phainon put his ball-up hand on Mydeimos’ palm. To make it worse, the blonde hybrid let Phainon took a bite out of his cupcake as rewards for what Aglaea hoped was the demonstration to help Pienon learn the trick.

“That’s enough foolishness for the day” she said to herself when both Fig Stew and Pienon put their paws on Mydeimos’ open palm on his next attempt. She bumped into Castorice and Cipher, who were looking for Mydeimos. The blonde woman pointed them to where he was and told them to prepare for whatever shenanigan the two male hybrids were up to. She then noticed that Castorice was holding 3 to-go drinks in her hand while Cipher was holding a cake box. The girls pick them up during their way back from patrol.

When they entered the orchard, unlike what Aglaea had warned them about, what the two girls saw was a normal day for the team. Mydeimos was sitting by the apple tree with Fig Stew suckling on his finger like a kitten while laying on its back. The two chimeras were laid back while enjoying the breeze. Meanwhile, Phainon was after chasing Pienon, who was chasing after a butterfly. When the hybrid caught the puppy, he wrestled it so Pienon would be on its back then began tickling it. Castorice and Cipher were looking at two different ways of parenting.

The girls were staring at the way Phainon just tossed his (adopted) child a few meters away from him and started running the opposite direction, resuming their game of chase, when Mydeimos called them over. Fig Stew got up and ran over to Cipher, leaning on her leg with its front paws, clearly curious over the smell of what she was holding. The cat hybrid gave the chimera a few head scratches before heading over to where Cas and Mydeimos were sitting. Fig Stew had curled up between Castorice and Cipher, enjoying the occasional pets and head scratches from them.

The trio were talking about random topic when Cipher brought up the existence of Fig Stew own social media that Phainon made for him. Mydeimos scrolled through the account, smiling at the different picture of Fig Stew sleeping and grooming itself. Castorice suggested that Mydeimos record the way Fig Stew was curled up between the girls and asked Phainon to post it later. The account had been inactive for quite a while so there was no reason to not do it. It was endearing to see how Mydeimos got a bit distracted with taking picture of Fig Stew, being able to communicate with chimeras had its perk. With food as bribery, Fig Stew had no problem with posing for pictures.

“Phainon”

“Yes, dear?” The wolf hybrid seemingly teleported next to his boyfriend. Phainon was cooing over how adorable the pictures were. Always the one eager to please his Mydeimos, Phainon uploaded a couple of pictures on Fig Stew’s account. A picture of it curled up in a ball, sleeping soundly. Another picture of Fig Stew loafing and a short video of Fig Stew holding onto Mydeimos’ hand while licking at the tube of cat treat.

Fig Stew was slowly working its way into becoming an influencer.

chapters.title: Chapter 15
chapters.html:
The life of the Chrysos special investigation team had its ups and downs. Since they were a classified team for the police force, they have to show up for work daily to keep their normal police work. Aglaea made sure that the team only have to go on patrol and do take care of some paperwork, so none of the team will be on dispatch when an emergency commission from the council dropped on their door. Their patrol route that Tribios had picked for them rarely had any trouble with mugging and fighting on the street.

Things changed a bit when Mydeimos was approved to join the police force by the council.

The first few weeks on patrol were peaceful, only meeting a few people that were impressed by his tail. The hybrid became quite the attention magnet when his route was changed to the street right outside a chimera nursery. The baby chimera recognized that Mydeimos was also a chimera and flocked to him like baby ducklings running towards their mother. Thankfully, civilians and the caretakers believed the babies’ reaction was because he dyed his tail orange, making it look like an orange chimera’s tail. The blonde became a small celebrity because of a video that went extremely viral of how baby chimeras would run along the fence to walk with him during patrol. The fact that Mydeimos looked extremely easy on the eyes was a major factor in his sudden fame.

Phainon, having a possessive side, was upset at the people taking pictures of his boyfriend. Mydeimos looked devilishly handsome in his police uniform, Phainon couldn’t blame people for wanting to take a picture with him. He was fine with strangers taking selfies with his lover, seeing the hickey peaking out under Mydeimos’ shirt in those pictures was exhilarating for the wolf hybrid. The one that made him extremely angry was the few people that sneakily took pictures of his body, zooming in on his ass, chest and tail. Phainon shattered his teleslate when he saw a picture of his lover’s ass when he bended down slightly to talk to a little girl. He silently thanked the gods above that other than checking out Fig Stew’s account, Mydeimos had zero interest in scrolling through social networks.

“Sorry, Phai-chan. I can’t change Mos-chan’s patrol route, the baby chimeras had taken quite a liking to him. The caretakers there had summited a request to the council to keep Mos-chan current patrol route”

Even if Tribios could change it, Phainon didn’t have the heart to actually follow through with his request. Mydeimos was way happier after returning from patrol when he was switched route, the wolf didn’t want to take that from him because of his stupid jealousy. All he could do to push his jealousy down was aggressively pet Pienon and squish Fig Stew’s face.

Phainon’s inner turmoil did not go unnoticed with Mydeimos, the blonde hybrid could read his lover like an open book. The chimera hybrid made sure to thoroughly kiss away all of Phainon’s stupid thoughts. The wolf scented him so often that Cipher mistook him for Phainon because of how much Mydeimos smelled like him. Poor Fig Stew and Pienon was having trouble finding their mama because of how strongly the blonde smell like Phainon.

Mydeimos started to see the scenting problem when Fig Stew ran to the other side of the HQ to get Anaxa to help find his mama, even though Mydeimos was in the room next to where the small thing was napping.

“Phainon, I need you to stop scenting me so often. From now on, you only get to do it when I’m preparing to go out for my patrol. And in moderation” Mydeimos sternly told the man that was walking towards him. He felt very bad when Phainon expression dropped immediately from happy to distraught, his wagging tail drooped down between his legs.

“Did the thought of asking to be stationed with me not cross your mind, you single minded fool” Mydeimos pinched the bridge of his nose, sighing loudly. The gomen oomf-chan ahh pose confirmed Mydeimos’ thought. Anaxa and Aglaea just earned more respect from the blonde, for having enough patience not to strangle Phainon whenever he did stuff without thinking. The man managed to scare off both Fig Stew and Pienon with his stressed pettings.

Just like that, everything went back to normal. Fig Stew and Pienon were spared from Phainon’s hands and Mydeimos returned to smelling like himself. Mydeimos’ internet fame died down after a couple weeks, just like how the blonde had told Phainon. Now the wolf hybrid didn’t have to worry about people looking at his boyfriend’s glorious assets. More importantly, Phainon successfully got transferred to where Mydeimos was patrolling.

A few days after the couple began patrolling together, they were asked to model for a new batch of recruit posters for the police academy. Apparently, high school students interested in applying for the academy got increased in the recent survey because of Mydeimos’ old and new video that went viral. The new one was recorded by one of the caretakers, showing Mydeimos and Phainon playing with the baby chimeras after they’re off-duty. The two sent a quick text to Anaxa and Tribios, who were teachers at the academy, about the poster thing. Both hybrids were correct with their suspicion, the sergeant was lying. With a plate of pomegranate flavored golden honeycakes and Mydeimos got the intel from detective Cipher.

“…huh?” The blonde hybrid was introduced to the concept of celebrities and idols merchandise. Mydeimos stared at Phainon for a good minute, slowly processing what his lover just told him. Phainon saying he would pay good money to buy a single scale from Mydeimos tail if he was an idol didn’t not help with the man’s confusion.

“Why would the sergeant sell our poster? We’re not celebrities”

Aglaea walked in when Phainon went on a rant about how he would become Mydeimos’ #1 fan if he decided to join the showbiz. The topic was quickly shut down.

chapters.title: Chapter 16
chapters.html:
Today was the bi-annual health check-ups at the Chrysos HQ, and also Mydeimos’ first check up after he got out of the underground lab more than half a year ago. Anaxa had expressed high interest in Mydeimos’ blood sample, curious of how the hybrid hormones and blood cells function with his DNAs being a mixed between 4 species.

Phainon’s interest, on the other hand, was a little bit more on the side of inappropriate interest. The wolf preferred to use the word “anthropometric measurements” rather than the terms of chest, stomach and waist measurements. He was a bit pouty during his boyfriend’s check-up because Hyacine wouldn’t let him help with the chimera’s measurements. Phainon could only watch as the tape measure tighten around places that the wolf wanted to squish every day.

Unsurprisingly, Mydeimos was very healthy and fit as a fiddle. Phainon almost shattered the cup in his hand when he overheard his chimera lover asking Anaxa and Hyacine why his body was softer than Phainon. The question was valid as they both shared the same physics. Phainon didn’t expect Anaxa to actually answer that question, furthermore, he didn’t expect the answer to be related to Mydeimos’ DNAs.

“Mydeimos, your father was a genius when it came to DNAs. I’m sorry for saying this but you are his magnum opus, as I believe that no one would be able to recreate your complex strands of DNAs” The mint-haired professor stopped and gestured the eavesdropping Phainon to come over, sitting him down next to Mydeimos. The way the trio was sitting made it look like a married couple waiting for the doctor to reveal the baby’s gender.

“DNA talk is very complex, and Mydeimos’ existent is another hundreds layer of complexity combined. I’ll keep it as simple as possible. From what we have gathered from the underground lab, that mad man was planning on create more chimera hybrids. Judging from how Mydeimos was raised up, we hypothesized that Eurypon was trying to strengthen the military might of Castrum Kremnos”

The strength of a lion, the vertical agility of a goat and the regenerative ability of the reptilians while possessing human intelligence. Mydeimos was a perfect weapon for Kremnos’ army with his brutality of a predator and the perception and alertness of a prey animal. But now that Mydeimos joined the Chrysos Heirs, unless the mission has high risk of combat, none of that mattered. Eurypon would be smashing his head against the prison wall if he knew his perfect killing machine is enjoying the domestic bliss, purring and sleeping in the arms of the wolf that destroyed the lab’s defense system that costed him a fortune.

True to his word, Anaxa kept the lecture brief and quick, kicking Phainon out and gave Mydeimos a nod when the blonde stood up to follow his lover. Phainon’s soul seemed to have left his body after the small lecture, not even reacting when Cipher stole the piece of cake that Mydeimos was trying to feed him. Mydeimos called Fig Stew and Pienon over when Cipher asked what happened to Phainon that made him like that. The blonde then dropped an atomic bomb level question on his adopted children and Cipher was stunned after hearing it.

“Fig Stew, Pienon. What do you think about a new younger sibling?” Both children joined Phainon in his “brain is not responding” corner. Castorice and Tribios walked into the room the exact moment Cipher put her hand on Mydeimos’ stomach and started feeling around for something.

“Mydeimos, I see you as my younger brother and I know you and Phainon are like the definition of soulmates…but please, please tell me you’re not with child. You two have only been dating for two months!” Cipher held Mydeimos’ hand with both of hers, an anxious smile on her face. The cat hybrid’s words were followed by multiple gasps and the sound of broken glass. Unfortunately, Krateros stopped by to check on his young master’s health check-up and brought him a glass of juice, which was now in pieces on the floor.

Phainon managed to keep his life after Mydeimos stepped out to explain everything to the Mydeimos protection squad™. While lion is known as the protector of their pride, lioness is the backbone of it. Lioness is equipped with exceptional hunting skills and ambush tactics while having good leadership and teamwork skills, characteristics that Eurypon looked for in his hybrid army. The mad man managed to do the impossible, modifying and stringing together a string of DNA that was impossible to replicate again without his knowledge. The lioness genes came with all that he wanted in a soldier, furthermore, it gave him the opportunity to replicate his genius creating through the work of nature.

“As crazy as this may sound but from the small journal I found among the debris, Mydeimos was a failed prototype because of Gorgo’s intervention” Krateros dropped another atomic bomb on everyone head. The late scientist had done something that had messed with the child developing inside her. Eurypon had told her about what he had done with their first child, confident that she didn’t have what it takes to kill her own child. And he was right; how can a mother do such a thing to her first baby. Being a scientist came with its perks, like knowing how much radiation that a human body can be exposed to for a minor change in DNA molecules.

The DNAs that originally written for Mydeimos were tampered with because Gorgo exposed herself to a controlled amount of radiation, enough to cause a couple of DNA molecules to change itself. This results in Mydeimos losing the ability to replicate the network of complex DNAs inside him and causing the human and lioness genes to become the dominant ones. These changes explained Mydeimos’ gentle and nurturing personality and the lack of horns despite having goat DNA.

Anaxa is going to be very upset that he wasn’t there while Krateros casually said that Mydeimos complex networks of DNA had a few defects in it. TLDR: If Phainon is not careful in the future, there will be mini Mydeimos or mini Phainon running around the HQ.

Seeing that Phainon’s soul hadn’t returned to his body, Cipher decided to tease him a little bit to help him snapped back to whatever daydream he was in. She came over and whispered to Mydeimos.

Phainon, the unfortunate soul, had no idea what Cipher had tainted his lover’s innocence mind with. The moment Mydeimos whispered that word into Phainon’s ear, the wolf immediately snapped his head around to stare at the blonde as he shielded his ears. Mydeimos, the one that had no idea that that specific word used to refer to a male parent was not to be said thanks to the internet, tilted his head at the wolf’s red face and agape mouth.

“Mydeimos, please never ever called me that” Phainon grabbed his lover’s shoulders with a serious look on his face. As serious as how could be with his red face and wagging tail.

“You sure that you don’t want the little prince to call you that ever again? Or is that word specially reserved for the bed-“

“CIPHER!” Phainon moved his hands to cover Mydeimos’ ears, to protect it from his loud yelling and whatever Cipher was about to say. The cat hybrid had a smug look on her face as she said that she was taking Fig Stew and Pienon out for a walk, wiggling her eyebrows and winking at Phainon.

“Don’t cause any trouble for auntie Cipher alright?”

Woof!

Awoo!

The wolf could only hide his face in his hands as steam coming off of his head while Mydeimos waved at Cipher.

Chapter End Notes

Pls Phainon give me E2S1 I just gave Mydeimos the ability to get preggy

chapters.title: Chapter 17
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Obligatory sick fic

The HQ was very quiet, scarily quiet for a weekend. No Fig Stew wandering around purring and rubbing its head against the crew’s feet. No Pienon following the chimera with a squeaking toy in its mouth chomping down on it as a greeting when it saw anyone. No sound of Phainon’s usual yapping to fill the silence in the air nor the sound of Mydeimos’ occasional humming to show that he was listening to his yapping boyfriend.

Instead of Mydeimos, Tribios and Hyacine were in charge of making food for the day. Cipher and Castorice were the ones patrolling the street outside of the chimera nursery.

The reason for the sudden absence of 2 out of 3 hybrids in the Chyrsos HQ could be traced back to yesterday where Phainon returned from his night stroll completely soaked from head to toe. According to a colleague – a police man that was patrolling in the area the wolf hybrid was enjoying his night walk, a thief had snatched a young lady’s purse and ran away. Phainon chased after the criminal, catching up to him in no time. The thief unaware of Phainon being a wolf hybrid jumped down into the river to escape only to be caught a few moments later as the wolf jumped in after him.

The soaking wet clothes coupled with the night breeze, Phainon was unsurprisingly sick a few hours after that. His sudden rise in temperature woke Mydeimos up because Phainon was panting into his nape. The blonde hybrid then learned a new thing about Phainon when he tried to go get a cooling patch, his wolf boyfriend was super clingy when he was ill, making it impossible to get out of bed.

Fig Stew and Pienon both woke up when Phainon let out a whimper when Mydeimos tried to push his arms away from his waist.

“Mydei… don’t… leave me…” Phainon sobbed into his lover’s chest, bumping and rubbing his hair against Mydeimos.

“Shh… It’s okay. I’m not going anywhere Phainon” The blonde hybrid was taken back with the amount of vulnerability Phainon was showing him. Despite being sick, Phainon somehow still have enough strength to manhandled Mydeimos so that the blonde was sitting up against the wall. The chimera hybrid’s expression softened when Phainon laid his head on his lap. The corner of his lips curled up slightly when the white-haired male grabbed his hand to place it on his head, eyes full of expectancy.

Fig Stew and Pienon to the rescues as Mydeimos sent them out to look for Anaxa, the only person who had a 90% chance to be awake at 3 a.m.

Just like their mama had said, the two found Anaxa – who looked like a deer caught in the headlight when he saw them – slurping on a cup of instant noodles in the kitchen. When the two ran over to paw at his legs, the first thing Anaxa did was put a fork full of noodles on the flat aluminum lid and put it down on the floor for the two animals. The professor figured out that the two weren’t hungry after Pienon ran toward the entrance and sat down, looking into the hallway then at Anaxa.

Mydeimos apologized for bothering the professor when he opened the door to his room. Anaxa just waved his hand dismissively and grabbed the cooling patch inside the bathroom cabinet.

“We have never seen Phainon gotten sick before, he could be a handful from all we know. Rest, Mydeimos. I’ll have Hyacine deliver some medicine when she wakes up.”

---

Saying that Phainon was pampered was an understatement. Never would he have thought that being sick was this enjoyable. Mydeimos was indulging Phainon with every request that he could voice out with his sore throat. He got all the head pats and ear scratches that he wanted, got to cuddle up with Mydeimos tail to enjoy the coolness of the scale against his blazing skin.

Now that Phainon got a closer look at his lover’s tail, he couldn’t help but be mesmerized by how the scale perfectly overlapped each other to form a flexible and durable armor for the flesh underneath. Phainon was positively occupied with groping and feeling up and down Mydeimos’ tail, so much so that he didn’t notice his lover inserting a pill inside the piece of chicken he was about to feed Phainon.

Mydeimos found out the hard way that Phainon doesn’t like taking medicine. The chimera had to coax Phainon to stop kissing and biting at his neck to occupy his mouth so his lover couldn’t get him to swallow his pills. Reinforcement was called and Phainon demanded that Mydeimos let him honka honka his chest as compensation for the traumatic experience of Aglaea holding his dormas pants hostage while Cipher and Castorice held a fancy box with a pair of scissors inside and stand next to the blonde woman.

Of course, Mydeimos wasn’t so cruel to make Phainon swallow the bitter pill when the wolf accidentally chewed down on it. The chimera hybrid told his lover that lunch was ready, and the wolf got up and anchor his chin on Mydeimos’ shoulder from behind. The wolf got flicked on his forehead when he pulled on Mydeimos’ shirt so he could nibble at his boyfriend’s exposed skin. The blonde hybrid fed him a spoonful of chicken noodle soup when Phainon opened his mouth to whine.

Mydeimos put the rest of Phainon’s medicine inside his mouth and took a small sip of water. The moment Phainon took a bite of the piece of chicken, his teeth instantly bit down on the pill. Mydeimos’ mouth was on his before Phainon could spit out the pill, pushing the water and the rest of the pill inside the wolf hybrid’s mouth while rubbing up and down on his throat, causing Phainon to swallow everything down. The wolf didn’t even notice that he had swallowed all his pills, too busy focusing on the way that Mydeimos was sweetly kissing him.

Mydeimos shoved another spoonful of soup into Phainon mouth as he was about to tease him about the blush on the blonde’s face.

Phainon was feeling much better after taking a nap, chalking it up to Mydeimos’ doing for his speedy recovery. The blonde didn’t have the heart to tell him that it was actually because of the medicines. The wolf had a small headache whenever he turned his head too quickly, other than that Phainon had practically recovered from his sickness. But Phainon was enjoying being spoiled by Mydeimos a bit too much, so he draped an arm over his head and dramatically fell back on the bed.

“Mydei… Your adorable and very ill boyfriend wants cuddle…”  That brought a fond chuckle out of Mydeimos as he shook his head at Phainon’s childish behavior. Before the blonde hybrid could sat down on the bed, the door to the room opened revealing Fig Stew standing in the entry way, with a food carrier on its back and an delivery outfit. Seemed like Castorice and Aglaea had a lot of fun with baby sitting the orange chimera today, and vice versa as Fig Stew seemed to really like the small delivery box on its back. The baby trotted over to show Mydeimos its new outfit, even doing a twirl for him.

“Seemed like someone had a lot of fun with their aunties. You must be hungry, let go find your brother then I’ll feed both of you” Mydeimos pressed a bunch of kisses on Fig Stew face and the chimera was soaking up all the attention from his mama, purring and licking Mydeimos face. The blonde felt a tug at his shirt. When he turned to look at Phainon, the wolf was giving him sad puppy dog eyes, pouting while pointing at his face. He was a bit disappointed when Mydeimos just hold Fig Stew closer to his face and the orange chimera gave him a lick, one single lick. Phainon was now both disappointed because Mydeimos didn’t kiss him and offended that Fig Stew only gave him a smidgen of the affection that it gave Mydeimos.

Pienon excitedly ran into the room just before Mydeimos went and looked for him. The puppy jumped into Phainon arms and happily greeted him with a few licks before turning his attention to Mydeimos.

“My baby boy, you looked fabulous!” Phainon picked the samoyed up to take a better look at his puppy son. Judging by the dormas puppy onesie, Pienon’s babysitter was Anaxa. Seemed like everyone wanted to play dress-up with the phaidei children.

Chapter End Notes

I was thinking about Mydei taking care of sick Phainon, then I remember I have hands and free will.

chapters.title: Chapter 18
chapters.html:
Mydeimos attracted a lot of attention whenever he went out, that was a very well-known fact among the people in the police station and the Chrysos team. That was why other than patrolling, he tried to stay away from crowded places like the supermarket or the city center. If he was going to those places, one of the team members would accompany him – said person more often than not was Phainon. The wolf did not skim when it came to showing his affection towards Mydeimos and it helped with the unwanted attention a lot as people turned away from their PDAs. The hand that attached itself to Mydeimos’ waist was enough to tell people that the blonde-haired beauty was taken by an equally handsome wolf hybrid.
The current impromptu trip to the supermarket was missing a white-haired man sticking to Mydeimos like glue. Replacing Phainon was the two critters that he and Mydeimos adopted, small but a force to be reckon with if you tried to touch their mama.
Earlier that morning Mydeimos was assembling Pienon’s breakfast, the Samoyed was on a raw diet because he’s Mydeimos’ spoiled little boy. Since Pienon was so spoiled by the blonde hybrid, half on his breakfast was already in his stomach when Mydeimos was done with his food bowl. Just like how the chimera hybrid let his lover sneak tiny bite of his dinner before it was served, Pienon got a small piece of whatever meat was in his breakfast whenever the Samoyed pawed or tapped it nose against Mydeimos’ leg. While cutting up the beef for the puppy, Mydeimos was suddenly reminded about Phainon’s first ever attempt to court him. He smiled fondly at the memory of Phainon shyly giving him a plate of raw ribeye steak, the wolf was so cute back then that Mydeimos couldn’t say no to him.
“You’re just as bad as Phainon with sneaking bites at your food. Here you go, enjoyed your breakfast.” Mydeimos fondly watched Pienon woofed down his food, jokingly said the Samoyed was going to turn into a marshmallow if he kept inhaling his food like that.
As if on cue, after Pienon finished his breakfast, Phainon walked in the kitchen with Fig Stew in his arms. Mydeimos walked over and gave Phainon a good morning kiss then took Fig Stew from his arms. He set the chimera down next to Pienon, the orange critter went to check out the puppy’s food bowl, eating the small chunk of meat patty the Samoyed left for him.
Mydeimos handed Phainon his plate of eggs on toast with a side of bacon and a cup of smoothie. The blonde pressed other kiss on Phainon’s face when the wolf nibbled on the toast with his eyes closed, clearly still wanted to sleep in more but couldn’t because there was no Mydeimos for him to cuddle. Fig Stew happily dug into his bowl of chimera food (that Mydeimos bought from the nursery on his patrol route) topped with fruits and vegetables.
Mydeimos waved goodbye to Castorice and Hyacine as the two walked by the kitchen to go to the station. He sent Phainon on his way to work after brushing out his tail and fixed his bed head. The blonde changed his clothes and took Fig Stew and Pienon with him on the impromptu trip to the supermarket. Pienon was understandably upset that he wasn’t allowed to enter the place, while Fig Stew was allowed to be inside as long as he stayed inside the cart. Because of how sad his baby was, Mydeimos decided to change his plan and looked for a butcher shop on his teleslate.
“Welcome!” The lady behind the counter cheerfully greeted him, squealing at the sight of a chimera inside her shop. Her sudden high-pitched squeal spooked both of the animals, Pienon ran to hide between Mydeimos’ legs while Fig Stew hugged his leg with its front paws. The lady looked a bit crestfallen at their reaction, apologizing for scaring them. The blonde hybrid ushered his two babies to say hi to the lady, the two critters immediately warmed up to the shopkeeper when she gave them some of the meat scraps.
The butcher lady was surprised, as Mydeimos had expected, when he asked her if he could buy that slap of A5 Wagyu beef she had on display. She was suspicious at first, but all of her hesitation vanished the moment her eyes landed on the platinum card in Mydeimos’ hand. The moment the purchase was made, the shop door opened, and two men dressed in black suits entered and took the box containing the 2 kg. of A5 wagyu ribeye. The blonde hybrid waited inside the shop for a few minutes after the car left to avoid more unwanted attention. The shop lady stared at his retreating back in awe and disbelief at what had just happened.
Mydeimos took Pienon and Fig Stew to see Phainon working and typing away at reports after reports at the police station. The wolf, whose eyes were lifeless due to boredom immediately lit up when he saw his boyfriend, running over to recharge his battery with hugs and head scratches. Their co-workers had to shield their eyes from the blinding light from Phainon’s bright smile. Mydeimos’ presence also brightened the gloomy atmosphere in the office because he came by with food.
A few co-workers couldn’t help but sneakily follow the two hybrids when Phainon tried to sneak Mydeimos away to the very rarely used smoke break room. They saw one of the best dreams one could have when it came to affection: sneaking away to some hidden corner to trade kisses with your lover. Phainon hands were holding onto Mydeimos’ cinched waist while the blonde slightly tilted his head up to meet Phainon’s lips, his arms wrapped around the wolf hybrid’s neck. The sight was so tooth-rotting-ly sweet that the co-workers all sneaked back to the office with a slight blush on their faces.
“I think I’ll begin to wear higher flatform shoes, so you’ll have to tilt your face up for a kiss. You reckon I could find one high enough that you’ll have to stand on your tiptoe to kiss me, cutie pie~” Phainon had to thank Aglaea for his new shoe, seeing his Mydeimos raising his head slightly to talk to him scratch a itch in his mind that Phainon didn’t even know he had.
Distracting the blonde hybrid with smooches, Phainon silently checked to see if any of their co-worker were still spying on them. When he was sure the sound of fading footsteps was gone, his advances began getting a little bit bolder. His hands moved downwards to rub at the base of Mydeimos’ tail, causing him to begin purring and nuzzling against Phainon’s neck. Who needs therapy if you have your lover purring in your arms, sending soft vibrations through your chest? Whatever fatigue and stress those reports were giving Phainon was gone in a matter of seconds. The wolf was hit with a charge of energy boost when Mydeimos raise his head slightly, slightly jutting out his lips with his eyes closed.
Titans above, who taught him this? He’s gonna be the death of me, Phainon yelled internally. Externally, his tail was wagging so hard that Mydeimos was afraid Phainon was going to dislocate it one day. The blonde hybrid was going to head back to the HQ after this kiss, so Phainon had to make it count. No one questioned Phainon about the sound of something crashing against the wall nor did they question why Mydeimos looked so out of breath while the wolf was smiling like he just won the lottery.
Of course, Phainon had to let his co-worker suffer through one more act of couple PDAs. When the wolf saw the familiar limousine and Krateros stepping out to open the door, Phainon swept Mydeimos up in his arms – princess style, and carried him to his car. With Pienon and Fig Stew walking on either side of him, all that was missing was some flower petals floating in the air to make a perfect wedding. Krateros let out a amused huff, happy that his young master found his equal.
Later that day, everyone in the Chrysos team was treated to a lavish and exquisite steak dinner. The wagyu was cooked to a perfect medium rare, the meat was so tender that it seemed to melt in your mouth. Upon chewing it, the tastebuds were treated with the buttery and juiciness of the meat. Tribios and Aglaea really enjoyed the red wine jus while Castorice and Hyacine couldn’t get enough of the smooth and cheesy smashed potatoes. Anaxa was served loaf of sourdough to accompany the classic dip of balsamic vinegar instead of smashed potatoes. Mydeimos accidentally caught the professor with a cup of instant noddle too often to give him the potatoes as his side dish. Cipher also requested bread as her side dish, so the hybrid served hers with smoked king salmon as topping.
While everyone was enjoying their dinner, Phainon got was given the chance to indulge in his carnivore side. Mydeimos got him two raw tomahawk steaks, so the wolf could gnaw on the giant bone after tearing the meat apart with his fangs. By the time Phainon had finished his indulgent dinner, everyone had moved onto the dessert. A cup of fruit sorbet was a perfect palette cleaner after such a flavorful steak dinner. Phainon, having the benefit of being Mydeimos’ favorite person, was given a cup of fruit parfait and got to get spoon-fed the entire dessert by Mydeimos himself.
Phainon ascended to heaven when his beautiful and talented lover invited him for a bath together. The wolf smelled like strawberry and pomegranate afterward.
“Did something good happened today? Normally you wouldn’t spoil me this much” Phainon asked while they were cuddling in bed, with him burying his face in Mydeimos’ chest.
“To cheer you up”
“From wha-… O-oh” Phainon caught on to what the blonde was talking about. It seemed like Mydeimos found out about his reoccurring nightmare.
“Just wake me up next time, alright? You don’t have to tell me about it. I just wanted to give you a safe space and an open arm to cry in. You don’t have to quietly leave the bed to go cry in the bathroom” Mydeimos pressed a tender kiss on Phainon’s hair, hugging the wolf tighter. They lay in each other’s embrace, enjoying the comfortable silence between them. After a while, Phainon finally spoke up.
“My reoccurring nightmares stopped after I found you in that lab. Then it returned after you left. It hadn’t happened for a long time now after we became a thing. I caught me off-guard when I dreamt of it again yesterday.
It all began with a string of number, ticking up by one each dream… I dreamed that I was the savior, the hero, the deliverer of the world. Yet, I failed to save my comrades, failed to protect those that were close to me. Each dream was slightly different, but they all lead toward the same ending no matter what I’ve done…” Mydeimos reached down to tilt Phainon’s head up to press a kiss on those trembling lips, his tail moved to wrap around the wolf’s leg for an extra comforting touch. The chimera hybrid licked at the tuff of fur on Phainon’s ears, calming the wolf down by grooming his ears.
“One of my comrades in these nightmares resembled you so much that I pained me how many times I’ve failed to protect him, failed to protect his back and his weak spot… Everyone all told me to become the shining sun, to lead them to the new word… I know it’s stupid how affected I am over these nightmares, but they felt so scarily real, like I was living my previous life…”
“Shh, it’s okay Phainon. I know I can’t make those nightmares disappear, but please know that I’ll always be here for you. Everyone is here for you, so you don’t have to carry the burden you have in those dreams. All of the suffering you felt in those dream, I’ll made sure to burn them all away with my affections for you”

Chapter End Notes

Fun fact, I wrote like 3/4 of the chapter before stopping to prepare for a small artist alley convention the next day. While I was enjoying my time browsing and purchasing phaidei goods, I got hit with the depression beam when I opened twitter lmao.
DW, I got my whimsical self back after a good lunch lol.
My Artist Day's haul

chapters.title: Chapter 19
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Inspired by Phainon's anan magazine

It was late evening when Cipher got woken up by her stomach protesting.

The girl got back a few hours after everyone had their dinner, so all she had eaten was a simple tuna sandwich. Mydeimos had offered to make her more food but Cipher just waved her hand dismissively as she bit into the sandwich that was supposed to be her lunch. Alas she couldn’t refuse that sad kitten face and agreed to let Mydeimos make her a big breakfast the next day.

While Cipher was raiding the pantry for some filling snack to satiate her stomach till morning, the cat hybrid heard some heavy footsteps from the corridor. At first the girl thought it was just Anaxa doing his thing, then she realized that the human professor did not possess light reflecting eyes. The girl almost strangled the owner of those eyes when she saw a familiar head of blonde hair with red ombre anchoring on the other’s shoulder.

It was Phainon, piggybacking Mydeimos with one arm while the other was holding a small basket of bathing essentials. Cipher was about to smack the man that was kidnapping her (sworn) younger brother but stopped her claws when she saw Mydeimos’ tail wrapped securely around one of Phainon’s legs. The chimera hybrid was letting Phainon do whatever he wanted.

“Oh. Good evening, Cipher! I thought professor Anaxa was in the kitchen eating his secret stash of instant noodles” Phainon explained why he was walking around in the dark. With the wolf talking right next to his ears, Mydeimos stirred awake stretching his arms past Phainon’s head almost hitting Cipher in the process. The cat hybrid stared in awe as Phainon didn’t even lose balance or struggle when Mydeimos pressed his chest into Phainon’s back so he could arch his back, grumbling and whining about being woken up. He fell back asleep after pressing a few messy kisses and licking Phainon’s face.

“He used to bite my cheek when I accidentally woke him up while taking him with me for a bath, the licking was to apologize for the bite. He switched to kisses a few days prior and the licking stayed for some reason” Phainon explained while looking like the happiest man on the planet with a wet spot on his cheek.

“Dragging Mydeimos to the bath at 11 P.M, it’s a miracle that he hasn’t punch you, Phainon” Another voice joined their conversation, both hybrids smelled the aromas of tom yum instant noodles in the air. It was Anaxa, with his cup of instant noodles. The mint-haired man handed Cipher the pipping hot cup when her stomach protested again. She thanked Anaxa for the food and carefully blowing on the noodle strands then happily eating it. Phainon was about to say something when Mydeimos started grumbling again.

“Sorry princess, I’ll get going now. You’re so fussy when you’re sleepy” Phainon whispered to the chimera hybrid, kissing his temple and turned to Anaxa and Cipher. “He so adorable, isn’t he? I think I’ll use the hot tub today” Phainon mumbled the latter part to himself than carried his lover to the bath.

“I thought they bathe together after dinner every day. Had something happen while I was busy?” Cipher asked Anaxa, who was making himself another cup of noodles.

“Nope. Nothing happened during mealtimes. Phainon began dragging Mydeimos for a second bath a few days after the blonde agreed to bath with him”

“Oh, darn it, here I thought they were getting Fig Stew and Pienon a new sibling”

---

Mydeimos was preparing a lavish breakfast for Cipher when Phainon strolled into the kitchen with his teleslate in his hand. He showed him a video of what he could assume was a new trend among couples with pets, each person running one direction to see which one the pet would follow. Phainon suggested that they recorded one like that with Fig Stew for the critter’s social media account. Castorice, who was helping Mydeimos with his cooking, let out a chuckle at Phainon’s suggestion

“I don’t mean to offend, Phainon. Fig Stew had shown us multiple times that he had a favorite person” and that person isn’t you was left unsaid, and Phainon could hear those unspoken words as clear as day when Fig Stew and Pienon walked into the kitchen. They both made a beeline toward Mydeimos when he crouched down with opened arms. The blonde threw a smirk at Phainon as Fig Stew climbed up into his arms.

“Still want to make that video, papa Phainon?” Phainon was left speechless after that critical strike from Mydeimos.

Phainon still asked his lover to record the video with him, only showing their legs in the final edit. Just like Castorice and anyone who had seen Fig Stew interact with Phainon, while the pets in the video posted online took a few seconds to choose, Fig Stew didn’t even glance at Phainon’s direction and immediately followed Mydeimos when the blonde moved his foot. Mydeimos had assured his sulking lover that Fig Stew liked him a lot, recalling those times when the critter brough Phainon the apples that it managed to steal from Aglaea’s tree. The blonde tried to cheer him up by telling him that Pienon would run after him if they tried the trend with the large puppy.

“If it makes you feel any better, Fig Stew started calling you papa a few days after you started bottle feed him” Phainon narrowed his eyes at the blonde hybrid, clearly not buying it. Mydeimos let out a huff of amusement and truffled Phainon’s head. The chimera hybrid then asked him to head over to Aglaea orchid and wait for the blonde to prove that what he said was true. After Phainon walked over to the gate, he could still see Mydeimos and Fig Stew, the blonde began recording the orange chimera. Phainon saw Mydeimos say something to the small critter, and it began looking around until it spotted him, jumping up and down when it saw the wolf. Fig Stew ran over to him on its short legs, rubbing its head on Phainon’s legs and making a lot of cute sounds.

Phainon covered his agape mouth like a maiden in the past, when Mydeimos showed him the video. His ears picked up on every word that his lover said to Fig Stew.

“Fig Stew, baby. Go find papa!” Phainon could see the critter face lit up as it started looking around then running over to him in the video.

The Fig_Stew account uploaded three videos later that night. The first one was about the new pet parent trend with Fig Stew following Mydeimos the moment the hybrid turned his heel. The second was them doing the same trend but tittle: How to get Fig Stew to follow you, where the moment Mydeimos finished counting down Phainon immediately lifted him up bridal style and ran across the camera multiple times with Fig Stew running after them, and Pienon following a few seconds later. The third one was to show their followers that Fig Stew had a papa.

The internet fame of the pair of handsome policemen patrolling near a chimera nursery just died down a few weeks ago was ignited again after people saw those three videos. All of which showed Phainon and Mydeimos’ face very clearly, the people would have recognized them anyway with a short glance at Mydeimos’ orange tail. Phainon turned on private mode for the account for the second times.

chapters.title: Chapter 20
chapters.html:
It was supposed to be a simple stealth mission. Stayed hidden in the location that Anaxa had pinpointed to be one of the places that a wanted criminal could carry out a drug deal that night. Mydeimos was the stealthier one between them, so he had managed to slip right through the guards while Phainon kept his eyes on his lover’s blind spots. The sound of their walkie talkie switching on and off signified that he had found the criminal in the abandoned warehouse. Right on time Cipher and Hyacine arrived at the place.

Following Tribios’ instructions, Cipher made her way to Mydeimos with ease. They switched, Cipher keeping her eyes on the criminal while Mydeimos sneaked his way out to take care of the guards. Two guards were injected with Anaxa’s sedatives, one was knocked out by a quick chop on his nape. Three were lured away from their spot and quickly dispatched, one did try to scream but his mouth was blocked thanks to Mydeimos’ tail coiling around his face. Phainon made a growling sound when he saw a bloody spot from when the guard bit down on his lover’s tail. 

When the number of guards had thinned out significantly, Phainon and Hyacine made their way to the warehouse to rendezvous with Mydeimos. The pink haired girl immediately disinfected and bandaged the wound on the chimera hybrid’s tail. She didn’t want it to get infected and doing it helped Phainon focus more on the mission.

Cipher sent a signal through her earpiece, telling the team that there was a hatch in a hidden corner of the warehouse, behind the many wooden boxes and pallets. The sound of the hatch opening was noticeable, even Hyacine could hear it. Everyone was on high alert, preparing to storm in and detained the criminal. Upon Cipher’s signal, Phainon tore a hole through the rusty metal wall of the warehouse. The criminal turned his attention to the sound immediately, pointing his weapon at the wolf hybrid. All of the criminal’s muscles suddenly seized up, making him fall on the ground.

Before Cipher could reach the paralyzed man, the light in the warehouse turned on, flashing the color red. Combat mechs broke out from the wooden boxes and started attaching them. Phainon jumped into action, lunging at a mech that was charging toward Hyacine, his claw dug into the mech torso ripping out the circuitry. Mydeimos coiled his tail around one of the mech’s arms, throwing it toward another robot that was overwhelming Cipher.

The noises from the combat mechs drowned out the sound of footsteps charging toward them. Phainon only realized there was a gun pointed at him when he heard the sound of it firing. Instead of pain all Phainon felt was a body slamming into him then a pained sound from the one person that he swore he would not let such a noise leave those beautiful lips. Mydeimos saw the guard out of the corner of his eyes and bolted towards Phainon, pushing him out of the bullet way. The bullet hit Mydeimos’ tail instead of Phainon’s body. Hyacine quickly took out the guard before Phainon could tear him to shreds.

The wolf was too focused on Mydeimos, who was breathing heavily because of the pain to realize the mech he was fighting had got up. Cipher couldn’t reach it in time and when Phainon noticed it, it was too late. The mech clamed its mechanical arm on Mydeimos’ injured tail, lifting him off the ground and out of Phainon’s arms. People say you shouldn’t take candy from a kid, and the entire Chrysos team said you shouldn't take Mydeimos away from Phainon. The mechanical arm was severed in less than a second, letting Mydeimos fall into Phainon arms.

“Phai- Phainon. Help me take the arm off my tail. Kremnos’ battle mech can still use their parts if the main circuit isn’t-“Mydeimos couldn’t finish his sentence as searing pain ran up his body. The severed mech arm had tightened its grip on his tail, digging into the bullet wound. All Phainon saw was red when his ears picked up on the tiniest sound of cracking as his lover passed out from pain. Both of the girls were frozen in shock as they watched Phainon destroy one mechs after another. The wolf’s eyes were filled with fury, he was baring his fangs and growling as he stalked towards the criminal still lying on the ground.

The criminal would have turned into minced meat if Hyacine hadn’t shot Phainon with a sedative shot.

“Where is he?” The door to the infirmary was almost tore off its hinges because of Phainon strength. Anaxa only raised an eyebrow at him then pointed at the bed in the far corner of the room. As Phainon ran over to where Mydeimos was, the green haired professor noted down that his sedative wasn’t as effective on Phainon compared to others. Normally people and hybrids will be knocked out of a day with the amount Hyacine had shot the wolf with, yet here Phainon was 3 hours after the initial injection, knelling next to Mydeimos’ bed while holding the blonde’s hand.

A single glance at how Phainon was nuzzling into Mydeimos hand could tell what the wolf was thinking about. Or rather, being reminded about. Anaxa was sitting in the opposite side of the room, and he could feel the gloomy aura of guilt pouring from Phainon. Being the person that witnessed the incident, Anaxa couldn’t blame his student for feeling that way. The bandage on Mydeimos’ tail was extremely close to the place where a certain wound was inflicted on him when Mydeimos first came to the Chrysos Heir’s custody.

“Phainon?” Mydeimos woke up a little later. Phainon nuzzling and kissing his palm brought Mydeimos out of his slumber. The chimera hybrid was used waking up from Phainon nuzzlings because of his nightmares.  If this was a normal hospital, the wolf hybrid would be kicked out of the room the moment he climbed on a patient’s bed, one that had just woken up too. Anaxa only shook his head at the way Phainon was ugly sobbing into Mydeimos’ chest mumbling out a bunch of muffled nonsensical sounds. The blonde hybrid was stunned and confused about Phainon behavior till he saw that his tail was bandaged up, and the lower part was put in a cast. Mydeimos turned his attention to the wet blob of white fur on his chest, all he could think of then was giving Phainon head pats to calm him down.

“How long do you think it would take to heal a broken bone?” Anaxa asked the chimera hybrid after Phainon was done using his lover as a tissue. The mint-haired man tried his best to ignore his student inappropriate behavior. Phainon had slipped his head under Mydeimos’ shirt to “feel his boyfriend heartbeat better”, one would easily believe that innocent excuse if not for the way his hand was moving in a circular motion where Mydeimos’ chest was.

“Two or three days? My leg healed in two when I was staying in Castrum Kremnos with Krateros. My leg broke when I fell down a tree.” That was when he learned about his fast reptilian regeneration.

Both Phainon and Mydeimos gave Fig Stew and Pienon a heart attack when they returned from their mission. Phainon was covered in small bandages from the cuts he got when he singlehandedly destroyed all those combat mechs. The babies thought their mama was fine until they looked at his tail.

“Oh my little Fig Stew, don’t cry. Mama is fine. You’re a big boy now, baby. Phainon is going to laugh at you” Mydeimos crouched down to pet the chimera’s head

“HEY! Don’t put that evil on ME!”

Chapter End Notes

Kudos to you if you read through 20 chapters ⸜(｡˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝♡
If you saw that twitter post u know what to expect next.

chapters.title: Chapter 21
chapters.html:
For someone who was ugly crying when he saw Mydeimos’ wounded tail, Phainon was positively glowing the next day. The wolf had taken upon himself that he would take care of his lover until his tail had healed completely.

How did he manage to get a few days off to stay with Mydeimos? You may ask. The answer is simple. Phainon had made quite a reputation for himself at the police station that he couldn’t function normally without Mydeimos being in the area. His co-worker and chief had involuntarily observed how Phainon had sped through writing and organizing the team’s report after Mydeimos said he wanted to eat lunch together. The lifeless husk of I-don’t-like-sitting-in-an-office-to-do-paperwork-Phainon was reinvigorated, when through the process of metamorphosis to emerge as a hyperactive puppy wolf after his lover gave him a kiss.

Phainon woke up earlier that morning and carefully untangled himself from Mydeimos’ legs and arms. The wolf sneaked out of their shared room with his toothbrush and hygiene stuffs because Mydeimos would most likely wake up if he heard the sound of rushing water in the bathroom. After washing up and brushing his teeth, Phainon made his way toward the kitchen and rolled up his non-existent sleeve on his short sleeve shirt to prepare breakfast for his beautiful darling angel boyfriend.

Phainon had never cooked salmon before, but his boyfriend seemed to like them, so he was going to try his best to make it. The wolf took out the supermarket salmon in the fridge and set it inside a baking dish with some lemon slices, dill, those sprouts - that according to Tribios, tasted bad because of his genes? and white wine. The white-haired hybrid stared at the bottle of white wine for a few seconds wondering if using alcohol for breakfast was a good idea. He decided that he didn’t have the right knowledge or skills to alter how Mydeimos made the dish, so he just stuck with doing what he remembered. Phainon got everything down perfectly thanks to his good memories and way too much time spent staring at Mydeimos in his apron.

While waiting for the salmon to be cooked, Phainon decided to make his HQ-famous sweet potato hashbrowns. As he was peeling the sweet potatoes, Phainon got a taste of his own medicine. Mydeimos had sneaked up on him and wrapped his arms around the wolf’s torso, clinging on Phainon like how the man had done in the past. The wolf dropped the peeler in his hand when Mydeimos decided to be more handsy, slipping his hands under the shirt to grope and feel Phainon’s tone stomach.

“Hmm~ Nice abs, Phainon~” One could cook an egg on Phainon’s face thanks to how red it was. Mydeimos’ sexy morning voice thirsting over his abs was not something Phainon had on his bingo card. The chimera hybrid was carried out of the kitchen and gently set down on a beanbag by a very flustered Phainon. Mydeimos was enjoying himself, the smug look on his face after “accidently” slipped his pinkie under the waistband of Phainon’s pant said it all. Despite the scowl on Phainon's face after the inappropriate act from Mydeimos, the wolf still leaned down to kiss his lover’s lips then a smooch on the cast on his tail. The chimera made grabby hands at Phainon, looking at his lover’s shirt then his face.

The Chrysos team saved a few cups of coffee that day.
