Castorice and Hyacine were so shocked that they forgot they were sleepy. Mydeimos had to give Cipher his seat on the bean bag as the cat hybrid laughed so hard that she got a stomachache. Anaxa walked in the kitchen with his eyes half open, he probably stayed up late last night, looked at Phainon then walked out of the kitchen while mumbling that it was too early for that.

“Oh my… Cute apron, Phai-chan! I’m guessing lack of shirt was on Mos-chan’s request?” Tribios tried to hide her laughter behind her hand.

Phainon was unable to resist the charm of those golden eyes looking up at him so lovingly. It didn’t help that his brain conjured up a dreamy pink background with roses floating around Mydeimos face. Just a simple use of the pet name “honeycake” from Mydeimos, Phainon took off his shirt and put on the pink frilly apron in record speed.

“Mydei, I don’t mean to insult your lover but…” Cipher leaned over to whisper to the chimera hybrid

“Yeah, I know. His butt is a bit lacking for a half-naked apron” Not that Mydeimos minded Phainon’s lack of cake, his eyes were already having a feast with the wolf’s muscle and abs on display like that. Cipher headed out to the police station like the rest of the team after her stomachache died down. Mydeimos was about to ask about his adopted children when he received a text from Hyacine saying that she had taken Fig Stew with her to the Garden of Life for the bi-annual chimera heath check-up. She also told him not to worry about the orange chimera’s breakfast; Fig Stew could eat the supplement bar that the Garden gave out during the check-up. The pink haired girl explained that the bar had a lot of minerals and vitamins, the main reason for giving those out was the de-worming tablet mixed into the food bar.

With Fig Stew out for health check-up for the day, Pienon received Mydeimos’ undivided attention just like how it was back in Castrum Kremnos. Pienon is a smart boy, carefully climbing on Mydeimos’ lap while being mindful of the chimera’s injured tail. The samyoed only got to enjoy the head scratches from his mama for a few minutes when the puppy was ushered off his lap by Phainon.

Phainon, no longer wearing a pink apron, lifted Mydeimos up with ease and carried him to the dining table. The blonde was salivating, both at Phainon’s shirtless form and the delicious looking meal on the table. He looked at his lover, asking to be let down so he could eat his breakfast. Phainon chuckled mischievously at that, sitting down on the chair with Mydeimos now sitting sideway on his lap. After making sure the broken tail was comfortably set down on the chair behind the blonde, Phainon grabbed the fork, broke off a piece of perfectly cooked salmon and fed the blonde that was looking at him like a love-struck maiden. The heart eyes were doing bad things to Phainon’s heart, and the loud purring when Mydeimos nuzzled into his neck did not help with the situation.

“Mydei, baby. You’re killing me with your cuteness”

“I’m… not cute” Mydeimos looked away from the wolf, puffing up his check while denying the other’s statement. When he glanced back to check Phainon’s expression, his hand reached out to grab the tissue box

“Phainon! Your nose is bleeding!”

After the couple and Pienon’s breakfast, Phainon took his lover outside to bask in the sunlight. The wolf set his lover down on the lush grass patch under a big oak tree a few minute walk from outside the HQ. The sunlight filtering through the leave canopy, shining rays of light through the dense layers of leaves, creating a tranquil atmosphere. A perfect atmosphere for reading a book or watching your lover played tag with your Samoyed puppy. Mydeimos was a few dozen pages into his current book when he looked up to see Phainon and Pienon rolling around in the grass, resulting in specks of green dotting their hair/fur.

The blonde received another text from Hyacine. The girl sent him a video of Fig Stew making friends and playing with a grey chimera with asymmetrical horns on its head. The two chimeras seemed to really hit it off as Hyacine sent another video of them curling up and cuddling in a cat bed.

“Isn’t Fig Stew a little young to be having a boyfriend?” Phai-there-is-no-word-for-personal-space-in-the-Aedes-Elysiae-language-non asked with the tone of a disapproving dad.

“Fig Stew is 2 years old now. He’s a fully grown chimera now, according to the Garden of Life. He could play with any chimera that he wants”

“Fully grown chimera, yet he still cries and clings to you like a baby would”

“Sounds like a certain wolf hybrid that I know” Mydeimos said, kissing the side of Phainon’s jaw.

“I like to call it boyfriend privilege” The wolf replied, leaning down to show his lover a real kiss, leaving Mydeimos lying breathlessly on the grass after. Pienon, the puppy in shining armor, came to his mama rescue, tackling Phainon aside before the wolf could steal another kiss.

Lunchtime brought Mydeimos quite a few pleasant surprises. One, he was allowed to walk on his own feet without Phainon swooping in and flexing all those muscles to carry him bridal style. Two, Tribios came back with a cake box from his favorite bakery. Three, Fig Stew returned home from his health check-up with the chimera he was playing with earlier.

Phainon picked both Fig Stew and his chimera friend, Vigethos, up and sat them down in the lounge area. Hyacine watched in amusement while Mydeimos face-palmed at the sight of his boyfriend giving the gray chimera “the dad talk”. Keep in mind that Phainon doesn’t speak Chimera, so all that was happening was Phainon asking questions and only receiving an awoo from Vigethos. Thankfully, Hyacine clarified that Vigethos wasn’t staying here with them, he’s just visiting. Phainon let out a sign of relief knowing that he won’t have to fight three critters for his Mydeimos’ attention. He found Mydeimos first, get in line!

At least Pienon got along well with Vigethos.

Despite knowing that the gray chimera won’t be living with them, Phainon still gave him the stink eyes when Mydeimos gave him his lunch. Judging by how Vigethos eyes lit up when he took the first bite, the chimera is going to be visiting quite often. It did make him wonder what the hell the Garden of Life was giving these chimeras.

Phainon was unfortunately tasked with his job of looking after the two chimeras and Pienon, a job he begrudgingly took because he wanted Mydeimos to enjoy his dessert without three critters bumping and pawing at his legs for food. No, Phainon wasn’t salty at the fact none came to him while he also had the same thing on his plate.

After a round of rolling around in the dirt and subjecting both Fig Stew and Vigethos to what the orange chimera called “the wrath of Poseidon”, Phainon learnt about Fig Stew’s name for wet bath time from his beautiful lover, Phainon returned to the lounge with all three critters squeaky clean and smelling like pomegranate. The fruity scent from the shampoo was the only reason Fig Stew tolerated being imprisoned in the bathtub (the side was too slippery for his short legs to climb out of)

“Aww my poor Fig Stew~ Did meanie papa make you take a bath again? I know I know. Bad Phainon. But you smell like mama’s favorite fruit now, I’m going to eat you up!” Phainon watched in awe as Mydeimos pulled out the baby talk voice and blew raspberry into the “fully grown” chimera’s stomach. The irony would be delivered better if Phainon wasn’t doing the same thing to Pienon a few seconds earlier. Mydeimos saw Vigethos sitting alone sadly looking at them from the corner of his eyes while kissing and cooing at Fig Stew. The gray chimera didn’t realize that the blonde hybrid could understand his quite chimera noises until he was picked up and showered with licks and kisses from Fig Stew and Mydeimos.

“Be good to my Fig Stew alright, Vigethos? Or else… I’m going to tell Hyacine to ban you from coming over, understood?” Even though that threatening smile wasn’t directed at them, Phainon and Pienon still felt a chill down their spine. The brave chimera faced that murderous smile head-on and made a few noises at Mydeimos, who’s seemed very pleased after hearing it.

Vigethos was warmly welcomed into the critters napping pile, curling up next to Fig Stew on top of Pienon’s fluffy fur. Phainon, a man on a mission of taking care of his lover, let Mydeimos used him as a pillow for his short nap. The blonde let out comforting purrs while lying on Phainon’s sturdy chest and Phainon almost got another nosebleed. Sadly, Hyacine had to return Vigethos to the Garden of Life as it was nearing the end of chimera working hour, all chimeras on duty had to report back at 2 P.M. so the managers could record their workload before the end of human working hours.

Thanks to Krateros’ help, Phainon was able to get the ingredients for his favorite meal during childhood: Honey Suncake, with smoke venison and olive juice. The wolf was excited and curious to see Mydeimos’ reaction to trying venison for the first time. The wolf watched in anticipation as his lover took a bite of the smoked red meat, the small uplift in the corner of the lips told Phainon that the blonde liked it. Phainon was all smile during the entirety of dinner, enthusiastically feeding Mydeimos cuts of smoke venison and pieces of honey suncake.

[A/N: I pray to God that the “olive juice” in the HSR universe is extra virgin olive oil. Or else I’m questioning Phainon’s taste in food if he eats his smoke venison and suncake with olive brine]

After everyone finished their dinner, to no one’s surprise, Phainon loving swept Mydeimos away to the bath.

chapters.title: Chapter 22
chapters.html:
Anaxa woke up and decided to head out to the garden for some needed sunlight and vitamin D. On his way, he saw three of the girls out in the open area of the flower section: Castorice, Hyacine and Cipher all focused on fussing over something, brushes were scattered around them. Upon getting closer, he saw what they were doing, and he had to do a double take. Pienon was lying comfortably in the middle of the three, while next to him was another pile of white fur the same size as the Samoyed. Anaxa thought the two lovebirds in the Chrysos team got another kid, he let out a sigh of relief when he saw it was just Pienon’s fur.

Pienon started shedding like crazy when autumn came, and Phainon being the possessive wolf that he was, was not happy with his own adopted son’s fur sticking all over Mydeimos’ clothes. The white-haired male went to ask Hyacine about what type of brushes should he get to brush out Pienon’s coat. The girl’s eyes lit up at his question and excitedly asked him to let her brush the Samoyed.

Anaxa came back after photosynthesis with his people (the mint plants that Mydeimos planted for Fig Stew) and had to stop to stare at the shenanigans in front of his eye. Pienon was napping at 7 in the morning with his belly up, and the birds were flocking around the fluff generating puppy to pick at the loose fur for their nests. A perfect plan made by his own students. Brushing Pienon in the garden so his fur wouldn’t fly around the HQ interior, collecting the fur for Castotice needle felting projects or weave into yarns for Pienon’s future winter outfits. After they were done collecting the loose fur, the tuff that scattered around the area was cleaned up by birds.

“There you are professor Anaxa. Mydeimos baked a loaf of sourdough bread if you want to have them for breakfast”

“That’s Anaxago- wait sourdough bread?” Phainon tried not to laugh at the way his professor stopped midway through correcting him because he heard the word sourdough bread. The wolf nodded at Anaxa’s question while pointing at the slice that he was munching on. It seemed like Anaxa had judged the quality of the slice Phainon was snacking on was up to his standard because the professor power walked toward the kitchen mumbling something about Aglaea and Cipher eating his portion.

Phainon almost spit out the piece of bread in his mouth when he saw Pienon.

“Oh boy… Mydei is going to love this!” The man said as he snapped a picture of the puppy sprawling on the grass. Phainon was too focus on taking pictures to realize his lover was behind him, holding a de-shedding brush in his hand, watching with the wolf with a light frown on his face as he saw a piece of fur flew out from the wagging tail.

Phainon soon joined Pienon in the grass, sitting with his tail in Mydeimos’ lap while Pienon was lying on his and getting petted. His tail didn’t take as long as Pienon to be brushed out, only a few minutes before Mydeimos strayed something on the fur and started fluffing it up and hugging it. The two hybrids didn’t need to look at a clock to know it was 8 o’clock thanks to Pienon. The puppy started barking, demanding his breakfast at exactly this time in the morning. It seemed like the puppy’s barking was heard by the other child in the family as Fig Stew ran toward them a few minutes later.

Mydeimos was surprised to see the chimera since the critter was supposed to go with Hyacine to re-register him on the Garden’s data bank, so Fig Stew now worked for the Okhema’s police force. The orange cutie pie kept bumping its head against the brush, pushing it toward Mydeimos. It seemed like someone felt a bit left out with all the brushing this morning. Phainon gave his lover an unimpressed look as Mydeimos picked his “fully grown” chimera up and cradled it in his arm while playfully using the brush to “brush” its tail. Mydeimos let the chimera down when Hyacine came looking for it, Fig Stew followed his auntie to get his paperwork done so he could see his mama and papa (mostly mama) during work hours.

“Sweetcakes what should we do with Pie now? Fig Stew is not gonna be home to play with him after they updated his chimera job profile” Phainon hugged Mydeimos from behind while the chimera hybrid was preparing Pienon’s breakfast. The samyoed was too head empty to understand that his parents were feeding him unsolicited PDAs as his entrée.

“Pienon was strangely smart for an 8-month-old puppy back when I found him. Since he’s almost two now… I’m sure the police academy wouldn’t turn down the offer of having a Samoyed running around its campus”

“…You want Pie to stay in the academy? Who’s going to look after h- ooohh. That’s why you commissioned a collection of dromas onesie for Pie. My lover is so smart, lemme give you more chu-chus” Phainon exclaimed as he jutted his lips out, he was about to land a kiss on Mydeimos’ face when an orange tail wedge itself between his lips and its owner’s soft and munchable cheek.

That’s how Pienon got a job at Okhema’s police academy’s animal mascot. He’s very good at running around with a baton in his mouth and being the first “friendly looking” dog mascot in Amphoreus’ many police academies. Pienon got the “friendly looking” title because he was walking around in a dromas onesie instead of a K-9 hardness like all the other cities. The internet was on fire after Pienon made headlines on the day of his debut, with people asking why is all the cute stuff in Okhema? First were the chimeras and now they have a Samoyed in a cute dromas onesie as the police aca mascot?!

With Pienon sudden fame, it was only a matter of time when people recognized that he was the same puppy featured in a few videos on the Fig_Stew account. Which once again, directed more internet fame to Fig Stew and Pienon’s parents, aka the hot policemen couple. The police department had to ask people to stop coming up to Phainon and Mydeimos while they were on duty to give them gifts and take pictures. Phainon had to make a post on the Fig_Stew account to ask their followers, mostly the new ones, to refrain from doing such things as they could be charge with “interference with a law enforcement officer”.

“Thank goodness that we only manage one social media account, imagine if you and I both have one. The mess would be so much worse” Phainon chuckled light heartedly after posting, flopping down on top of his favorite napping spot/pillow/stress ball/emotional support boobas. Being the Mydei expert that he often claimed to be, Phainon immediately noticed how Mydeimos froze for a second before continuing to pet his head. Mydeimos only lasted 5 minutes after Phainon pulled out his puppy dog eyes and told him about that one chimera meme account that the wolf had been watching for the past months.

“YOU’RE THE ONE BEHIND @chimerameme-meries?!” Phainon wanted to dig a hole for himself when he recalled the many times, he had sent those animated chimera videos to Mydeimos. Not because he was embarrassed, it’s because he had failed to realize that the events featured in those animated clips was not just simply coincidental.

“Wait… so that one clip of the gray chimera waking up the orange one and dragging it to the bath… it was based on our nightly baths?” Mydeimos corrected his lover, stating that it was Phainon’s nightly baths and the chimera hybrid – like the orange one in the animated clip, was an unwilling participant.

“There was that one clip about the gray one eating the slice of ice-cream cake left in the fridge… You know that I ate your cake?!” The chimera hybrid explained that Phainon’s stomachache later that day pretty much outed him as the cake thief. Mydeimos also scolded him about eating random things in the fridge, because almost if not all canine hybrids were lactose intolerant.

“Oh right… I forgot I couldn’t drink cow milk. But goat milk on the other hand…” Phainon wiggled his eyebrows at the chimera hybrid.

According to Mydeimos, that red handprint on Phainon’s face was well-deserved.

chapters.title: Chapter 23
chapters.html:
Ever since chimeras were brought back to life, everyone in Okhema knows that mistreating one could lead to at least a decade in prison. Kidnapping a working chimera in broad daylight? Those criminals would be staying behind bars permanently. Safe to say, it was never a good idea to mistreat or kidnap a chimera as the citizen and police officers were allowed to use any mean possible to rescues the ancient creature. Unfortunately, some people were blinded by the amount of money the rich would pay for a chimera and risk their life of freedom to snatch or steal those critters.

The criminals had received some insider information about a new team of chimeras joining the workforce. While most of the new chimeras were assigned indoor jobs, one was tasked with helping old people and children cross the street. They had been keeping an eye on that one for a month now and had been noting down when the street would be empty enough for them to snatch the little critter. When the right day came, the chimera nursery nearby was opening a charity event and everyone was there, leaving the street bare. Their target was a diligent and hardworking blue chimera, despite knowing there would be little to no people walking around that day, it still stayed in its station not even trying to nap. A man wearing a black hoodie approached the blue critter and it immediately got into working mode, sitting by the crossing light button to see if the man wanted to cross the street.

The man was playing it off like a normal citizen when they saw a chimera, crouching down and cooed at the hardworking critter. It seemed like the newbie chimera was a well-disciplined one, not leaving it spot when the man held out his hand, offering a few head pats to the critter. Another person walked up to them and took pictures of the working chimera. When they received the go ahead from their accomplice, the taller one took out a piece of cloth and tied it over the chimera’s mouth while the other shoved the critter into a bag. The blue chimera was only about to let out a panicked noise before the two criminals snatched it and ran behind the building opposite the crime scene.

During the short time that the criminals spent running to their escape vehicle, the chimera managed to cut open the bag and poke its head out to let out a muffled cry before being shoved back into the bag. Once they got into the cargo truck, the criminals were met with a small surprised, the chimera they kidnapped was not blue but an orange one that was painted over. They weren’t given time to process the sight of the now orange with blue paint on its scales, before something slammed into the truck creating a dent in the truck body. Not even half a second later, the dented part was clawed open by a very upset and angry policeman with blonde hair.

The criminals were a bit too confident because the policeman was outnumbered, a 5 vs 1. They assumed the man was some kind of reptilian hybrid who just painted his tail orange, but little did they know that hybrid was trained to hold his ground and fight against an army. To make matter worse for those criminals, one of their accomplices pinned the chimera down when it tried to run towards the policeman, making the small critter cry. Many had said that you shouldn’t hurt a cub in front of its mother, same principle could be applied to Fig Stew and Mydeimos. The moment a single tear spilled down the chimera’s face, five names were being written onto the grim reaper’s list. The scene that went down couldn’t even called a fight as the five men was knocked out not even a minute after they triggered Mydeimos’ protective instinct in his lioness DNA.

Phainon arrived with Hyacine and an ambulance. Phainon was there to check on his lover, Hyacine went to check on Fig Stew while the paramedic took the ill-fated criminals to the prison’s infirmary. When Mydeimos suddenly ran off without saying a thing, the wolf could only pray that his lover didn’t send the criminals to hell himself. After making sure that Mydeimos had calmed down, Phainon turned to look at the state of the truck the criminals were about to escape with. The thing looked like it just ran through a war zone with the giant hole that the chimera hybrid tore through.

After Hyacine had double checked that Fig Stew wasn’t hurt anywhere, the critter ran over to his mama and papa waiting for their praises.

“My little honeybun! Papa is so proud of you! You did so well on your first mission” Phainon picked Fig Stew up in his arms and showered the critters in praise and kisses, Mydeimos joined in not long after.

As a reward for such a successful first mission for Fig Stew, Mydeimos made chimera cookies and golden honeycakes for the critter. Even though Phainon was a little upset about the next reward but as a good papa, he let Fig Stew sleep and cuddle with Mydeimos at night for an entire week. The orange chimera was a devilish little thing, when Phainon said Fig Stew could ask him for anything as a reward, the critter kicked him out to the couch for a week so the chimera could cuddle his mama to sleep.

Aglaea was very pleased when she received the news that Fig Stew had brought 5 criminals to justice and made him a cute lion onesie. Castorice and Hyacine made Fig Stew a new bed while Cipher got her nephew a new scratching post. Tribios got Fig Stew a special gate pass so it could go see Pienon in the academy whenever it wanted. Anaxa bought a new mint plant for Fig Stew.

Pienon also made his parents proud during his working hours as the police academy mascot. The Samoyed wow’d all of the teachers in the academy by simply memorizing the layout of their biggest school building in just a few days walking around. It was Tribios that helped him show his navigation talent when she asked him to deliver her book to the class she was about to teach. The student watched in amazement as their mascot pushed open the classroom door, leaped on the teacher desk to put down Tribios’ book, and left like this was a normal thing in his daily life.

Thanks to the 3-month living in Castrum Kremnos with Mydeimos and Krateros, Pienon learnt how to pick up his toys and put them in his toy box to help the butler to clean up the mansion. After seeing the janitor picking up trash around the campus, Pienon now had a new game to entertain himself when the students were in class. When Mydeimos came to pick him up, the puppy was very excited to show him the pile of trash he had picked up from around the campus.

Another thing that every person working or studying in the academy learnt about their talented mascot was when the handsome blonde policeman came to visit, it was impossible to get Pienon to leave the blonde’ side. Not even waving a stick of beef jerky dog treat could tempt Pienon away from his mama’s legs. The same thing could be said to the wolf hybrid next to him. Whenever anyone saw Mydeimos, there was a guaranteed that two pairs of white wagging tail would be following him.

chapters.title: Chapter 24
chapters.html:
Even though Mydeimos didn’t upload anything content about himself on his socmed, the chimera memes account was just a bonus gain from his drawing and doodling hobby, his Chrysos family loved to include him in their posts.

Hyacine often post pictures and clips of chimera, sometime those would feature a handsome blonde man playing or taking care of the critters. Castorice mainly post about her flower garden, which would sometime feature a strong big bicep wrapping around a bouquet of flowers native to Castrum Krenmos. Anaxa post a picture once in a blue moon, which was either of some kind of Dromas merch or the dromas cookies and cupcakes Mydeimos made for him as thanks for looking after Pienon. Anaxa got a four-legged helper carrying his books to his classes and he received baked goods from Pienon’s mama, someone hit the jackpot. Aglaea only post pictures of her finished design and the date of when said design would be auctioned. The designer only asked Mydeimos to model for her outfits on rare occasions, because the influx of people thirsting over him would result in a sulky and moody Phainon.  Phainon got his handful with Fig Stew and Pienon account.

And there was Cipher.

It wasn’t surprising that she and Mydeimos got along quite well. Before the Phainon’s Mydeimos-less arc, the cat and chimera hybrids got along splendidly after Mydeimos warmed up to everyone at the HQ. Cipher and Mydeimos were practically siblings a few days after Phainon’s Mydeimos-less arc. No one was surprised when they saw Cipher post her selfie with Mydeimos during their feline night out, the post more often than not would have a comment from Phainon saying something along the lines of Mydeimos not giving him attention or a picture of Pienon’s sad puppy face.

But in the past week, the cat hybrid was really interested in the trend on the Tok. Given her mischievous and playful nature, she often chooses the trend involved recording someone’s reaction on certain things. The girl had posted various clip about said topic such as: Aglaea’s reaction to the new outfit that Phainon bought, Anaxa’s reaction to someone slandering his dromas or teaching style, Hyacine’s reaction to various animals that Cipher somehow managed to borrow for a day, Castorice’s reaction to weird and rare plants from different places in the world. Of course, her most popular clips was the one featuring two of Okhema’s favorite pair of heartthrobs – Phainon and Mydeimos.

One of Cipher favorite clips was the one about the trend where you hold out your hand in front of your lover, but the cat hybrid titled the clip as “Testing if my bestie trained his puppy”. The first part of the clip was Cipher asking Mydeimos to show her some of the tricks Pienon learnt, which include the Samoyed rolling, barking and playing dead. Mydeimos was about to show the recent trick that Pienon learnt, which was putting his snout on his palm. when the blonde held out his palm and Pienon put his snout on it, the clip was expertly edited so it smoothly cut into the recording of Mydeimos holding his hand out toward Phainon. The wolf was picking his lover up from his shopping trip with Cipher when the girl decided to record it. It was safe to say the people on the Tok absolutely swooned over how Phainon titled his head at Mydeimos’ gesture before breaking into the brightest smile ever and skipped toward the open palm to put his chin on it.

If people scrolled through Cipher’s uploaded clips, they would be able to find the one showing the aftermath of that couple’s trend. After Phainon put his chin on Mydeimos’ palm, Cipher zoomed in to show how much the wolf hybrid’s tail was wagging. The still zoomed in camera suddenly moved to the male hybrids’ face, flash banging the audience with the sight of two incredibly attractive and very obviously in love men kissing. Mydeimos decided to squish Phainon’s face in his palm and pulled him into a quick smooch.

“Sorry everyone, but this one right here…” Mydeimos looked into the camera while pulling out a black choker from his shopping bag then put it around Phainon’s neck. The chimera hybrid then hooked his fingers under the black choker to pull Phainon closer to him.

“…is already taken” after that bold declaration, Mydeimos slipped his fingers out, letting the black leather snapped against the skin of Phainon’s neck.

Phainon had to sit down on the bench nearby for 15 minutes to calm his Dawn Maker.

One of the clips on the adorable side was the one showing Hyacine, Castorice and Tribios sitting in a line, eyes sparkling and expectant. Cipher turned the camera towards a Samoyed being brushed by Mydeimos. Judging by the air dryer and towels scattered around the blonde’ feet, Pienon had just finished his “beauty bath”, a bath where Mydeimos pulled out all the fancy dog shampoo and conditioner after he had given Pienon a coat trim. The moment the girlies were waiting for arrived when Mydeimos gave Pienon a few sprays of puppy cologne, the fluffy cloud was now twice as fluffy as before. Pienon got a few treats for his good behavior before running towards his aunties for hugs and pets.  Petting Pienon after his spa day was one of the many ways the Chrysos team chose to de-stress, they were basically petting a cloud.

What Cipher didn’t record that time was after Pienon ran off to play with the girlies, Mydeimos turned around toward the bathroom to clean up the scattered towels only to see Phainon leading against the doorway with a rose in his mouth. Whatever Phainon was about to initiate was poured down the drain as he slipped on one of the towels and fell on his very-much-lacking-in-cushioning-butt. The wolf got a free hair cut for his tail and a few kisses from Mydeimos as an apology for laughing. Everyone at the HQ had quite the few muffled giggles at the small blue bow tie clip on Phainon’s twin sprouts, Mydeimos clipped it on him when the wolf was distracted with kisses.

chapters.title: Chapter 25
chapters.html:
“Oh my… What happened to Phai-chan?” Tribios walked into the kitchen to see Phainon sitting alone eating a plain piece of toast with a dark gloomy cloud floating above his head, raining down on the wilted twin sprouts. The poor thing looked at Tribios with the saddest puppy dog eyes when he greeted her. Castorice, the wolf’s best friend, just shook her head when the red hair woman turned to her. She sat down next to Castorice and joined the girl to stare at the white blob of sadness in the corner of the room. They only got more confused when Hyacine entered the room, clearly unhappy toward Phainon as she looked like she was about to hurl a fat unicorn at him. Then, came the reason why Hyacine was upset and why Phainon was acting the way that he was.

Mydeimos strolled into the room, with bandages around his neck. Thankfully, Cipher left early in the morning to investigate a case, if the cat hybrid saw the chimera’s neck… Castorice fear that Phainon would end up in the hospital.

Everyone and their mother knew about Phainon unwavering love and devotion towards Mydeimos. No one was surprised when the wolf hybrid ran toward his lover and kneeled to hug his legs, mumbling out apologies while tears threatened to spill from his eyes. Phainon was about to kiss Mydeimos’ foot to beg for his forgiveness when the blonde pulled the wolf up to stand on his own legs. The chimera pressed a kiss on those watery blue eyes before slipping his fingers under Phainon’s choker pulling it down enough to expose a small expand of his neck. Tribios and Hyacine looked away while Castorice was using her hand to cover her red face, still looking through the large gaps between the fingers, when Mydeimos bit down on Phainon’s neck, enough to break skin. After giving the bite mark a few kitten licks to lap up the blood, Mydeimos pressed a kiss on his stun-locked boyfriend’s jaw.

“Now we’re even… Look like someone still hungry, I’ll make something for you, you big puppy” Mydeimos smirked at the way Phainon was looking at him, pressing another kiss on his nose before stepping away to make breakfast. They both knew that Phainon wasn’t just hungry for breakfast.

After a few worried questions from Tribios, Mydeimos explained what happened between them. Despite being raised as a killing machine, Mydeimos got tamed and domesticated by Phainon. The chimera that used to wake up from the slightest sound was now akin to a cat, sleeping without a care about what was happening around him after a few nights with Phainon spooning him to sleep. The night before had shown Phainon how his lovers sleep like the dead, unless Mydeimos woke up by himself or Phainon pressing kisses on his face, the chimera would sleep through an earthquake.

It was past midnight when Phainon was woken up by Fig Stew slapping the shit out of him with its paw while Pienon was pulling on the back of his shirt. Phainon was brought out of his groggy sleepy state when he tasted something metallic on his tongue. The wolf hybrid had unconsciously bit and chewed on Mydeimos’ nape leaving multiple nasty and bloody teeth marks on the skin. Hyacine’s room was a few steps away from the infirmary, so she was woken up from the frantic footsteps running down the hall and the loud noise of Phainon almost breaking the infirmary door off its hinges.

The pink haired girl peaked through the door to see Phainon bawling his eyes out because his hands were too shaky from his panic to unroll the gauze bandage. Hyacine immediately stepped in when she saw a drop of blood landing on the floor. Mydeimos, who managed to sleep through the bumpy ride of Phainon carrying him to the infirmary, woke up when Hyacine touched his nape. The chimera blinked at the tears threatening to spill from Phainon’s eyes then turned to look at Hyacine, who was holding disinfectant wipes in her hand. The chimera realized why he was in the infirmary when he felt a drop of blood glide down this back.

“You seemed to be weirdly okay and calm about it” Tribios asked after hearing the story. Mydeimos just shrugged and said he didn’t really mind since he healed quickly, only worried about how Phainon would react if the wolf knew that it wasn’t the first time the wolf had used his lover as a chew toy.

“You don’t have to worry much about it, Ms. Tribios. The nibbing and biting in his sleep were just Phainon’s way of saying his body was craving for some raw meat” Mydeimos casually said as he typed on his teleslate, probably asking Krateros to buy Phainon’s dinner. One has to wonder how whipped Mydeimos were to just let Phainon nibble on him long enough to come to the conclusion that the wolf was craving raw meat.

The truth was… when it happened the first time, Phainon looked so happy with Mydeimos tail in his mouth and the sight of that was too cute to handle. The chimera hybrid didn’t have the heart to wake his lover up, since the wolf hybrid was just simply holding onto his tail with his mouth, like how a snow leopard would carry its tail in its mouth.

Mydeimos was certain that Phainon didn’t know about his weird habit because his joke about letting Phainon eat his tail never land. For some reason, the next thing that popped into Mydeimos head when he joked about that was a maid outfit.

chapters.title: Chapter 26
chapters.html:
Someone in the council had too much time on their hands, was the thought that popped into Aglaea’s head when she read through what said council had tasked her with. The Special Investigation team, Chrysos Heirs, main job was to investigate and neutralize underground networks related to hybrid auctions, illegal production and trade of simulants, additives. Sure, they worked at the police station doing all kinds of things there when there were no major cases that needed their specialty. That did not mean that the council could task them with “hosting a charity event, selling dessert and drinks while wearing some eye-catching uniform”. In Aglaea’s humble opinion, if the council wanted a successful charity event, they should order Anaxa to wear a potato sack sitting in a chair waiting for his student to hit a target with some throwable object so they can dunk him into the water. Just simply thinking about the council using her children colleague as some kind of prop to pull in money for their “charity event” made Aglaea want to strangle every single person that green lit this idea.

Mydeimos, who was untangling Fig Stew from all the yarns that the critter was playing with, noticed the frown on Aglaea’s face. He raised his eyebrow when he skimmed through the email that the woman was reading. The man crouched down to pick up a ball of yarn and threw it behind him, Fig Stew stopped nudging his leg and chased after the ball, tangling himself once again. Mydeimos was about to give his input regarding the email when a loud cheerful voice cut in.

“Mydei! I bought you- Pffft- Fig Stew are you having fun there?” The personification of the sun walked in holding a box of sweets. Staying true to his title “father of the year” Phainon laughed at the way his chimera child was tangled up in yarns, taking pictures of Fig Stew predicament before helping the chimera out of the web of yarns. Mydeimos walked over to them and picked Fig Stew up before it could cause more mischief with its new “toys”. The chimera protested being put in timeout at first, but quiet down after Mydeimos gave it chin scratches. Both Mydeimos and Aglaea turned to look at the wolf hybrid when he called for his lover. Phainon was holding a large blue bow asking if Pienon would look good with it. The two blondies looked at each other as the same idea crossed their mind. Phainon for some reason felt like his boss and his lover were up to no good.

Phainon was right to be worried about the look on their faces as he moved his fingers into a peace sign, smiling at the camera with a random person before returning to taking people’s orders. Phainon had worked in a coffee shop before, quickly noting down the customer orders and carrying a tray full of drinks and dessert. Given his prior experience, Phainon agreed to help Aglaea with the “hosting a charity event, selling dessert and drinks” task she was given by the higher up who had way too much time on their hands. Just like you have assumed, the blonde woman conveniently left out the latter part of the task.

A light blue bodice with white cuffs at the end of the sleeve and white peter pan collar. A fluffy shirt layered with white petticoats and nesting to create the volume for the shirt. Aglaea did not skim on the details as bows were seen every where on Phainon’s maid dress, she did not forget about a white choker with a cute bow on the side of the wolf’s neck. In his defense, Phainon had never been able to say no to Mydeimos when it came to anything, which resulted in a giant bow above the base of his tail. The white frilly apron was given the same treatment as the rest of the maid outfit. Phainon felt so exposed after putting on the outfit, not used to having his collar bone and legs on display for people other than Mydeimos.

“Phainon, come take a break. I’ll take over for the next 2 hours” Aglaea’s accomplice, the one with the key to his heart, the angel sent down by the titans handed him a cold can of soda, the temperature of the can did wonder on his hot skin. It took Phainon a few seconds to process the latter part of what Mydeimos just said to him when it clicked the wolf rushed over to the changing room. As expected, Mydeimos was holding the same outfit as him, it was orange instead of blue like his. The wolf walked in when his lover was tying a orange ribbon with a gold bell on the lower part of his tail, and that was the final straw for the white-haired male.

“I didn’t even have the change to see or appreciate Mydei in a maid dress and I’m his LOVER! Why should I let other people see it!?” Phainon said as he clutched Mydeimos’ outfit closer to his chest. The wolf angrily and cutely puffed his cheeks up at his lover when said man pointed out the fact that he let Phainon walked around in a maid dress.

“I’m going to cry if Mydeimos walked out in public in a dress!” Phainon threatened.

“Why did I let you graduate? You’re not gonna cry over such a ridiculous thing, Phainon. You really want to ruin the make-up that Mydeimos put on you?” Anaxa tiredly said while pinching the bridge of his nose. When in doubt, call Mydeimos. Anaxa looked over to the chimera hybrid. The blonde took a long sip of his drink before an idea popped into his head. Mydeimos walked over to the make-up box and took out a lipstick and applied it on his lips. Phainon didn’t get the chance to ask what he was doing before the blonde strolled over to kiss him on the check leaving a red lip mark there and another under Phainon’s white choker.

If Phainon was being possessive, it was much easier to feed into that possessiveness than doing anything else. Mydeimos had purposely picked a lipstick color that none of the girls out front was using, Castorice was wearing a light shade of purple while Hyacine was using pink lips gloss. Anyone with eyes after a glance at Phainon would know that the wolf was loyal to only one person.

Phainon looked way too happy after that.

The charity event went smoothly; people loved the drinks and dessert. The café that they rented for the day received a lot of attention from social media. Anaxa thought the stunt that Mydeimos pulled to soothe his possessive lover would end badly but it became the highlight of the whole event. People had to shield their eyes from how radiant and bright Phainon’s smile was after his quick break. Many were squealing over how Mydeimos just simply winked at them when they asked about the lip marks on Phainon’s face and neck.

The box of fee to take pictures with Fig Stew, Vigethos and Pienon also made quite a sum of cash.

chapters.title: Chapter 27
chapters.html:
The Chrysos Heir HQ was insanely quiet during lunch break, Phainon returned to the place confused to why there was no sound at all. When he was about to yell out to announce he was back, Castorice texted him telling him to be quiet and head to his and Mydeimos’ room. Still confused about why Castorice would say that he received another text from Cipher threatening to murder him if he dared make a sound. Putting the accumulative experience from all the stealth missions, Phainon tip-toed his way to his room. When he entered the hallway, his ears picked up a feign melody, he took a few more steps and saw the girls huddling and peaking into his room. Cipher gestured to him to come closer and pointed into the room.

♩♪♬♫♪♩♬~

Phainon peaked into the room to see Mydeimos humming a lullaby while rocking Fig Stew to sleep. It was a soft and gentle rhythm, his voice a soft baritone humming out the foreign melody. Phainon never knew that his lover had such a beautiful and smooth singing voice. He and the girls were entranced, Hyacine slowly swaying her body to the soft melody.

  ♩♪♬~

Phainon felt like the luckiest man alive as he looked at Mydeimos’ body gently swaying to the rhythm of his own humming, the wolf stared at his lover like a lovesick fool grinning to himself like an idiot. The fuzzy feeling in his stomach got stronger the more he listened to Mydeimos, it didn’t take long for his tail to start wagging. Phainon and the girls’ cover were blown the moment he couldn’t control his tail as it hit Cipher right in the face making the silver haired cat yelp out in surprise. Everyone looked at Mydeimos with an awkward smile on their face when he caught them listening in.

The older trio returned to see the younger members all piled up in front of the couch in the lounge. Phainon and Mydeimos were leaning on each other’s shoulders with their backs against the couch. Hyacine and Castorice were using Phainon’s and Mydei’s thigh as pillow while Cipher got the premium spot on his tail cuddled up with Pienon and Fig Stew.

“Great. While we were working on our asses off grading exam paper, they decided to form a cuddle pile” Anaxa mumbled out. Tribios giggled as the green-haired professor walked over to fix the blanket Hyacine and Castorice were sharing.

---

“Mydei!”

“…No”

“But-“

“No”

“Ueue QAQ”

“You’re a grown-ass man Phainon. I’m not singing you a lullaby” Mydeimos stared down at the man kneeling between his legs. Said man had the audacity to nuzzle his face against his thigh while looking up at him with his puppy dog eyes. Phainon looked like a wet puppy who got kicked by his chimera friend when he realized Mydeimos was not amused or even falling for his trump card. The blonde didn’t even react when Phainon kissed and nuzzled into his palm. The wolf hybrid didn’t want to stoop this low, but his dignity was already gone when he slid between Mydeimos’ leg and began whining.

“Fine! I’m sleeping outside until you sing to me!” Phainon announced, trying his best to sound like he was angry. Mydeimos rolled his eyes at the childish man, wishing Phainon goodnight as the wolf stomped out of the room. Thankfully Phainon did not see his traitorous adopted children immediately jumping on the bed and making themselves comfortable in his place.

Three hours later, and Phainon was regretting his words. It was near midnight and instead of the soft and purring boyfriend to cuddle with, he was stuck hugging the couch cushion for comfort. He perked up at the sound of footsteps but soon became disappointed when he saw Cipher on her trip of steal food from the pantry. Phainon was beginning to miss the softness of his lover body and started yelling at himself for wasting the perfect opportunity to appreciate Mydeimos’ body.

“I was already half a foot in heaven! I was between his legs for titans’ sake why did I leave?!” Phainon hugged the cushion closer to his chest while looking at the TV screen that was showing some low budget and stereotypical romance. The wolf felt a chill run down his spine right after he opened a bag of chips. The knock was already landed on his head before Phainon could try and defense himself.

“Phainon. What did I say about eating snack late at night?” The disappointed parent voice could only belong to one person. The one person that monitored his nutrition and helped him maintain a balance in his cooked and raw diet.

“Mydei…*sad puppy noises*” Phainon suddenly remembered that he was supposed to be angry at Mydeimos for not singing him to sleep and stopped the pout forming on his face.

“*ehem* What? I missed me already, princess? Realized that you only need to hum a few melodies to get all of this-“Phainon gestured to his entire body “-in your bed?” Unfortunately for Phainon, Mydeimos was done with his bs and grabbed the wolf by his pajama collar

“You either get back to bed right now or spend the rest of the month out here” That got Phainon scrambling to his feet and clung to the chimera hybrid, frantically nuzzling his head against the other’s neck. After a few inhales of that sweet fruity scent from the blonde’ shampoo, Phainon was fully recharged and ready for bed. Effortlessly sweeping Mydeimos up in a bridal carrying and beelined to their shared room. Pienon and Fig Stew were not happy with Phainon after he carried them out to the lounge so he could enjoy Mydeimos “singing” to him.

chapters.title: Chapter 28
chapters.html:
Everyone was well-aware of the fortune that Mydeimos was sitting on, but the chimera hybrid rarely used the card that Krateros had given him. One reason for it was because of Phainon. The wolf wanted to spoil his lover by buying him gifts and sweets. The day when it finally clicked for him that Mydeimos was a multi-millionaire thanks to his inheritance, Phainon was conflicted. He was glad that Mydeimos wasn’t short on money to buy what he wanted, on the other hand Phainon wouldn’t get the chance to spoil his lover with gifts. Because what could Phainon get as a gift for the man who had everything? Mydeimos would probably feel bad if Phainon bought him gift with the wolf’s hard earn money and Phainon would dig a hole to crawl into if he used Mydeimos’ money to buy gifts for the chimera hybrid.

Mydeimos found Phainon’s dilemma(?) endearing and funny at the same time. The wolf was too busy feeling conflicted with the news about his lover’s fortune, he forgot that Aglaea paid them generously. That not counting the wage of working as a policeman. Similar to how Phainon had his puppy dog eyes as his trump card, Mydeimos also got one of his own. A homemade meal and letting Phainon “feel his heartbeats” were enough to convince Phainon to stop overthinking about getting gifts for the chimera hybrid. Considering that Mydeimos accepted that horrendous excuse of a handmade pottery flowerpot Phainon gifted him as a courting gift, the wolf could give Mydeimos a single flower he picked from the side of the road and the blonde would still love it.

Because of that, Mydeimos only used the money from his wages, rarely touching the fortune that he was sitting on himself. The platinum card only used for buying gifts and ingredients to spoil everyone at the Chrysos Heir’s HQ. Imagined the surprise of everyone when they found out the chimera hybrid opened a coffee shop about three months ago.

“Krateros and his men said that they were bored because I rarely asked them to do anything. So, I off-handedly said they should open a little mom&pop-espe coffee shop since I don’t need bodyguards” I already have a guard dog wolf, was left unsaid. Mydeimos was not one to judge another’s preferences but hearing his colleague whispering to each other about a DILF coffee shop then later found out they were talking about the one his bodyguards were working in was not on Mydeimos’ bingo card.

[He did find those colleagues’ expressions quite amusing when they saw him talking to Krateros behind the counter.

“So DILF coffee shop huh?” The blonde took a long sip of his drink while staring at his colleague. The two people on the receiving end of that look wanted to dig a hole to bury themselves while Krateros and the other employees stared at their young master’s smug face.

“My chauffer is singl-“

“Young master, please don’t tease your colleague and the employee” Krateros interrupted the chimera hybrid while pouring more hot chocolate in his cup. Bribery accepted.]

Mydeimos chuckled at the memory pouring himself another cup of tea. He was having teatime with Castorice and Cipher when the cat hybrid mentioned seeing Krateros working in the coffee shop. The place received a steady stream of customers every day, so it was doing pretty well for a simple cottagecore themed coffee shop. The blonde took a bite of the strawberry shortcake, closing his eyes to savor the sweet and fluffiness of the dessert. Castorice and Cipher swore they saw a pinkish blush on the chimera hybrid’s cheek while cartoony flowers floated around him. The cat hybrid was quick enough to start recording the moment Mydeimos took a bite of his cake knowing a certain wolf would pay good money for it.

And speak of the devil…

“Mydei~ I finished my reports! Gimme chuchus” An overgrown puppy excitedly ran over to where the trio was enjoying their afternoon tea, hugging Mydeimos from behind his chair while jutting his lips out and making kissy noise. Castorice and Cipher’s reaction was in two entirely different worlds. Castorice was smiling at Phainon’s antics while typing on her teleslate with incredible speed while Cipher was looking at him with lighthearted disgust and making gaging noises.  

“Phainon, sit”

“Hai~”

“Now, open”

“Ah~”

“How is it?”

“Sweet but not as sweet as you~” Phainon said after swallowing the piece of dessert, standing up to give Mydeimos a kiss.

“Gross” Cipher said after involuntarily witnessing whatever that was.

Phainon quiet down after comfortable settled down on his chair. By “his chair” Phainon meant Mydeimos’ chair after he lifted the chimera up and sat down on the chair, letting the other sat on his thigh. Phainon’s definition of “comfortable” that day was having Mydeimos’ weight on his legs, hugging the blonde by his stomach and inhaling his lover’s hair.

Tribios was concerned that Mydeimos’ shampoo had some kind of addictive for wolves but after checking the ingredient and Mydeimos changed his shampoo, it turned out Phainon was just a simp. The wolf hybrid was quite unhappy to be called that because no one called Mydeimos that when the blonde straight up tore his shirt to shreds just to take a whiff of his scent, then proceeded to be jealous and upset at the people calling themselves Mydeimos’ simps online.

“Phew~ My dessert stomach is so full! Thanks for treating us, little prince!” Cipher patted her stomach after eating the last of the cupcakes. Castorice also finished her share of the desserts and thanked the chimera hybrid for treating and indulging them. The two girls offered to clean up the dishware, it was Phainon’s turn to thank them as he whisked his lover away.

Phainon managed to scare both Fig Stew and Pienon when the two critters entered the room. The two thought Phainon was going to eat their mama and began awo-ing and barking loudly. To be fair, no one was going to look at the sight of a wolf hybrid pinning down a half-naked man to inhale the scent between the shirtless man’s pectorals and thought that it was a normal thing. In Phainon’s defend, Mydeimos’ scent between his cleavage had a faint milky scent, the wolf was testing to see if it was the chimera’s nature scent or the man just changed his body wash.

chapters.title: Chapter 29
chapters.html:
Castorice preferred the quiet atmosphere when she was working on her stories. The coffee shop that Mydeimos’ butler was running met her criteria for a peaceful and calm environment. The smell of freshly roasted and brewed high quality coffee lingered in the air was the thing Castorice noticed and came to like when she first visited the place. After that first day, the girl always invited either Hyacine or Aglaea to come and enjoyed a good cup of their preferred beverage.

That day, when Castorice stopped by the coffee shop she was quite surprised to see Phainon behind the counter. The wolf flashed her his usual bright and radiant smile and punched down her order into the register then turned around to begin preparing her drink. When Castorice turned to find a place to sit, she spotted Mydeimos sitting in the corner of the place. He waved her over to join him when he saw her standing in front of the cash register.

From what Mydeimos had told the purple haired girl, Phainon wanted to learn barista skill so he could made Mydeimos the best cup of coffee every morning, “so good that he would ask Phainon to make him coffee every day, and that’s basically a proposal” was Phainon’s exact word to his lover. Castorice couldn't help but chuckled at how Mydeimos tried to say that using his best Phainon’s impression. When asked about why the blonde was also staying in the coffee shop, all Castorice got was two words “to supervise”. Which was quite confusing because Krateros and the rest of his men were also working. She later found out what those words meant.

If look could kill, the lady that was trying to flirt with Phainon would be Thanatos next customer. She must have been new here judging by how she wasn’t surprised to see a young man working at what the people in the city dubbed as “The DILF café”. The woman said that she wanted to check out the menu first so Phainon would turn around to continue working on the to-go order on the delivery app. Castorice could tell she was checking out Phainon rather than the menu.

As sharp as Phainon was when it came to anything related to Mydeimos, he was strangely oblivious to the not at all subtle hints that the woman was sending him. She propped her arms on the counter to pretend to read the menu, flashing her cleavage, when Phainon turned his attention back to note down her order. She began twirling her hair when Phainon asked about her preferences. Before she could flirt and started describing Phainon as her preferences, the wolf hybrid began yapping about the tea leaves imported from Xianzhou. What prompted the yap about how different tea tasted was because Phainon saw her finger pointing to the tea section.

Just when Mydeimos thought the woman had lost interest, Phainon proceeded to flash her his charming and bright smile, making her blush and making the chimera hybrid snapped the pencil in his hand.  The lady was more determined to get the handsome wolf hybrid’s number. She asked Phainon what his favorite drink on the menu was and proceeded to order that while winking at him. Too bad for her, Phainon didn’t saw her winking at him as Castorice “accidentally” knocked over her drink, pulling the wolf’s attention to her and Mydeimos. Phainon quickly typed in the woman’s drink and handed her the receipt before running over to his friends. There was no way Phainon was going to let Mydeimos clean up a single drop of spilled drink. The wolf rushed over with a cleaning cloth to clean up the spilled drink before Mydeimos could reach for his pack of travel size napkins.

A spilled coffee in exchange for seeing one of the scenario she had wrote in real time, Castorice would take that deal without hesitation.

Mydeimos offered to pay for Castorice spilled drink and head to the counter before she could say anything. Phainon felt chills in his spine when Mydeimos brushed pass him, standing next to the woman and giving her his business smile. The lady paid him no more attention after returning his smile, she turned her attention back to Phainon who was having a crisis in his head trying to think what he did wrong for Mydeimos to act like that. His tsundere cat chimera boyfriend didn’t even look him in the eyes, those golden eyes looked at the menu with boredom and disinterest. Phainon didn’t even notice the note wrapped around the credits the woman handed him. After she finished her payment and sat down at the nearest table, the moment she looked over she saw Phainon jumping over the counter to lift Mydeimos over his shoulder like a sack of potatoes.

“HSK! Put me down!” Mydeimos hissed at Phainon, hitting his back with his hands. All that struggle to only let Phainon manhandled him into a bridal carry and pout at him. Phainon knew he had won when Mydeimos stopped moving about to get out of his hold and felt his tail wrapped securely around his calf. The two lovebirds completely forgot about the other patrons in the café; both lost in their own world. Castorice brazenly walked in front of them and snapped a picture, smiling widely as she snapped multiple pics when Phainon leaned down to nuzzle his forehead against Mydeimos’. The gasp from that lady was very audible when Mydeimos shot her his victorious smirk while Phainon kissed the top of his head.

“I can’t believe an employee would abandon his job to flirt with his boyfriend! What kind of work ethic is that? I want to see your manager” Seemed like someone was a bit salty that the wolf hybrid that she was interested in was already taken. Her face was red, none of them knew if it was because she was embarrassed about flirting with a taken man or she was mad about Phainon disinterest in her.

The lady had the nastiest smirk on her face when Krateros walked out to check out whatever the yelling was for. She started going on about how Phainon was leading her on for not saying that he was taken and saying that Phainon was tricking her into buying their most expensive drink. Mydeimos, still being bridal carried by Phainon, started to become agitated the moment the lady accuses his lover of tricking her. Thankfully the other customers began defending the wolf hybrid.

Stop with the accusation, lady. You asked what his favorite drink was, and you decided to order it yourself!

Yeah! He was being honest about the drink, you’re just mad that you wouldn’t have a chance with him!

Girl, you ordered an almond milk latte. That’s half the price of what I’m drinking.

The lady knew that she couldn’t get Phainon in trouble, so she turned to Mydeimos and Castorice. Before she could say something that could cause Phainon to maim her, Krateros stepped in to offer her a refund and kindly asked her to leave. The woman still believe that she could get Phainon fired because of what he was doing with Mydeimos. Her expression immediately dropped when Krateros cleared his throat and gestured towards the blonde man, still comfortably being held in Phainon’s arms, while telling her that Mydeimos was the owner of the café.

She accused the entire café, including the patrons of scheming and working together to humiliate her, of ruining her reputation online. The woman threatened to spread bad words about the café on her social media, showing Mydeimos her followers count. The blonde gestured to Castorice to take a look, and the girl was silent. She had a few hundred followers less than Anaxa’s account that he used to ragebait and talk shit about the other teacher in the Grove of Epiphany – the university that he used to teach in.

“Krateros did you post any advertisement online?”

“No, I did not. Most of our customers are people living around the neighborhood while the to-go order was mainly delivered to the Okhema Police Academy” Mydeimos nodded at the information then turning to the lady.

“Well, any publicity is good publicity. Please go ahead and do whatever you want after you leave, miss”

Phainon was able to guess what the lady was going to pull next and set Mydeimos down, kissing his head as an apology for letting his lover step foot on the ground. He motioned a special signal to Castorice, and the girl nodded, pulling out her police badge. That was enough for the lady to give up and walked out of the café, fuming. After she left the other costumer said that they would defend the café reputation if that woman decided to go through with her words. The smile on both Phainon and Mydeimos’ faces made everyone swoon over how beautiful the two were. The blonde insisted that everyone took a coupon as his apology for such an unpleasant scene, ruining the cozy atmosphere.

Phainon was about to return to working as the temporary barista when his vision flipped. One second, he was standing and the next, Phainon was securely lying in his lover’s arms. Mydeimos pulled him back and swept the wolf hybrid away in a bridal carry, Phainon was as red as a tomato when he realized it. Steam could be seen rising from Phainon’s head when the customers whistled and clapped as Mydeimos carried him out and into the limo. The blonde romantically threw Phainon inside the car, then holding the door opened for Castorice to enter. The chimera hybrid sat down next to Phainon, opposite the purple haired girl after one of his bodyguards handed him the take-out drinks for Castorice and the rest of the Chrysos team.

“Cas” Mydeimos spoke up after taking a sip of his drink.

“You could commission someone to engrave words on his leather choker. A heart with both your initials could look pretty good”

“How about a heart charm with an “M”?” Mydeimos pulled out his telestale and doodled out Phainon’s choker with a silver heart tag with an M on it.

“That’s a pretty good idea” Castorice said nodding at Mydeimos.

“I can’t believe you two are having this conversation in front of me” Phainon said with his hand covering his red face. He tried to hide it but Mydeimos could tell how excited Phainon at the implication that his lover was being possessive.

Chapter End Notes

I have no idea what prompted me to write this chapter lol

chapters.title: Chapter 30
chapters.html:
After the incident at Krateros’ café, Phainon thought his lover would be more open to more affectionate gestures like curling or hooking his tail around Phainon’s or purring. Despite mentioning to their colleague about getting him a collar, Mydeimos was a reserved man, the reasonable one between them, the one making sure that Phainon didn’t go overboard with his affection. Mydeimos, the immoveable fortress that kept and managed Phainon’s weird behavior when it came to the chimera hybrid. The blonde was the sole reason why Phainon didn’t even attempt to grope his lover while they were in the breakroom together. Everyone had immense appreciation for Mydeimos’ hard work, toning the PDA down to a reasonable level.

The sergeant at the police station seemed to have received some good praises from the council, because he invited the ones that wasn’t stuck with night shift and patrol out for drinks. He promised that he’ll invite them next time.

Phainon had no idea how Krateros got hold of this information, but he suddenly appeared at the station, asking Phainon to sit inside the limo for a little talk. The butler grabbed his shoulder and wanted him to swear that if Mydeimos showed any sign of getting drunk Phainon had to take him home IMMEDIATELY. The wolf agreed instantly when Krateros disclosed that people from the Strife family tend to become aggressive when inebriated.

“Wait a second… If you’re so worried about drunk Mydei, wouldn’t it be more logical to ask him to not go?”

“There is a chance that the young master would react differently. You’re basically his husband now so take it as a chance to prepare yourself for the future”

Phainon was well-aware he had been joking and teasing Mydeimos about marriage and proposal but to hear someone else say it was not what the wolf was prepared for judging by how red he was while stuttering out that he’ll keep an eye out for his lover. Of course, Krateros’ title as butler didn’t stop at that. The old man had arranged and booked a private booth for them. Even the sergeant was impressed by the quality of the alcohol. Phainon, like always, plastered himself to Mydeimos’ side downing the shots that the blonde handed him every time they cheered with the other. The wolf noticed how Mydeimos scrunched up his nose after sniffing the shot of whiskey and took the little glass out of his hand to drink it. Then, he blew a breath of air at the blonde laughing at how Mydeimos entire face morphed into disgust. Phainon was unsurprisingly banned from giving Mydeimos kisses.

“C’mon Mydeimos, have some fun! How long are you planning on letting Phainon drink your whiskey?” One of the co-workers said, the man was already tipsy as he draped his arm across Mydeimos’ shoulders. The man started talking about how good the bottle of whiskey were and how most people wouldn’t be able to get their hand on such a pretentious brand. The chimera hybrid was about to be sick from the whiskey breath from the man, he leaned onto Phainon’s sturdy chest to get away from it. The wolf immediately pressed Mydeimos’ face into his body, stroking his hair while the blonde tried to stop his dinner from coming out. The scent of the ripe wheatfield helped Mydeimos recover from the whisky breaths that hit him right in the nose. Phainon thankfully had managed to drive the man away, saying that he overheard the other colleague talking about the man’s interest.

“Are you okay, sweetie? Sorry, I didn’t know you hate whiskey that much” Phainon mumbled out, his voice was muffled because of the handkerchief covering his mouth to stop the smell of whiskey. The wolf reached for the menu and decided to get Mydeimos a dessert cocktail, a Parisian Blonde. Phainon hoped that Mydeimos liked Jamaican rum because of its sweetness and fruitiness. It was already a good sign that the chimera didn’t scrunch up his nose when he sniffed at the cocktail. The white-haired man high-fived himself when he saw the blonde’s eyes lit up after his first sip.

Aglaea and Castorice were also invited to the drinking party but arrived an hour later because of paperwork. Apparently, an hour was enough for Mydeimos to get drunk out of his mind. The blonde woman shot Phainon a disapproving stare while Castorice blushed at how Mydeimos was straddling the wolf hybrid. Thankfully, their co-workers and the sergeant had taken to the dance floor, leaving Phainon to deal with an affectionate drunk Mydeimos. The blonde was purring, if it wasn’t for the music both Aglaea and Castore would be able to hear the sound of an engine running on Phainon’s lap. Mydeimos was treating Phainon as if the hybrid was catnip, licking and rubbing his face against the wolf hybrid’s face, then suddenly pecking him with almost a dozen kisses simultaneously.

“Phainon.”

“Lady Aglaea, I swear on my purple dromas pants that I didn’t get him drunk intentionally! All he had drank this entire time was a cup of cocktail, a dessert cocktail!” Phainon gestured toward the singular fancy looking glass on their side of the table, surrounded by a dozen shot glasses. Castorice pointed at the shot glass, and Phainon understood what she was asking.

“Mydei hated the smell of whiskey when he first sniffed it, so I downed his share of shots and mine. That’s why there’s 12” Castorice stared at the extremely sober man that drank 12 shots of whiskey, mouth agape at his alcohol tolerant. Opposite attract each other after all.

“Phainon. Krateros asked you to take him home immediately if he got drunk” Aglaea scolded the wolf hybrid, making his ears drooped down. Mydeimos noticed it and glared at the blonde women. Well, more like pouted at her.

“Don’t yell at *hic* him… hus-…band *hic* will be sad…*hic*” All three of them was 100% sure that Mydeimos was drunk out of his mind, hiccupping and slurring in his speech.

“Mister, can you tell me your name?” Castorice asked to see how out Mydeimos was, and his answer nearly took Phainon out.

“Name…? *hic* M-Mydei…mos Kh-*hic*Khasla…na”

“Kephale above Mydei you’re going to kill your future husband with that” Phainon teased the drunken hybrid sitting in his lap, kissing his forehand to avoid his whiskey breath hitting Mydeimos’ nose. Seeing how their most powerful fighter was acting, Aglaea urged the waiter to get them a glass of warm milk, dropping a 5k credits as the tip when the waiter came back a minute later. Thankfully, the chimera hybrid quickly fell asleep after drinking the milk, softly snoring in Phainon’s arms.

The Chrysos team would never stop being amazed at how quickly Krateros showed up after a single text message from Mydeimos’ teleslate. The old man let out a sign of relief when he saw his young master sleeping soundly and the area didn’t look like a tornado just swept through.

When Phainon carried Mydeimos back to their room, Fig Stew and Pienon were waiting for their mama. The wolf asked to be quiet as he tucked his lover in after changing his clothes. When the wolf crouched down to say something to the critters, Fig Stew face was of pure disgust when he got hit with the whiskey smell. Phainon had to wash his mouth and brush his teeth thrice to lessen the smell of 12 shot of whiskey in his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 31
chapters.html:
“Mydei, you love me right?”

“That entirely depends on what you’re about to say next, Phainon” The tone that Mydeimos used made Phainon rethink what he was about to brought up. The wolf was one wrong step away from sleeping on the couch that night, that’s said a lot for someone who often enabled Phainon’s antics. The white-haired male had already made the wrong decision of interrupting Mydeimos during his reading time – the only time that Pienon and Fig Stew wouldn’t dare to bother him. Phainon knew he was walking on thin ice when Mydeimos’ tail began thumping on the ground the closer he got to him.

Phainon prides himself in his Mydeimos taming ability, he knew exactly what to do to not sleep on the couch.

Chin scratches.

The moment Phainon was able to bring his hand under his lover’s face, all of the annoyance bubbling inside Mydeimos disappeared as soon as those fingers began moving. The chimera hybrid closed his eyes and rested his chin on top of Phainon’s hand. The wolf knew he had succeeded when Mydeimos exhaled and slowly relaxed his body. Phainon got his immunity toward sleeping on the couch when the blonde started purring from his scratches. The purr indicate that Phainon had turned on the chimera’s “adorable and dangerous” mode. The name was self-explanatory, Mydeimos was affectionate and adorable with his half-lidded eyes and light pink blush on his face, which was also extremely dangerous if you’re Phainon – the scale of danger depends on how Mydeimos smile at him in this mode.

With his lover contently purring on the bean bag, Phainon was able to carry him back to their room without an angry tail slapping him and a cold Mydeimos-less couch waiting for him. Phainon opened the door and set Mydeimos down on the bed, and as expected both Fig Stew and Pienon ran over to the chimera hybrid asking for attention. The wolf ushered Pienon and Fig Stew out of the room giving the chimera a pouch of credit and told it to take Pienon to go look for Cipher.

“You’re up to no good, aren’t you”

“Slanderous words there Mydei. I’m your good boy, I have no nefarious intention towards you” Phainon gave the blonde his charming smile, leaning down to nuzzle their noses then gently pushed Mydeimos to lie on the bed.  The blonde wrapped his arms around Phainon’s neck when he caged him in with his hands. Phainon slightly chuckled at Mydeimos’ eagerness for a kiss and indulged the man under him. Ever the caring partner, the wolf hybrid grabbed a pillow and slid it under his lover lower back, elevating the blonde’ back so his tail wasn’t uncomfortably squished under his own weight. When Phainon reached into his pocket, what he pulled out wasn’t the usual packet with the word XXL that the wolf carried with him for reason that shouldn’t be mentioned in a T-rated fic. The wolf hybrid, the man that Mydeimos adored and loved with his entire heart, pulled out a pack of catnip. Catnip. The chimera hybrid stared at the dried catnip inside the plastic pack, wondering whether or not he should be offended and delivered divine retribution upon his lover.

“Phainon, get off of me”

“But-“

“Get off”

Phainon’s ears flattened against his head, and he scrambled off the bed when he heard how pissed off Mydeimos was. The blonde looked at the man kneeling beside the bed, avoiding eye contact like a guilty puppy. Recalling how happy Phainon was and the innocent look on his face when he took out the catnip, Mydeimos gave the man the benefit of the doubt and assumed he didn’t know how catnip actually work. The chimera held out his hand and was about to ask Phainon to give him the catnip when the wolf put his chin on top of it. The wolf looked at Mydeimos with his guilty puppy eyes, nuzzling into the other palm with it moving to the side of his face. Maybe Phainon really didn’t know how catnip affect felines.

Mydeimos was right on his assumption as Phainon groveled in front of him, apologizing for buying such a thing after reading an article about how catnip works. It was going to be hard for Phainon to explain why his lover was showing signs of being in heat. Cipher would probably bury the wolf alive if she caught wind of it, Krateros would definitely castrate Phainon if he ended up doing the deeds with catnip-high-Mydeimos.

“…Well, if you already bought it. I guess it wouldn’t hurt to use a small amount” Mydeimos mumbled out, he couldn’t help but wanting to spoil and indulge his lover. The blonde poured out a tiny pinch of dried catnip and cautiously sniffed it. One of the dried leaves ended up in his nose, causing the chimera to sneeze, blowing the pinch of catnip on top of Phainon’s head. It took a few seconds for the nepetalactone to take effect and when it did Phainon was tossed onto the bed before he realized it.

A few minutes later, someone came knocking at their door.

“Phainon, have you seen Myde-… are you alright?” Castorice opened the door when she heard an Oof from Phainon. The wolf hybrid was sitting at the edge of the bed with Mydeimos straddling him. The chimera was rubbing his face against the top of Phainon’s head while the wolf was holding onto his waist to stable him. Everything suddenly made sense when Castorice saw the bag of catnip on the floor and immediately texted Cipher to stay away from the place that was contaminated with catnip. The purple-haired girl looked up at the exact moment Mydeimos decided to push his lover down to rub his upper body against Phainon’s catnip infected hair. Despite not being affected by catnip, Phainon was already on cloud nine as he almost got asphyxiated by Mydeimos bountiful and bouncy pectorals. Castorice was no king Authur, so she left to let Phainon and Mydeimos deal with the Excalibur in the wolf’s pants.

Phainon is a caring and loving partner, so when the catnip wore off he left Mydeimos to snooze soundly on his hoodie and went to take a throughout shower to get rid of the catnip and polish his Dawnmaker.

The titans had given Fig Stew their blessing as the critter wasn’t reacting to the pack of catnip Phainon forgot to lock away before heading to the shower. Phainon wasn’t sure how Krateros got hold of the information about him letting Mydeimos tried catnip, the bitter caffeinated abomination of parental disapproval and disappointment in his hand told him that the butler was not happy about it. Anaxa saw the cup of liquid death in Phainon’s hand and asked if the wolf hybrid could get him the same thing, not knowing that the drink was a punishment for Phainon. The white-haired male handed the professor his drink and the man took a sip of it, smacking his lips to savor the caffeinated abomination that could probably kill a horse

“Hmm… Not bad. Some students at the Grove would pay good money for a potion that could keep them awake for two days straight”

Both Phainon and Krateros, after the wolf hybrid told him about Anaxa’s feedback, wondered what kind of human the Grove of Epiphany was teaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 32
chapters.html:
Everyone knew that Cipher had pretty much adopted Mydeimos as her little brother a long time ago, so seeing them napping and braiding each other’s hair was a normal occurrence. Mydeimos cared for her just as much as she cared for him. That’s why no one dared to stop Cipher from wanting to hit Phainon when she heard about the alcohol incident.

During lunch, while the people at the police station was enjoying their lunches, Cipher barged into the office almost broke the door of its hinges and beelined toward Phainon. The sole reason why the sandwich in the wolf’s hybrid hand didn’t get slapped away was because Cipher didn’t want to clean up afterward. The girl dragged Phainon out of the office before turning to glare at him.

“You ungrateful bastard. Do you know how many days it took him to prepare that for you?! And here you are eating your sandwich while he is back at the HQ with the plate of dessert that you refused to try?!”

When Cipher returned to the HQ to grab the lunch that Mydeimos had prepared for her, she saw the chimera hybrid eating something with a crestfallen look on his face. She had approached the blonde to ask what had happened. Mydeimos had offered her a small plate of tiramisu to try and ask for her opinion on it. It was the best tiramisu she had tasted.
