The ladyfinger cookie was dipped in such delicious coffee syrup combined with the rich and light cream and the chocolatey goodness that was the love heart garnish made from chocolate ganache, Mydeimos could make all the dessert shop in Okhema a run for their money. After coming back from dessert heaven, Cipher noticed how her tiramisu was decorated with hearts, it was clearly made for Phainon. Yet, there her little brother was, eating such a masterfully made creation alone in the HQ kitchen without the familiar white twin sprouts next to him.

“Mydeimos spent days perfecting the recipe so he could see that stupid smile on your face. If you don’t give me a good reason why you refused to even try a single bite, I’ll make sure that sandwich is the only good thing you’re going to eat from now on”

Cipher pulled Phainon down by his shirt collar and demanded him to explain why he didn’t want to take a single bite from the dessert that was sent from heaven itself. Before Phainon could try to explain his reasoning, the door to the break room that Cipher planned on sending the wolf hybrid to see Thanatos opened, revealing the angel that made those heaven-sent tiramisus. Mydeimos confusedly blinked at the sight of Phainon hunched over because Cipher was gripping his shirt. Mydeimos convinced Cipher to let go of his lover and sat down to hear Phainon out. Of course, the cat hybrid did not let the lovebirds sat next to each other. The wolf hybrid looked at Mydeimos with his head lowered, fighting his habit to not pout while explaining why he didn’t want to try the tiramisu.

“I’m lactose intolerant… The stash of fruit popsicles in the freezer is mine… not Hyacine’s…” Since ice cream was a no go, popsicles were Phainon’s go-to sweet treat to cool off during hot days.

“Me too, you’re not special. Bitch”

The last word flew out of Cipher mouth before she could stop herself. Mydeimos could only pinch the bridge of his nose and exasperatedly sighed when Phainon turned to look at him with his confused eyes. The chimera offered no word of explanation to his lover; he stood up and left the room. Cipher then proceeded to ask if Phainon had hit his head elsewhere and called him an idiot. The cat hybrid asked him how often he got stomachaches from eating Mydeimos’ food, to which he answered only the first week when the chimera returned. Cipher was extremely close to put a giant “not approve” stamp over Phainon and her brother marriage certificate in the future. It was baffling how the wolf hybrid failed to connect the dots on how his stomachaches disappeared after the first week when Mydeimos began cooking for him.

“Phainon, how often do you open the communal fridge in the HQ?”

Cipher then told him about how Mydeimos was on the verge of tears when he pulled her aside after his third time making dinner for Phainon. The poor thing was so distressed over how his food was making the wolf sick and can’t seem to figure out why. Cipher couldn’t even blame Mydeimos for not knowing most hybrids are lactose intolerant back then. Eurypon would most likely teach the chimera that he could weaken his enemies with milk rather than explaining what lactose was. Mydeimos then proceeded to stock the fridge with lactose free products and goat milk when he learnt about Cipher and Phainon’s problem with high lactose milk aka cow milk. The only time Phainon got a stomachache because of his lactose intolerance was when he ate the ice-cream cake in the mini fridge in their room. The wolf was too well-taken care of by Mydeimos that he forgot he was lactose intolerant then; too used to eating whatever the chimera made without having bathroom visits.

“Cupid and Mnestia would be Cerces arch-nemesis if love could make someone this stupid”

“Okay. Frist of all, rude. Second of all, Cupid isn’t even from Amphoreus” Phainon said with a pout on his face, crossing his arms and huffing. Cipher slowly counted down from 5 in her head, the moment she got to 1 Phainon bolted out of the room to chase after Mydeimos. One have to wonder who reminded Phainon that he was lactose intolerant after the wolf had gone months without worrying about whether or not the food Mydeimos was feeding him had lactose in it.

The sergeant didn’t even try to stop Phainon from leaving the station while he was still on the clock, knowing how pissed off the wolf hybrid would be if anyone even dare to slow him down when the only thing he had in his mind then was Mydeimos. The wolf scouted the entire Chyrsos HQ, he even went to the academy to look for his lover hoping to see the blonde playing with Fig Stew or Pienon to rid his mind of the stupidity that Phainon had that morning. There was only one place that Mydeimos would often visit, the café.

Krateros was not happy when he saw Phainon’s face, yet he still let the man entered the staff lounge to see his lover. The wolf knew he didn’t get to be upset when he saw the café staff enjoying the tiramisu that Mydeimos made. So, Phainon swallowed down his emotion and walked over to the couch Mydeimos was sitting on. Before the wolf could voice out the string of apologies, Mydeimos shoved a spoonful of tiramisu into his mouth, a smile slowly formed on his face when Phainon eyes lit up. The bodyguards that hadn’t seen Phainon yet watched on in amazement as it was their first time seeing his tail-icopter in action. One of the older bodyguards wiped away a proud imaginary tear when he saw how his young master had domesticated one of Okhema’s powerhouses into a puppy. Mydeimos only needed to tap his thighs a few times and Phainon would immediately flop his head on top of those juicy melon crushers. The bodyguards, not knowing about the sin that Phainon had committed that morning, all nodded to each other silently giving Phainon their stamp of approval when they saw the gentle and loving smile on Mydeimos’ face.

“I’m so glad that the young master not only inherited Lady Gorgo’s look but also got her gentleness and kindness as well” One of them whispered. If Phainon made Mydeimos cry he would have Cipher, Fig Stew, Pienon, Krateros and his legion of dads bodyguards out for his head.

“For titans’ sake what are you even sulking for? I’m not even mad at you, Phainon” Mydeimos turned to look at his lover. They had returned to their room after spending some time at the café, with Krateros staring daggers at Phainon’s head. The wolf looked at the blonde with his wide eyes, clearly surprise to hear it. Phainon was sure Mydeimos was putting up a small act so that his bodyguard wouldn’t  jump Phainon.

“We have been together for nearly a year now. You should know that it is borderline impossible for me to stay mad at your handsome face, Phainon” Mydeimos close their distance to hold Phainon’s face in his palms, giggling when Phainon took on of them to press a kiss on it, then slowly kissing up Mydeimos’ arm to reach his face. The giggling turned to full laughter when Phainon decided to voice his apology through kisses, pecking his lover’s face with dozens of kisses. Even Fig Stew and Pienon wanted to join in, not letting Phainon hogged their mama.

Lots of kisses and laughter later, Phainon took Mydeimos to enjoy their daily one out of two baths. The wolf spoke up, disrupting the quiet between them, hugging Mydeimos mid-rib while they were still in the bathtub.

“I’m sorry for acting the way I did this morning” Phainon recalled the way the chimera’s smile dropped when he said that he didn’t want to try out the dessert and left without even giving Mydeimos his goodbye kiss.

“You really know how to ruin the mood huh? I already told you I’m not mad. You’ve been working extra hours and juggling your time with your temporary part-time job. Working yourself to the bone, pulling an all night out working as the night guard at the museum. Have you forgotten how ridiculously large the yearly bonus that you’re going to receive from the police force and Aglaea? Stop doing all this extra job do whatever you plan on doing for our anniversary”

“You know about it already?” Phainon asked, his hand moving to rub circles on Mydeimos’ naked waist. For some reason Phainon wasn’t even sad that his surprise was half spoiled.

“Can’t go to bed without these strong arms spooning me to sleep. So, I followed you after you sneaked out the second time”

“So… how about I apologize for leaving you alone at night then?”

“Later, Phainon. The children is waiting for their baths” Mydeimos slapped away the hand that sliding down to do inappropriate stuffs.

Chapter End Notes

Every chapter I stray closer and closer to changing the rating of this fic

chapters.title: Chapter 33
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

This chapter contains Phainon's dream about giant titan Mydei

Mydeimos was enjoying some coffee during his lunch break when a few of his co-workers entered the room with their lunches in hands. They all sat in the same table as his, which he didn’t mind, then began chatting away while occasionally taking a bite of their lunch. They would often turn to Mydeimos to ask for his input on the topic they were talking about to which he replied honestly.

When Mydeimos finished his coffee, one of the co-workers that was scrolling through social media giggled at a clip then showed the other what she was looking at. The blonde man got pulled into staring at his co-worker’s phone. The clip showed a girl unboxing a fluffy tail, Mydeimos initially thought that it was for some kind of cosplay, but after inserting a battery into the tail the part where his co-worker was giggling came.

The tail was voice activated, wagging whenever she said anything, it was a short fluffy tail, so it was more of a wiggle than a wag. Through coincidental comedic timing, her lover entered the room after she tested it wagging. The girl then attached the tail to her lover’s back, watching it wagged whenever she made a noise. The man was wiping down the table, the tail wagged when she called him. The same thing happened two more times with the man washing the dishes and watching TV.

Everyone tried to hold in their laughter, Mydeimos included, when one person said they wanted to buy one as a prank since the tail had an adhesive base. Another wanted to buy one to stick it onto their lover. They turned to ask Mydeimos if he wanted one too so they could order it together. Cue the comedic timing of Phainon entering the room calling out to Mydeimos with his sing song happy voice, he pressed a kiss on the chimera hybrid’s head before walking over to the expresso machine. Phainon turned around when he heard Mydeimos say to their co-workers that he already had something and saw all of them covering their mouth trying to hold in their laughter.

Cipher had been telling Mydeimos that she hadn’t had anything to upload on her social media. Being a content creator himself, he made chimera animations anonymously, Mydeimos saw a golden opportunity. The chimera took out his phone and pressed record, aiming the camera at Phainon.

“Phainon” The wolf hybrid turned around, his relaxed tail began wagging slightly, smiling and posing when he saw Mydeimos holding up his phone. The blonde turned his flash on and off, pretending that he was taking a photo. Waiting for Phainon to turn his focus back to his coffee, Mydeimos saw his co-worker trying to get his attention. When he looked over two of them made a heart out of their hands, Mydeimos understood what they meant immediately and went for the second hit.

“Babe~” The tail that was slightly wagging before had double in speed as Phainon turned back with his eyes wide, pink blush on his face while a spoon was hanging off his mouth. Phainon trotted over like an excited puppy when Mydeimos held out his hand, his fingers forming half a heart. The wolf hybrid leaned down and smiled sweetly at the camera then completed the heart with his hand, winking at Mydeimos. Phainon then replaced his hand with his face, pressing it into the unfinished heart that his lover’s hand was making.

Mydeimos had to turn away from the cuteness to save his heart when Phainon nuzzled into his palm. The co-workers had then understood and joined Castorice on her battleship named Phaidei. Taking advantage of the unguarded Mydeimos, Phainon pulled him up and led him over to the expresso counter. The wolf hybrid turned to wink at his co-workers, putting his index finger on his mouth signaling them to not tell anyone.

“Phainon… We’re at work…” The chimera tried to look away from Phainon, his face was beet red when he heard their co-workers lock the door.

“Hmm? Am I not allowed to enjoy a cup of espresso at work now?” The wolf smug grin could still be seen from over the rim of his cup. He put down the cup to occupy his hands with holding Mydeimos’ sturdy waist, as he was leaning in for a kiss, a pair of hands on his chest stopped him from getting his treat. Phainon looked at Mydeimos with his confused puppy face, the chimera rarely rejected his advances, especially when they were alone. From what Phainon could guess by the look on the other’s face, it seemed like he had somehow made Mydeimos recall something unpleasant.

“Wipe your face, there’s espresso on your chin” The wolf hybrid wiped away the droplet instantly and was allowed to kiss his lover after that. Mydeimos wasn’t a clean freak, so it wasn’t unexpected that Phainon was curious about why the blonde acted like that

“Phainon, what kind of dream did you have last night?” The white-haired male froze when he heard the question. It was Phainon’s turn to cosplay as a tomato.

“I’m not going to judge you, honeycake. I’m just curious” After a bit of coaxing and bribing Phainon with kisses, the man finally gave in and told Mydeimos about his weird dream last night.

Phainon dreamed that he was some kind of fantasy protagonist, traveling the world to defeat the demigods for their coreflames. Dream Phainon was on his trusty horse, chasing after a moving fortress. After a short chasing sequence, the flying fortress stopped, its golden chains dropped to the ground acting like anchor keeping the place stationary. Those chains also acted as Phainon’s means of entering the fortress. As dream Phainon walked deeper inside the place, slaying marble statues that came to life, he finally got to the center of the moving city – the area. Floating above it was the giant sword that had taken down a huge part of the Sky Kingdom. Phainon recalled that his dream self was chanting something then a magic circle appeared under the giant sword.

“Demigod of Strife! With the signet ring of Strife as tribute, I hereby declare the Kremnos Festival had begun. I, Phainon, the hero who will bring this world into a new era, challenge you to a duel for the coreflame of Strife!”

Phainon still remembered clearly how the magic circle shone brilliantly when his dreamself threw some kind of ring into the center of the area. The giant sword resonated with the ring and the magic circle and emitted a blinding light. Dream Phainon shielded his eyes from the light and when he opened them again, the giant sword had disappeared and in its place was the demigod of Strife, the same size as the giant sword that he manifested from.

The demigod was wearing a simple red chiton with gold accents, a pair of gauntlets on his arms. The demigod of Strife was beautiful, his body seemingly carved by Kephale and blessed by Mnestia. Reality Phainon was making up a bunch of analogy to describe how beautiful the demigod was and Mydeimos was jealous until Phainon mentioned that the giant in his dream looked exactly like the blonde. The wolf then made grabby hands when he described the well gifted pectorals that could rival mountains raise by Georios. Dream Phainon was given to change to look at those pectorals up close when the demigod picked him up by his cape, the two were having some kind of conversation when the cape couldn’t hold dream Phainon’s weight and the knight was about to drop into the valley between those mounds.

That was when Phainon woke up without Mydeimos in his arms because the chimera was showering for some reason.

“My dear Phainon” The chimera held Phainon’s face in his hands, smiling sweetly up at him. “The reason why I was in the shower this morning was because…” Then he suddenly pinched and pulled Phainon’s cheeks.

“YOU DROOLED ALL OVER MY CHEST IN YOUR SLEEP!” So turned out Phainon wasn’t just drooling in his dream when faced with the tits of the titan Mydeimos. The wolf let out a pained whine, nursing the side of his face while the blonde unlocked the door and left to prepare for patrol.

Mydeimos originally intended to send the video of Phainon’s stages of tail wagging to Cipher, but he decided to keep the video to himself. Phainon’s cute gestures and loving gaze in that video belonged to him and only him, Mydeimos couldn’t stand the idea of some random strangers seeing what was solely his. Mydeimos possessive side didn’t want the internet to see Phainon’s adorable side, so he gave Cipher the video of him and Phainon’s picnic. The footage showed Phainon and Mydeimos sitting opposite of each other, Fig Stew sleeping in Mydeimos’ lap and Pienon pillowing his snout on his thigh. Phainon was strumming and humming on his guitar, then started singing

“Do you hear me? I'm talking to you

Across the water across the deep blue ocean

Under the open sky, oh my, baby, I'm trying…”

Mydeimos then continued the lyrics

“Boy, I hear you in my dreams

I feel your whisper across the sea

I keep you with me in my heart

You make it easier when life gets hard”

They were dueting a love song, their voices were harmonious and beautiful as they sang the ending together

“Lucky we're in love in every way

Lucky to have stayed where we have stayed

Lucky to be coming home someday”

With the power of two beautiful man and their beautiful voices, the video became Cipher’s most popular video. Half of the comment was swooning over their looks and voice while the other was sending well wishes for their relationship. No one at the Chrysos HQ would be surprised if some entertainment company wanted to recruit Phainon and Mydeimos as their talents.

Chapter End Notes

Not sure if anyone is interested but I have decided to pick up the unfinished 2nd chapter of Knight vs Dragon. I'm post it as an entire separate fic from it.

chapters.title: Chapter 34
chapters.html:
Everything has a limit. Mydeimos’ seemingly endless patience and indulgent for Phainon is one of them.

Phainon had made the mistake of trying to love a Mydeimos that had woken up on the wrong side of the bed that day. The wolf came up behind the chimera to hug him and was met with glare and hisses. If Mydeimos was a cat, Phainon would be receiving a bunch of rapid baps on his head. Thankfully, the wolf had another source of to charge his battery, it wasn’t as effective as burying his nose into his lover’s hair and took a whiff but it better than nothing.

Phainon’s other source of energy was the second closest thing to Mydeimos, Fig Stew – the orange chimera that everyone used to think that Mydeimos had given birth to due to how similar the two were. The wolf found his target sunbathing in the orchard; he approached the critter and gave it head and chin scratches. When Fig Stew began purring, Phainon flipped the chimera on its back. The wolf hybrid nuzzled into Fig Stew belly, kissing and blowing raspberry into it. The chimera had taken a wet bath the day before, so the smell of pomegranate was all over the critter making the process of charging Phainon’s battery 20% more effective.

The wolf’s energy was only charged 50% - according to Phainon himself, when he was yanked away from his chimera child. The complaint died on his tongue when he saw the culprit was Mydeimos with Vigethos securely held in his arm. The grey chimera jumped down just in time before Phainon jumped on Mydeimos, knocking him down on the grass. The blonde was still not in the mood for Phainon’s antics and tried to push him off, resulting in them wrestling and rolling around in the grass. Mydeimos underestimate how addicted Phainon was to his scent, was not prepared for the wolf to jump him. The blonde put up quite a fight but ultimately got his arms pinned above his head and instinctively bare his neck out for the man above him.  

“That’s a good kitty~” Embarrassment won over Mydeimos’ instinct to spoil Phainon and the wolf was yeeted across the yard after he whispered those words into the man under him. The blonde was already walking toward the HQ with the two chimeras nestled in his arms when Phainon got up.

It was quite a strange sight for the people in the neighborhood. Their favorite pair of lovers was keeping their distance with each other. The blonde man seemed to not be bothered by lack of hands on his body while the wolf hybrid was staring at his back like a guilty puppy, trailing behind him with his tail down. Mydeimos only gave his wet puppy a glance here and there, ensuring that the white-haired male was still doing his job. If someone paid really close attention, they would see Mydeimos stopping himself from reaching up to pet the other’s head. Phainon wasn’t paying much attention to his surroundings, his eyes glued to the other’s back, so his ears didn’t register the pitter patter of tiny feet running toward him and was tackled.

“Snowy!” Two voices said in tandem. Phainon blinked his eyes open to see two familiar heads of grey hair. It was the pair of twins he met nearly a year ago, as no one had ever referred to Phainon as that nickname. Being a responsible adult and policeman, Phainon stood up and scanned the area for a middle-aged brunette man frantically looking for the way too energetic kids. Thankfully, this time Welt was right behind the twins, the man lightly scolded the kids and apologized for their behavior. The twins, seeing what their guardian was doing, copied him and apologized for jumping on to Phainon. At least the wolf had somewhat understood how Mydeimos felt whenever he jumped on him.

Caelus and Stelle were flocking around Phainon one moment and the next they bolted towards Mydeimos when they turned around. The blonde was more prepared than Phainon, opening his arms to catch the twins, carrying them on each arm. Phainon was definitely not drooling over the way those biceps flexed and how Mydeimos effortlessly carried a 9-year-old kid on each arm. The wolf was too busy imagining the sight of coming home to his own children and an aproned Mydeimos saying the 3 famous lines to pick up on what the twins were whispering to his lover. Phainon was dragged out of his daydream by the collective gasps from Caelus and Stelle, then came the sound of children crying. Even Welt was perplexed toward his kids’ sudden mood swing. Mydeimos, being the angel that he was, trying to soothe the pair of crying twins on his arms, rocking them and asking why they suddenly cried.

“It’s *sniff* not fair! We f-found Mr. Pretty eyes first… Wahhh” Caelus stuttered out before bawling again.

“W-We wanted to marry *hic* Mr. Pretty eyes first! N-now S-snowy is going to m-marry him Ueueue” Stelle did the same thing as her twin brother.

Even Welt, who had years of experience dealing with the pair, was speechless. Trying to horde trash and talking to trash can was one thing, but the man had never ever heard they mentioned anything about wanting to marry Mr. Pretty eyes. The two had only seen Mydeimos once and that was when he wanted to say goodbye to Snowy the Samoyed puppy. The twin’s guardian was speechless while Mydeimos was stunned as Caelus and Stelle cried into his shoulders. As for Phainon, he had turned into a stone statue.

After a few minutes of soothing and coaxing the twins to calm down, Mydeimos lowered them to the ground and crouched down at their eyes level. The blonde pulled out his handkerchief to wipe away the tears on the children’s face. Phainon was not one to complete with children, yet his eyes couldn’t help but twitch as Mydeimos gave Caelus and Stelle a smooch on their cheeks.

“Now that you two had calm down. Mind if I ask why do you want to marry me? We’ve only met once before” The blonde asked after petting their hair.

“Cuz you’re pretty… and nice” Stelle said first, and Caelus followed with “Mmhm”. Mydeimos chuckled at their innocent words, glancing toward Phainon to see him totally not sulking at all.

“But Phainon is also pretty and nice right?” He asked and the twins turned to scrutinize every detail on the wolf hybrid’s face.

“He is… but not as beautiful and pretty as you!” Never had Phainon ever been so offended by something he 100% agreed with. Mydeimos’ eyes softened as he chuckled at the twins, he excused himself for a minute to type something on his teleslate. Phainon, with the advantage of being a tiny bit taller than his lover, was able to peak at the screen. A few second later, Tribios was video calling the blonde. Mydeimos picked up and greeted her then passed the device down to the curious racoons holding on to his pants. They happily greeted Tribios telling her that her was the same color as Himeko – Phainon and Mydeimos later learnt that she was also Caelus and Stelle guardian.

“So little Grayies, I have someone that you might want to meet” Tribios turned her camera towards Pienon, who tilted his head at the people inside the screen. The twins excitement was through the roof when they saw the Samoyed, waving at him through the teleslate. Mydeimos then leaned down and asked them if they still wanted to marry him and their answer was as he expected.

“We want to marry Miss Cool Hair!” Welt was once again speechless that Mydeimos had somehow figured out his twins’ real reason for their sudden interest in marriage. The middle-aged man made a mental note to monitor what the people at their daycare was teaching them, he had a strong suspicion that Kafka or Silver Wolf was the one that planted those ideas in the twins’ heads.

“So, does that mean I’m allowed to marry Mr. Pretty eyes?” Phainon walked over to stand next to Mydeimos, pulling the blonde closer to him by the waist. The twins just stared at Phainon as if he had grown a second head.

“You haven’t married Mr. Pretty eyes yet?”

“I thought Mr. Pretty eyes was mad at you for not proposing last time?”

Phainon had to explain to his lover what Caelus was referring to was related to the lipstick and perfume incident. Welt had to ask how the twin knew that the policemen were lovers, both Phainon and Mydeimos were surprised to know that the video of him doing the doggie trick where Pienon put his snout on his palm then it hard cut to Phainon’s face doing the same thing had gone viral outside of Amphoreus. Mydeimos showed Welt where the academy was on the map and told the twins that their Samoyed friend was working there. The two hybrids waved goodbye to the trio and returned to their patrol route.

Luckily for Phainon, Mydeimos’ mood had improved a little bit after encountering the twins. The chimera hybrid was happy enough to hook his tail around the wolf hybrid’s wrist. Even though Phainon wanted to hold hand, but after 8 hours of no touches from Mydeimos, the white-haired man was content enough with such a little touch. The chimera slightly flinched when the man behind him pressed a kiss on the tip of his tail. He turned around to pout at the wolf hybrid, his face slightly red. Phainon upon seeing that adorable expression on his lover’s face was unable to hold back and pulled him closer to kiss those pouty lips. Mydeimos looked away from shyness, glancing at Phainon once before looking away again.

The shyness from Mydeimos was not what Phainon was expecting, he was prepared for his lover to hiss at him like he did in the morning. Shy Mydeimos was so adorable, and it reminded Phainon about their first time a week after the blonde returned to the HQ and returned his feelings. The wolf was once again brought out of his daydream when Mydeimos lightly tapped his face. Their co-workers had arrived to take over their patrol for the day.

“Sorry for acting the way I did this morning” Mydeimos suddenly said as they walked back to the Chrysos Heir’s HQ, fidgeting with his hands.

“You don’t have to apologize, love. I shouldn’t say such a thing in front of the kid” Phainon got slapped by an orange tail, its owner was staring disapprovingly at him, stating that that wasn’t what he was talking about. The wolf gently took the tail into his hand and pressed another kiss on it, then moved to kiss Mydeimos’ lips. The chimera hybrid looked embarrassed when he asked about why the blonde was upset that morning.

“I had a dream that you read somewhere online that slapping your lover’s butt would make it more plum. You kept hitting my behind so often in that dream that it woke me up” That was an interesting dream that Mydeimos had had.

“Wow. The me in your dream was an idiot. Don’t worry, my golden honeycakes with extra honey! Your butt is the perkiest one I have ever had the honor of fondl- ack!”

That elbow to the stomach was well deserved. The chimera made the mistake of saying that he should try doing that to Phainon, to beef up his pancake butt. It had promoted Phainon to shamelessly say that he wouldn’t mind if Mydeimos wanted to spank him. During dinner that night, everyone was served a delicious beef stew while Phainon was given a plate of charred vegetables that were used to make the stew.  Mydeimos got even more annoyed when Phainon ate it, the blonde pulled his lover from the dinner table to the kitchen island, where a portion of mouth-watering beef stew was sitting.

Cipher made the grave mistake of walking in the kitchen, as her eyes saw Phainon slapped and squeezed her little brother’s butt while saying that he wanted cake as dessert. The cat hybrid made Phainon sat in the corner with a piece of paper sticked to his back that had “I’m a pervert” written on it. She also invited Mydeimos to have a sleepover with Castorice and Hyacine, the sleep over lasted 3 entire days and only stopped when Phainon signed a contract stating that he would limit the inappropriate stuff to the confine of his and Mydeimos’ room. There was a clause specifically stating that under no circumstances would Phainon touched or said inappropriate stuff when Fig Stew and Pienon and their chimera friend, Vigethos was in the same room.

chapters.title: Chapter 35
chapters.html:
Anaxa didn’t have a scheduled sleep schedule, the man could sleep and wake up during reasonable hour one day and the next Phainon would find him assembling a jigsaw puzzle when the wolf was talking his lover for their 2nd bath. During the mint-haired professor midnight to 3 A.M shenanigans, the one person that he had saw during those ungodly hours was Mydeimos. The mom-wife chimera hybrid, more often than not, was doing something for Phainon when Anaxa saw him fussing about in the kitchen. At 3 A.M.

That night, Mydeimos had a companion when Anaxa saw him in the lounge. The companion was none other than Phainon. The wolf’s face was scrunched up while pitifully groaning out his lover’s name. The blonde nodded at the professor to greet him then turned his attention back to frowning at Phainon while rubbing his exposed stomach. The sight was up there on Anaxa’s “Weird shenanigans Mydeimos was up to during ungodly hours” list.

Phainon was laying his head on Mydeimos’ lap while the blonde rubbed circles on his stomach. On the coffee table was a cup of hot tea and a heat pack. Out of the two hybrids, Anaxa hypothesized that the one more likely to have their period was Mydeimos, yet the one groaning and being taken are of was Phainon. The professor wondered if the lovers had something similar to the phenomenon of the husband getting morning sickness instead of the pregnant wife.

“Mydei… My stomach hurts…” Phainon groaned out when Mydeimos stopped rubbing at his stomach.

“It was your fault, HSK! Who in their right mind would sneak into the bathroom to eat half a tub of ice cream? Just because they’re low lactose doesn’t mean you could eat an entire tub during dinner then another half in the middle of the night! Were you seriously planning on eating the entire thing if I didn’t catch you red handed?” Mydeimos scolded the wolf hybrid, setting the heat pack on Phainon’s stomach. Anaxa was thankful that none of the scenarios in his head were correct. The professor was offered the ice cream that Phainon thankfully wasn’t able to finish. Thanks to a certain white-haired man, none of their friends were able to taste Mydeimos’ homemade ice cream.

The blonde ignored Phainon’s yelp as he stood up, letting the other’s head hit the couch and went to fetch the half-finished ice cream tub and scooped out some into a small bowl for Anaxa to try. The chimera hybrid assured the mint-haired man that this amount won’t give him a stomachache just to jab at Phainon’s suffering. When Anaxa tried a small bite, he was surprised at the hard and chewy texture of the ice cream. Compared to the one that he had eaten, this ice cream was creamier and more floral. All the characteristics of the ice cream was identical to the one from the neighboring country.

[Lets us all pretend that Amphoreus = Greece geological wise pls]

“Mydeimos, you’ll make a hefty amount of money if you sell this in Okhema” Anaxa said after taking another bite. Mydeimos just chuckled at his words and stated that he wasn’t planning on selling it as the people from the place it originated from might take offense that he used honey instead of sugar to make it healthier for his wolf hybrid boyfriend. The blonde didn’t forget to mention that despite making it with Phainon’s diet in mind, one shouldn’t eat one and a half tub of it in the same night.

“Mydei… I miss you…” Phainon sat up to anchor his chin on the back of the couch, staring at Mydeimos with his puppy eyes, pursing his lips out for the extra whiny boyfriend effects. Anaxa will be forever amazed as to how different Phainon acted when Mydeimos was around. No one would think that the man capable of scaring a gang leader shitless with just his stare alone and the happy smiley little thing cuddling up to Mydeimos’ side was the same person.  The same thing could be said for Mydeimos too. No one would believe that the hybrid that solo’d an entire underground casino full of criminals and the man gently carding his fingers through Phainon’s hair and kissing the frown on his face was the same person. Truly a power couple through and through.

“Drink your tea before its cold, HSK”

“Mydei, I want to eat pumpkin meat stew tomorrow”

“Pumpkin… Can you make Pumpkin Bean Casserole tomorrow, Mydeimos?” Anaxa suddenly said after Phainon mentioned a pumpkin dish. The blonde made a humming sound before getting up to check the communal fridge while Anaxa raised his eyebrow at the face Phainon was giving him. The chimera hybrid mumbled something about going out to buy more vegetables then turned and asked if Anaxa wanted the casserole for lunch or dinner. Phainon definitely wasn’t sad about how Mydeimos didn’t even acknowledge his craving and Mydeimos definitely did not notice how Phainon’s tail was dragging on the floor when they walked back to their room for a proper sleep.

The next morning, Phainon basically bolted out of the HQ after finishing his daily hygiene carrying Fig Stew and Pienon in his arms. The two critters was still groggy from sleep after being suddenly lifted up and carried out of their room by their papa. The morning joggers saw for a split second a blob of blurry white mass ran past them. Who would win in a sprint off? Cipher or Phainon when Mydeimos said they’ll go grocery shopping together after he took the kids to the daycare? The daycare in question was the police academy, and technically Fig Stew was supposed to stay at the police station, but the academy was closer. In Phainon’s defense, who was going to say no to having Fig Stew around for a day? Saying no to that was basically saying no to Mydeimos and Phainon had a tendency to take offense to that.

With Mydeimos’ good morning kiss as fuel, Phainon made it to the academy and dropped off Fig Stew and Pienon alongside their backpack, courtesy of Aglaea. The wolf gave each of the critter a smooch on their forehead, Pienon was as excited and enthusiastic as usual returning the smooch by licking Phainon’s face while Fig Stew absolutely hated it. To be fair, Mydeimos had the same reaction as Fig Stew when the wolf hybrid tried to kiss him after waking him up for their 2nd bath.

“Sorry kids, papa got a date to catch. Pie takes care of your brother, alright? Love you! I’ll convince mama to make your favorite tonight” And Phainon was gone after saying goodbye to the critters. Pienon stared at the hybrid’s retreating back then picked Fig Stew up with his mouth and carried the chimera to the teacher’s lounge. After successfully finding someone to keep an eye on Fig Stew, the Samoyed returned to where they were dropped off to pick up the backpacks. Tribios arrived at the academy and took Fig Stew and Pienon to the cafeteria to eat their breakfast. That day, many students and teachers alike were jealous of a chimera and a Samoyed after looking at the breakfast that Mydeimos had prepared for them.

At the same time, in a supermarket 30 minutes away from the academy, Phainon was enjoying his date with Mydeimos, holding hands and picking up grocery for everyone. Certified farmer boy Phainon had been entrusted with the task of picking the most delicious pumpkins for dinner, a task the wolf hybrid took extremely seriously. His eyes scanned through the selection of pumpkin looking for the ones without any bruises, feeling around to make sure the vegetable was hard all around and heavy enough for its size. With his heightened sense of hearing, tapping the pumpkin to check for ripeness. After a bit of scrutinizing the poor pumpkins that did not sign up for it, Phainon finally picked out two big, heavy and perfectly ripe ones.

With his spoil in tow, Phainon pushed the shopping cart to where Mydeimos was, unsurprisingly the chimera hybrid was looking at the pomegranates. The tail-icopter was activated when the blonde turned to affectionately bump his forehead against Phainon’s. What’s more adorable than your boyfriend wearing your hoodie out in public? Phainon’s answer would be seeing your boyfriend remembering and following what you have taught him about picking out the perfect pomegranate while wearing your hoodie because he liked your scent.

Everything was sunshine and rainbow until Mydeimos put a pre-packaged bag of green beans into the shopping cart, reminding Phainon about the craving he had been so wrongfully denied last night. As a green bean hater, Phainon was not happy seeing those green sticks in the shopping cart, staring at them as if they had offended him. The wolf hybrid was a little bit less upset after Mydeimos dropped the fattest head of cabbage into their cart and an assortment of seasonal vegetables. It was a simple gesture but one that made Phainon’s heart go doki doki.

“Titans… my lover is way too cute. I’m the luckiest wolf alive”

“Hm? You’re the cute one between us, though? Wagging your tail whenever you’re happy, adorable pouty face, big round sky-blue eyes, brilliant and charming smile, strong and reliable” Mydeimos then leaned in to press a quick peck on Phainon’s lips after rapid firing love arrows into the other’s heart

“A handsome lovable man with unlimited amount of love and affection to give. Who still loves me despite my flaws and ugly past. I’m the lucky one between us” The blonde continued with his love assault. Phainon was soaking up all the compliments like a sponge, his face turning the same shade as the cherry tomato in the cart. Between the two lovebirds, Phainon was often the one being more opened with his affection while Mydeimos reciprocated them through his service such as grooming Phainon’s tail and making his favorite food etc… It was an amusing sight for everyone in the Chrysos team to see Phainon short circuiting whenever Mydeimos was affectionate toward him. The wolf hybrid would have jumped the blonde right then and there if they weren’t in public.

“My boyfriend is trying to kill me” Phainon said, his hands covering his red face. The blush had spread to the tip of the wolf’s hybrid ears and neck.

“I often ask you the same thing whenever we have s-“ Phainon had to covered Mydeimos’ mouth before the blonde divulged something that shouldn’t be shared so openly.

“Where did I go wrong in loving you? What happened to my pure, innocent and shy Mydeimos?”

“Oh? I’m no longer cute?”

“Mydei, please shut up” Mydeimos let out a poorly hidden laughter at the tiredness in Phainon’s voice. The chimera hybrid decided to spare his lover and continued on grabbing items in their friends’ shopping lists.

Dinner that night was a feast. Anaxa got his Pumpkin Bean Casserole made with half a pumpkin and Phainon got his Pumpkin Meat Stew with the other half. Fig Stew and Pienon devoured the Feast-Gravy Roast Chicken together, leaving a bare chicken carcass which Mydeimos used to make a small pot of broth for their breakfast.

The day ended with everyone witnessing Anaxa’s maniacal laughter as he successfully tripled the size of the spare pumpkin through the power of alchemy. Aglaea shook her head in disapproval, asking the mint-haired professor what he was going to do with a giant pumpkin. Thankfully, three of Anaxa’s old students had taken care of dealing with the gigantic vegetable. Castorice and Phainon worked with the staff over at the police academy to treat the students there to a free lunch, a pumpkin theme lunch. Mydeimos helped Hyacine cut up the rest into small pieces and freeze dried them into treats for the chimeras at the Garden of Life.

Mydeimos single-handedly stopped another disaster when he stared disapprovingly at Phainon, who was on his way to Anaxa’s office while holding a head of cabbage.

chapters.title: Chapter 36
chapters.html:
Due to their line of work, accident was an inevitability, bound to happen eventually. That was what happened to Phainon during a raid on an underground drug den. A sprained ankle was better than a broken leg was what Phainon had said to a livid Mydeimos, the burning rage inside that cold glare was enough to make the yappiest mouth shut up. Anaxa had joined them during the raid and one look at the chimera hybrid’s face as he walked near the bunker in the drug den had the professor swiftly contacted Hyacine for an ambulance. For a bunch of people throwing stacks and stacks of cash for drug, they did not invest in a sturdy bunker door. Because of that the thick metal door was no match for Anaxa’s latest heating ray, a gadget that the man took inspiration from the battle gryphon from the Skyfolks. It didn’t even take a minute for Mydeimos to start throwing unconscious bodies out one by one. Anaxa was impressed by the amount of restrain the blonde had in him as he checked the unconscious’ vitals, other than a bruise and scratch here and there, there was no sign of serious injuries.

Ignoring Anaxa’s word to sit still, Phainon stood up and limped toward where the raging beast was. As he dragged his leg on the ground, the wolf hybrid stumbled over an unconscious addict’s leg causing him to fall forward. Instead of the ground, Phainon’s face was cushioned by soft, bouncy and warm skin as Mydeimos’ arms grabbed him. The blonde didn’t walk out completely injury free, he had a few sallow cuts on his tail, and someone had managed to cut open his bodysuit. As soon as Phainon saw where the suit was damaged, he quickly took off his outer coat to cover his lover. The cold gaze in Mydeimos’ eyes softened as Phainon fussed over the cuts on his tail, a smile tugged on his lips as he promised Phainon that he wouldn’t be so reckless again.

Hyacine arrived at the location with the ambulance and a familiar limo following behind. Before Phainon could question why Krateros was here, he was swept up into Mydeimos arms and carried him to Hyacine.

“Don’t pout. I’ll let you show off your skills and muscles next time.” Mydeimos patted Phainon’s head while Hyacine examined his ankle. The blonde seemed to contemplate something before leaning in to press a kiss on Phainon’s forehead. The wolf hybrid was monetarily distracted by the cute gesture, enough for Mydeimos to sweep him up into a bridal carry again.

“Shall we head back, my prince?” Boom tomato Phainon had appeared. Hyacine giggled at the heart eyes Phainon was giving Mydeimos as hand reached up to steady his heart. Meanwhile, Anaxa feared that Phainon was going to dislocate his tail if he kept wagging it like that.

“Woof…” Never had Hyacine and Anaxa ever seen Mydeimos laugh like that, full on laughing with his head tilted back. Little did Phainon know that he was going to be howling when the door to the limo closed as Mydeimos brought him to heaven with his mouth. The blonde had successfully sucked the life out of Phainon as the wolf hybrid was dead asleep when he carried him back to their room. Fig Stew and Pienon were a little sad and confused because Mydeimos refused to kiss them, only gave in after brushing his teeth. After the children had received their kiss tax, the chimera hybrid went to the infirmary and found the cold packs where Hyacine had told him. Following her instructions, the blonde felt around the pack for a disc then popping it to release the cooling agent. After shaking the bag a few times, he wrapped it in a towel then put in on Phainon’s swollen ankle. He left the room after putting a couple of pillows under the sprained ankle, Mydeimos needed to make some dinner for his two hungry babies and a plate of garlic butter salmon and mushroom for Phainon.

Pienon’s dinner was simple to prepare, Mydeimos simply gave him the other half of his breakfast meat patty and added some dried sardines and chopped fruits. Fig Stew’s food on the other hand… was a bit more complicated. Both Vigethos and Fig Stew had established that the chimera kibbles that the Garden of Life made tasted like broken hope and dreams. Anaxa had quite a laughter fit when Mydeimos straight up said that the scholar at the Garden were talented and knowledgeable on many things, cooking was not one of them. If the chimera living in the Garden was given the chance to study law, they would sue the shit out of the place. The milk formular for baby chimera was a work of art, nutritious and delicious luring the innocent babies into having expectation of getting similar thing when they grew up, only for that dream to be shattered as they took their first bite of the food pellets. As much as Mydeimos wanted to spoil his Fig Stew with real food, the kibbles still contained minerals that chimeras needed to maintain their mane, scales, horns and claws.

As Mydeimos had expected, Fig Stew was looking up at him with his large glassy and teary eyes when it was presented with a bowl of kibbles. The chimera began pawing and awo-ing at his mama, then looking at the plate of salmon on the counter then at Mydeimos.

“I know baby. You don’t like the kibbles, but mama had no other choice, hun” The blonde picked the chimera up and caress its tiny tail, which was missing a few scales here and there. Not a lot was missing but enough to make Mydeimos worried. Fig Stew, seeing how sad his mama was gathered up its wills and ate all the kibbles, they tasted terrible but seeing his mama smiled and no longer worried was worth it. Since the chimera was such a good boy, it was only fair that Mydeimos gave Fig Stew a treat. The blonde opened the freezer and took out a blueberry popsicle, it’s not like Phainon would even notice his stash was missing one.

Mydeimos picked Fig Stew up and set it on the kitchen island, then he held the popsicle for the chimera to enjoy the cool treat, licking the frozen treat then lapping up the droplets that had dripped on Mydeimos’ hand. Cipher entered the kitchen to heat up the convenience store food she had just bought and saw the cute scene, her nose sensed another viral clip coming to the Tok. The cat hybrid got tricked into babysitting Pienon and Fig Stew while Mydeimos left to do lovey-dovey couple stuffs with Phainon.

“Wake up, sleepy head. Eat your dinner while its still hot” Mydeimos gently shook Phainon’s shoulder then change tactic and pinched both of his cheeks. The pinching seemed to be the most effective way to wake Phainon up. The blonde helped his grumpy boyfriend sat down at the coffee table, kissing the side of his head when he began digging into his food. The white-haired hybrid asked if Mydeimos had already eaten his dinner, a question that he shouldn’t ask while chewing on his food.

“Oh. I already had my dinner earlier” Phainon almost choked his food when Mydeimos said that then winked at him with a mischievous smile. “I tried Moussaka for the first time, it was delicious. Now I know what to make whenever the eggplant is in season”

“Stop with the innuendo! You need to stop hanging out with Cipher. She’s corrupting my innocent boyfriend!”

“What innuendo? You asked what I have for dinner, and I gave you the answer” Mydeimos teased the albino pufferfish next to him, taking the abandoned fork to break off a piece of salmon. The pufferfish deflated in favor of opening his mouth, letting the blonde fed him. Phainon continued eating his dinner while Mydeimos prepare for his and Phainon’s bath. The chimera hybrid walked out of the bathroom right in time to catch his gluttonous boyfriend licking all of the mushroom sauce on the plate. The blonde sigh fondly while shaking his head at Phainon’s awkward laugh. It seemed like Mydeimos was in a teasing mood that night as he crouched down next to Phainon, leaning in and licking the sauce sticking on the corner of the other’s lips.

Phainon had a pink tint on his cheek when Mydeimos licked off the sauce, he was bright red when the blonde swept him up in his arms and carried him into the bath. The wolf hybrid was enjoying the best bath he had that month. The hot water was working wonder on his muscles; his head was cushioned on his lover’s voluptuous chest while listening to his beautiful voice humming to the song playing in the background. Despite waking up from a nap earlier, Phainon was getting sleepy from the fingers that massaging the shampoo into his hair. The wolf had a full body shudder when Mydeimos moved to massage his ears

“Brace yourself. I’m pouring water on your head”

Phainon was so glad that Mydeimos had the foresight of sending Fig Stew and Pienon away because the noise he was making, while his lover’s talented hands massage his back and work out the tension knots, was not suitable for children’s ears. Mydeimos’ sexy chuckle was not helping Phainon’s situation down below. The wolf was not kidding when he said Mydeimos was very talented with his hands. The chimera hybrid was able to cook up Michelin star meals for Phainon every day, those same hands knew exactly where to scratch when petting his head, now he was receiving the best massage from those delicate and beautiful hands.

Cipher came by to drop off the kid right after Mydeimos had set Phainon on the bed, the chimera was fluffing up some spare pillows for Phainon’s ankle to rest on.

“You don’t have to worry about Fig Stew’s tail anymore, little prince. Your big sis got chu. I brought the little treasure to Hyacine when she got back, and she said that there is a supplement power for that specific issue at the Garden. No more kibbles that taste like broken hope and dream for my little nephew”

Phainon being the goody two shoe between the two, had Cipher promised that she would not rope Mydeimos into stealing the power from the Garden of Life.

chapters.title: Chapter 37
chapters.html:
Chapter Summary

Author got invited to 3 marriage party in a week, so the word "marriage" is going to appear a lot in this chapter.

Phainon had noticed Mydei had been doodling on his tablet for quite some time after they got off work. He had tried to peak at his lover’s work but was quickly shoo’ed away to keep him suspend and curious to what the blonde was going to post on his chimera memes Tok account. But this time, Mydeimos didn’t mind that Phainon was peaking at his drawings as the wolf already knew what he was working on. Due to the similarity between Fig Stew and one of the chimeras in his animated clips, many had suggested that they should do a collab. Of course, the people lack the knowledge of the person behind chimerameme-meries was actually Fig Stew’s mama.

Mydeimos was in a doodling mood that day and offhandedly said that he was going to print some chimera stickers for funsie, that was when Phainon mentioned their fan’s wish for a collab between them. The wolf hybrid’s ears drooped down when Mydeimos mentioned that they don’t have enough time in the day to manage a website and package all of the stickers. The blonde stopped his pen for a second then turned to look at his lover.

“Well, there is another way”

That was how Mydeimos came up with a special drink combo for Krateros’ café. The combo includes a medium size coffee and a portion of chimera shaped cookies; the set came with a chimera sticker as freebie and a stamp. If the customer collected 3 stamps, then they could exchange them for either a free bag of chimera shaped cookies or an entire chimera stickers sheet. Of course, the stamps were limited to one per person per day.

The entire setup was mainly for their followers to have the chance to get their hands on the sticker of Fig Stew and Pienon drawn by chimerameme-meries. Both Phainon and Mydeimos didn’t expect that their regulars would order the combo every time after their first. Everyone said a lot of positive things about the new additions, about how cute and high quality the sticker was and how delicious and adorable the cookies were.

To stay true with the premises of a collab, Fig Stew and Pienon spent a few hours at the café during the last two days of the collab. Fig Stew was thriving on all of the attention from customers, even went out of his way to pose for pictures while Pienon was enjoying all the pets he could ever wanted. Not only were their customers hanging around to play with the critters, but they were also waiting for a specific time after the tiny celebrities had eaten their lunch.

Fig Stew and Pienon, after playing around for a little while, began getting sleepy as one after the other yawned. The two no longer care or notice the sudden appearance of a bunch of cameras recording their sleepy faces walking around to look for their parents. Fig Stew found Phainon first and tapped his leg with its paws asking to be held while Pienon went over to Mydeimos and flopped down next to him. The blonde man chuckled at the sudden switched up but still leaned down to smooch the Samoyed then gathered the doggo up in his arms and took it to the staff’s lounge. On the other corner of the shop, Phainon was holding back his tears of joy as he held and rocked Fig Stew to sleep then made his way to the staff area too. When the wolf entered the lounge, Mydeimos had already set Pienon down on his dog bed. He carefully set Fig Stew down next to the Samoyed smiling when the chimera cuddled up and buried itself in his brother’s floof.

“Look at our children. So cute” Phainon sat down on the couch nearby with Mydeimos, leaning over to kiss his cheek.

“Want another one?” Mydeimos teased his lover, grabbing Phainon’s hand to put it on his stomach. The action reminded Phainon of a certain event in the past.

“Tempting. Ask me about that a few more years later, preferably 3 years after we’re married. I still haven’t had my fill of your attention” Phainon moved the hand that was on Mydeimos’ stomach to hold his lover’s chin, pulling him into a kiss. The look on Mydeimos after he mentioned marriage was too cute to not kiss. Given how loving Phainon and Mydeimos were with each other, many were surprised that they weren’t married.

“So… I’ll take it that you’re dating my son Mydeimos with marriage in mind then?”  Krateros sudden appearance spooked Phainon into scrambling to the other side of the couch. The butler leveled him with a look that said, “you’ve done unspeakable thing in my limo and now you’re embarrassed over getting caught kissing?” Phainon awkwardly chuckled while tapping the tip of his index fingers against each other. The wolf glanced at his lover, who was smiling sweetly at his adorable reaction, then took a deep breath and stood up to stand in front of Krateros.

“Yes. I want to marry Mydeimos in the future. Please give me permission to ask for his hand in marriage!” Phainon gave the butler a deep bow, Krateros looked the wolf hybrid up and down before busting into laughter.

“Raise your head, boy. The young master can marry anyone he wants, as his butler I have no say in such matter” Krateros gave Phainon a few firm slaps on his shoulder then returned to his work. The wolf narrowed his eyes at the tiny giggle that Mydeimos failed to contain, running over to hug Phainon from behind when he started walking towards the door. Phainon could feel the vibration from his lover’s laughter on his back, his face becoming redder and redder as time went on. The blonde moved to stand in front of Phainon, leaning in to kiss away the frown on his face. Mydeimos’ offer to let him nap on his lap was too enticing for Phainon as the wolf immediately draped the chimera hybrid over his shoulder like a potato sack and carried him over to the couch.

Phainon was fast asleep and content with his cheek squished against his lover’s thighs when Aglaea entered the lounge. The wolf stirred awake when Mydeimos reached over to take the bags that Aglaea was handing him. Due to how he was laying on his side, all Phainon saw was Mydeimos’ stomach and half the ceiling if he glanced up. Not knowing that his boss was in the room, the wolf brazenly lifted his lover’s shirt and pressed kisses on his stomach.

“I certainly hope that you’re not pregnant, Mydeimos”

“Mydei… I told you earlier… Give me like… 7 years of having you to myself… then we’ll think about kids” Phainon said, still groggy from waking up. It took a few moments, moments that Phainon spent kissing his lover’s belly, for him to realize that it wasn’t Mydeimos that asked the question. The wolf hybrid robotically and slowly turned around to see Aglaea sitting in the armchair opposite of him. Phainon immediately shot up into a proper sitting position and scooted away to the other side of the couch, then realized what he had done to Mydeimos’ shirt and slid back to fix it then moved back to the other side of the couch.

“7? I thought you said 3 after we’re married” Mydeimos teased

“Oh? You’re planning on proposing on the 1st anniversary then?” Aglaea joined in, she then asked to have the chance to design their wedding outfits which Mydeimos had agreed to. Phainon couldn’t tell if they were serious or still teasing him.

The two blondies decided to spare Phainon and returned to their business. Mydeimos opened the bag and took out multiple stacks of cups with a new design. Instead of the usual light orange paper cup with red lid, the new ones that Mydeimos was holding were blue with a white silhouette of a chimera on one side and a puppy on the other, the lid was the same shade of white with a blue coffee stopper. Phainon curiously asked about the sudden change in cups, Mydeimos only looked at him a gave him a smile, the exact same smile that resulted in Phainon wearing a maid dress.

Before Phainon could escape his lover and possibly Aglaea’s scheme, Castorice walked in conveniently blocking his only escape. The purple hair girl was rocking a new stylish outfit. A white overcoat with two deer heads button at the end, a white long sleeve sweater with cutouts on both shoulders, decorated with a golden deer brooch on the neck paired with a short light gray plaid skirt with a dark blue belt that had purple butterflies’ patterns at the end. Castorice even accessorized her accessory as the belt had a thin double band hanging from it. The light blue head band and dark blue purse perfectly compliment her outfits

“You look lovely Cas”

“Thank you, Mydeimos. I’m here to fight for the role of your maid of honor” Phainon was beginning to suspect that everyone was messing with him.

“I can’t believe my bestie would betray me like this. Do y’all have some kind of telepathy or something?! How come everyone is teasing me about marriage?!” Phainon pouted, cuddling up to Mydeimos and demanded for head pats as compensation from the chimera hybrid. Castorice pulled out a small notebook from her purse and wrote down a few things then sat down next to Mydeimos.

“I don’t mean to offend, Phainon. But judging on how gloomy and depressed you were when Mydeimos left, everyone was quite surprised that you didn’t propose the moment he returned” The girl picked up the new cup and inspected it, smiling when Mydeimos said she could keep a few if she wanted. Aglaea cleared her throat when Phainon was getting overboard with his PDAs. Innocent kisses was something she could tolerate, Phainon pulling Mydeimos to sit sideway on his lap to sniff at his cleavage was not. Aglaea really needed to have a chat with Mydeimos about his nonchalance and indulgence towards anything that Phainon did to him.

Thankfully, Mydeimos was a good parent first and Phainon’s enabler was second. The chimera hybrid immediately went over to Fig Stew went the small critter called out for his mama. Mydeimos carefully detangled Fig Stew from the Samoyed fur, then let the chimera lay on its back in one of his arms.

“Fully grown chimera my ass” Phainon said under his breath, annoyed that his version of “catnip” left his lap. The wolf puffed up his cheek when he saw his lover moving Fig Stew to lay over his shoulder then gently tapped its back until the chimera let out a burp. His chimera son had the audacity to fall asleep right after stealing Mydeimos’ attention. Thanks to his obviously souring mood, no one was surprised when Phainon refused to wear whatever outfit that was in the bag Aglaea handed him. When in doubt call Mydeimos as they always say when Phainon was part of the problem.

Mydeimos set the sleeping Fig Stew on Aglaea’s lap then slowly, step by step, walked toward Phainon. It was quite amusing to see Phainon take a step away whenever Mydeimos took a step towards him. The very slow game of cat and mouse continued for a few moments before it ended with Phainon cornered against the wall. The chimera crowded the wolf’s space, trapping him against the wall with one hand next to his head. Castorice watched in batted breath as Mydeimos lifted his other hand to slowly unbutton his shirt. The blonde chuckled at how fast Phainon eyes moved to watch his hand. After undoing the first two buttons, Mydeimos lifted Phainon’s chin up so the wolf was staring into his eyes. The white-haired man was too easy to predict, Mydeimos chuckled lowly as Phainon closed his eyes when he leaned in but unfortunately for the eager wolf a kiss wasn’t what his lover had in mind. The chimera slightly leaned up to lightly blow at the inside of Phainon’s ear, making his breath hitch. The two women in the room saw Mydeimos whispering something in his lover’s ear, the moment that he was done, Phainon face turned bright red and collum of steam rise from his head. Castorice took a deep breath to stop herself from fujoing out when she saw the slightest peak of Mydeimos’ tongue when he decided to kiss the life out of Phainon.

Phainon’s legs turned into jelly after the short make out session, slowly sliding down the wall when the chimera hybrid walked away to grab Phainon’s new clothes. Mydeimos was winning big that day, Phainon had admitted that marriage was very much on the table, he got to tease the fuck out of his lover, was able to make out with Phainon and got to see his lover in a new outfit.

Phainon walked out of the restroom looking like Amphoreous next top model. Mydeimos was unfortunate that the only person he saw during his first 20 years of life was Eurypon, so past Mydeimos didn’t really have any preferences on how his future lover would look like if past Mydeimos ever got the chance to step outside. Nowadays, Mydeimos’ standard was through the roof thanks to Phainon pretty face being the 2nd person the chimera had ever laid eyes on. The wolf hybrid was already a Mydeimos magnet with his usual simple white T-shirt and dark blue jeans outfit. The blonde had almost blurted out something extremely inappropriate when he saw Phainon wearing a suit for one of their fancy dinner dates, let’s just say Phainon got extra dessert that date.

The moment Phainon walked out wearing a white suit with the shirt unbuttoned to show off the black turtleneck Mydeimos’ eyes were already feasting. Back then there was something called a virgin killer sweater, now we have a Mydeimos-impregnation-trench coat. The moment Phainon put on the blue trench coat, Mydeimos was already hearing wedding bells in his head. The wolf’s hybrid broad shoulders got even more accentuated with the coat, if Mydeimos was a lesser man he would have thrown himself at Phainon so his lover would hold him bridal style and take him straight to the wedding altar.

To no one’s surprise, the chimera hybrid was enjoying himself immensely while helping Phainon put on his accessories. Mydeimos was hitting the jackpot that day as he got to help Phainon put on his leather thigh strap. The same could be said for Phainon, the wolf was in heaven as he watched his reserved lover drooling for his new look. The wolf was already thinking about booking a hotel after the kabedon, Mydeimos pulling his thigh strap and letting go for it to snap against his pants had finalized his decision, the hotel got upgraded to a love hotel. Phainon didn’t know what had cause his tsundere cat to be so bold that day, but he wasn’t complaining.

Aglaea and Mydeimos had explained to Phainon what the new outfits was for after Castorice finished his make-up. It was just a simple touch up with eyeliners to accentuate his blue eyes and some lip gloss for him to woo his lover. Mydeimos had decided to release a new cup style for the collab, Phainon and Castorice would help with handing the customer their orders. The new outfits were Aglaea and Cipher’s suggestions, Aglaea wanted to attract more customers by getting their attention with the beautiful outfit while Cipher told Mydeimos that he needed to capitalize on Phainon’s face card.

The moment Phainon and Castorice walked out, the entire café exploded. The sounds of fan girling and fan boying, unfortunately woke both Fig Stew and Pienon up from their nap. The entire internet was on fire that day, Amphogram was filled with pictures of people holding a chimera cookie, pictures of Castorice playing and holding Fig Stew, pictures of Phainon in his new outfit. On the Tok, everyone was uploading clips of either Phainon and Castorice delivering the drinks to tables, clips of Fig Stew and Pienon playing around, clips of the hot blonde barista, clips of the same hot blonde barista but the camera got block by a certain wolf hybrid halfway through. The most viral clip was from a girl recording her friend asking Phainon to sign the cup, to which the handsome wolf hybrid had declined, smiling brightly while saying:

“Sorry, but the only thing I planed on signing from now on is a marriage certificate with my soulmate” Phainon then took out a bag of chimera cookie from his coat pocket and gave the girls some as apology for not signing the cup. The same user then uploaded another clip of Phainon getting caught stealing cookie from the hot blonde barista.

Safe to say the collab was a huge success.

chapters.title: Chapter 38
chapters.html:
None of them knew how long the criminal had been working behind the scenes, planning and orchestrating an illegal auction house large enough to catch the attention of the Chrysos Heir. The bastard intentionally let Cipher see the large amount of combat mechs being delivered to the auction house, making Aglaea send both Phainon and Mydeimos to accompany Tribios on her undercover mission. The hybrids were dressed and acted as Tribios’ bodyguard while the woman infiltrated the auction place as a patron.

All three of the Chrysos Heirs were stunned when the auction began as they pushed out a display case with a vial of red liquid inside.

“Ladies and gentlemen, feast your eyes on Castrum Kremnos’ most powerful physical enhancer. This is the only vial you’ll find in the entire world as its creator – Eurypon is now locked behind bars” The masked auctioneer proudly said. He then forced the audience to hear his history lecture, going on about how the Strife family got their name because of their bloodline.

The mortal Gnaeus after ascending to God hood, becoming the Titan of Strife – Nikador, had blessed his 5 descendants with inhuman strength and power. Said descendants, one after the other, took up the mantle of being the demigod of Strife. But as the reign of Titan and demigod was nearing its end, the last one in line to become the demigod of Strife abandoned his duty to live the rest of his mortal life with his lover. Tales said that the blessing of Strife had been passed down to the last descendant’s progenies as they possessed inhuman strength. The progenies then build a kingdom for themselves, a kingdom that proud itself on its military power. The first dynasty of Castrum Kremnos.

“The kingdom of patricide is no more, yet the royal bloodline still continued till this day, with the last being Eurypon” Phainon had to force himself not to yawn at the unprompted lecture. On the other hand, Mydeimos was extremely intrigued with the yapping as his bastard of a father never told him anything about the outside world. All three Chrysos Heirs snapped their attention toward the vial when the auctioneer revealed that the vial contained DNA of the progenies that founded Castrum Kremnos – Gorgo. Eurypon’s madness and thirst for power truly had no end.

As the trio were about to act, all the lights went out striking panic among the bidders. The place must have set off an EMP as all of electronic devices, including the Chrysos Heirs’ earpieces, went out. Tribios asked Phainon and Mydeimos to cover her, take care of the guards and guide her to the vial. The two hybrids strung into actions, watching each other’s back while keeping an eye on the red hair woman. Thanks to their night vision and strength, it took no time for all three of them to reach the stage. The men helped the lady climb up the stage, to their surprises, the vial was still in its display case. Sensing something was not right, the hybrids stepped in front of Tribios, shielding her from whatever scheme the auctioneer had come up with.

All of their attention turned to the sound of clapping as one of the stage lights turned on, illuminating where the mask auctioneer was standing. His sickening laughter grated both Phainon and Mydeimos’ ears as they growled at him.

“Well, well, well~ If it isn’t Eurypon’s precious son. Or should I say Experiment Polemos600-A? Came here to reunite with your other half?” Another round of laughter from the masked man when he saw the confusion on the blonde hybrid and the anger from the wolf.

“My, my, my~ Surely you didn’t think that you’re the only thing that madman was working towards for half of his life? You really think that after you were born, that that psychopath stopped his experiments and research? Fools. His ultimate goal wasn’t a failure of an experiment like you, resurrecting a dead titan is. Genius that he was, yet he still didn’t listen to my advice. His mistake was letting you be born instead of taking the fetus and nurture it inside his lab, forcing it to develop without ever knowing that it was a living being. You are nothing but a vessel to host the resurrected Nikador”

Phainon couldn’t control his anger anymore as he lashed out to strike at the masked man but was immediately incapacitated because of his hidden taser. Unfortunately for the man, he wasn’t able to act as Tribios fired a dart dipped with anesthesia. Before he could drop to the floor, Mydeimos’ tail had already made contact with his ribs, knocking him off the stage.

“Mydeimos! The vial is gone”

The blonde hybrid turned to see an empty display case. His eyes were darting around to find who had taken it but stopped and turned his attention to Phainon. The wolf hybrid groaned as he struggled to get up as the muscles in his legs were still contracting from the electric pulse. When Mydeimos knocked the auctioneer away, the force of his colliding with the seat must have broken the EMP emitter as Anaxa was able to contact them again. Krateros and his men had dropped everything at the café and headed towards their location the moment Aglaea relayed what Tribios had seen at the auction.

The three were occupied with reporting what had happen, Mydeimos fussing over Phainon that they didn’t notice the masked man getting up. The bastard stood up, brushing off the dart that was sticking onto his bulletproof inner vest.

“I hope your next life isn’t as tragic as this one, useless doll” The man mumbled out as he took out the tranquilizer filled with the red liquid. Not even half a second after he raised the firearm and aimed, the sound of a gun firing echoed throughout the place. The hybrids turned to where the source was to see Krateros with his pistol aimed at where the masked auctioneer landed.

Eurypon, due to the interference of the Kremnos’ military had his execution delayed, was brought out for interrogation. Upon being questioned about Project Polemos600, the man was surprisingly cooperative.

“Turning Nikador into Kremnos’ ultimate weapon was indeed the plan. But I abandoned it long ago. I don’t have time or interest to resurrect a pawn that I cannot control. As for experiment Polemos600-B or that red vial you mentioned, it doesn’t play any part in helping humanity to resurrect a titan” Before Aglaea could continue, Phainon’s voice played through the speaker demanding that the scientist explained why the masked man wanted it to inject Mydeimos with that red serum. The blond woman pinched the bridge of her nose, judging by how out of breath the wolf hybrid was, he must have just finished interrogating the masked auctioneer and bolted straight to their room.  The mic inside the observation room picked up on a pained yelp from Phainon then came an apology from a lower voice, which Aglaea figured it was Mydeimos.

The door to the room Aglaea and Eurypon opened and Mydeimos entered with Phainon right behind him, the wolf’s face had a red spot from where his lover had pinched him. The chimera had to hold Phainon back from jumping Eurypon when the man remarked that Mydeimos should check his body fat percentage. None of the blonds in the room expected Phainon to grab Mydeimos’ waist to turn him around, his back facing Eurypon. The wolf hybrid then crouched down to caress the undersize of his lover tail, lifting it up slightly.

“Watch what you’re saying old man. Can’t you see how plump and fat his tail is? That’s the sign of a well-fed and happy chimera! Oh, wait a minute, you don’t know that you dead beat of a father! Do you know how hard it was to spike his milk with just the right amount of sugar so he wouldn’t notice? Mydei’s body was still as mouth watering as the first time I see it and his physic could even rival Kephale’s built!”

The whole thing was too amusing to the scientist that he didn’t even mention that he was hinting towards Mydeimos’ chest measurement increasing. Phainon was understandably quiet after Mydeimos camel clutched him, sitting down like a guilty puppy while hugging his tail close to his chest when his lover threatened to shave it if he didn’t sit still. With the source of her headache taken care of, Aglaea opened the file the blonde hybrid handed him, a record of everything that the masked man had said during the interrogation. In Mydeimos’ opinion it was more like coercion due to how Phainon looked like he was ready to kill the man at any second during the entire two hours. The man quickly spilled everything when Phainon slammed his hand on the thick metal table with his claws digging into it.

Imagine Aglaea surprise when Eurypon flat out said that none of the thing the other man said were real. There was no dead ancestor DNA inside the red serum. There was no such thing as Mydeimos becoming a perfect vessel if he got injected with the serum. Most importantly, Eurypon had abandoned Project Polemos600 long before Gorgo was pregnant. Aglaea then showed Eurypon all the documents and reports for said project, with the latest entry from 5 years ago mentioning how the serum would cause red patterns to appear on the chosen vessel’s body. The old scientist took a glance at it and look straight into Aglaea’s eyes and said:

“That was the entry on how Pol-… Mydeimos’ body reacted with his medicines. Don’t bother trying to remember, boy. I had you take it nasally, breathing in the medicine fume while you were sleeping. Even though I was a force to be reckon during my military days, I’m not arrogant enough to fight a genetically made killing machine”

Phainon couldn’t help his curiosity and opened his mouth, asking why Mydeimos was reacting like he did in the entry and why he needed medicine in the first place.

“The fool that got his hand on the serum was correct on one thing. I did not stop researching. Think of it as a bastard husband trying to complete the promise he had made with the woman that he killed. Because of Gorgo’s interference, Mydeimos was born with a defect in his DNA. That defect made it so that he couldn’t asexually reproduce or in simple words, clone himself. Because of that the child no longer had any use for the Kremnos’ military”

“Can we skip the lore please? I’m getting hungry… Ack! Mydei, what was that for?!” The chimera hybrid wacked the back of Phainon’s head with his tail, as he gestured for Eurypon to continue.

“Gorgo and I had promised to each other that we would do anything to let our child live his best life. I know what I’ve done after all those years was anything but that, but a Kremnoan never goes back on his words. Because of your mother, your dominant genes became lioness and human but unfortunately for you…

Your life span wasn’t as long as human. It got shortened because of the lioness’ DNA. That serum was what had kept you alive beyond the 16-year life span of lioness. Fate was known to be cruel, the day that I was supposed to give you the perfected serum was the same day that you were rescued”

Both Phainon and Mydeimos were stunned after hearing what the man had revealed. The two shared the same thought that the man was lying, only to be hit with Aglaea’s confirmation that he was in fact telling the truth. Eurypon then revealed that the auctioneer was one of the sponsors for the Nikador resurrection project and that his men came to raid the lab after the scientist had been arrested. The man wasn’t wrong when he said that the vial that he got his hand on was a physical enhancement serum as it sole purpose was to help Mydeimos healthy and extend his life span.

“I have fulfilled my promise with your mother, Mydeimos. It is your choice whether or not to take the medicine. It will let you live a normal human life span but the side effect will cause crimson patterns to appear on your skin as if you were born with it. Now that I’ve provided you with all the information I have, I would like to go back to my cell, lady Aglaea. I’m an old man, my back can no longer endure sitting on a hard chair for hours. And dinner time is almost here, can’t miss my favorite plate of gray prison slop”
