The old man was escorted back to his cell by Phainon. The wolf didn’t know what to say to Eurypon, his mind was stuck on whether or not he should consider Eurypon his future father-in-law. The mischievous part of his brain was telling him to piss off Eurypon by recalling how cute and adorable Mydeimos was when they finally shared a proper kiss or describing their first heated make-out session. The wolf hybrid wondered how the older man would react if he knew about that one time he almost became a grandfather, almost thanks to the miracle of plan B pill. Phainon got his ears chewed out by a very upset Hyacine and Cipher after that.  Fortunately, or unfortunately – defend of who you’re asking, they reached Eurypon’s cell before Phainon could voice his intrusive thoughts. The wolf wasn’t given enough time to reach as Eurypon hit him with a leg swept.

“That was for inappropriately groping my son’s tail in front of me. Tell Mydeimos to surround himself with things he can find comfort in when taking the finally dose of his medicine as it going to burn where the mark appeared”

Which pretty much implied that Mydeimos was going to feel pain all over his body. Phainon got up and locked the cell door before bolting out of the prison to find the chimera hybrid. He found his lover waiting for him in the parking lot, leaning over the limo while reading some kind of document. That document just happened to be Eurypon diary during the time Mydeimos was born. The chimera hybrid was slightly proud of his baby-self for making the first 2 years of his life worse than hell for Eurypon. Phainon took the paper out of Mydeimos’ hands and put it on top of the limo. He then guided the blonde’s arms to wrap around his shoulders while his sneaked down to caress his lover’s waist. Phainon leaned in to steal a kiss from Mydeimos, a soft and gentle press on the other lips.

“I wasn’t able to tell Eurypon about how I almost gave him a grand kid” Phainon’s limo privilege was revoked after that and have to call a cab to get back to the HQ.

Phainon returned to everyone running around grabbing their pillows and blankets to put inside his and Mydeimos’ room, where Cipher and Anaxa were busy building a giant fort out of the stuff. Inside the bathroom, Aglaea and Tribios were setting up an ice bath, with candles scattered around the room for some aroma therapy. The wolf hybrid headed to the outdoor orchard after Cipher told him where his lover was. Mydeimos was sitting in the gazebo enjoying a cup of tea with Fig Stew and Pienon accompanying him. On the table was an assortment of the chimera’s favorite desserts that Krateros and his men had bought. Truly a well spoiled and pampered princess, Phainon thought to himself as he walked over to the blonde, getting down on one knee to gently took Mydeimos’ hand in his to press a kiss on it.

“Good afternoon, my one and only princess. Your knight is here to escort you and the children back to our newly constructed pillow fort” Phainon looked over to the two critters pawing at his leg, smiling when he saw Pienon and Fig Stew each holding a flower in their mouth. His tail started wagging when Mydeimos reached down to take the flower in Pienon’s mouth and set it beside one of his ear, the wolf of course also reciprocated the action with the Fig Stew’s flower. Phainon, acting upon the knowledge he read in one of Castorice’s books, held out his elbow for his lover to hook his arm in and lead him back into the HQ with Fig Stew and Pienon following them.

When they got back to their room, everyone including Krateros was waiting for them inside the fort that Cipher and Anaxa had expertly made. Cipher patted the empty space between her and Hyacine, smiling widely as she gestured to two lovebirds to sit down. The mischievous cat then pulled out a empty bottle and roped everyone into playing truth or dare. Cipher started first and the bottle stopped at Aglaea, and the blonde woman chose truth.

“Boo boring. Had Fig Stew and Pienon ever ruined your project while playing in your office?” The two mentioned critter was enjoying pets from Castorice and Tribios when Cipher asked the question. After hearing it both of them ran over to hide inside the blanket that Phainon and Mydeimos were sharing, poking their head out from under it. The blonde woman chuckled at the little one’s reaction and said that other than making her untangled them from the yarns none of them had messed with or ruined the clothes she was working on. Both of the critter left their hiding place when the lovebirds assured them that they hadn’t done anything bad.

Aglaea then spun the bottle, and it landed on Mydeimos, who had chosen dare.

“Very well then. I dare you to put as much accessory as you can on your hair” The dare had stirred up quite the laughter from the group, Castorice and Cipher volunteer to use their accessories. Other than the girls, Phainon was also extremely excited to see the result. As the two girls returned, the girlies began helping Mydeimos put on the accessories. After they were done, Mydeimos had two red, white plaid patterned bows with cherries clipped onto the part of hair that framed his face, on both sides. The chimera’s bangs were clipped up by a fish bone hair clip, exposing his forehead which Phainon didn’t hesitate to press a kiss on it. On top of his head sat two small fluffy bunny ears hair clips, which Hyacine admitted that she bought them to play dress-up with Fig Stew.

Phainon also helped Mydeimos with his dare, putting a yellow bow on his tiny braid and a purple flower under it. He was banned from helping after that. The final piece was a purple shoulder length veil with a bow to clip on, one of Aglaea’s abandoned pieces of clothing. The adult trio and Krateros watched in amusement as Cipher pulled the veil’s blusher over Mydeimos’ face while loudly humming a wedding tune. The cat hybrid almost successfully murdered Phainon without using any force. She simply joined Phainon and Mydeimos’ hands together then ask Tribios and Aglaea to officiate the marriage. After that, everyone agreed to let Mydeimos take off the veil, for the sake of Phainon’s heath.

The bottle landed on Krateros, and he chose truth.

“How many times did you accidently saw us making out?”

“3 times. Once in the staff restroom, once in the walk-in storage, once behind the café. All of which was initiated by the young master, while the other 20 times, 2/3 of which happed inside the limo was Phainon that started it”

The game went on for a while then came dinner time, which were taken care of by Krateros. The man left and returned with a big bamboo mat and lay it down inside the fort then he brought in a giant pot of Hearty Vegetable Potage, a dish that Mydeimos had really enjoyed during his time back in Castrum Kremnos. Everyone enjoyed it immensely, chatting and laughing while eating the hot and warming dish.

The laughter died down as Krateros took out a small brief case as everyone knew what was in it. A red vial, the medicine that Eurypon had tried to perfect for almost two decades. A chance for Mydeimos to live his life fully. The chimera hybrid took the vial, then climbed onto Phainon’s lap, straddling his legs. The wolf hybrid naturally moved his hands to rub soothing circles on his lover’s back while pressing kisses all over his face. After reassuring Fig Stew and Pienon that he’ll be fine, Mydeimos took a deep breath and down the entire vial. The two portable air conditioners that Tribios brought in were blasting at max power yet a few seconds after drinking the serum, Phainon could feel Mydeimos’ body heating up.

Phainon watched in fascination as crimson line appeared under Mydeimos’ left eye, framing it like eyeliner. Another crimson shape appeared under his eyes, the wolf didn’t have much time to admire it as Mydeimos pulled at the hem of his own shirt to take it off. The heat was getting too unbearable to wear a shirt. The blonde hybrid let out a sign of relief when the other helped moved the air conditioners to blow its cold air at his back. The team watched in fascination and worry as more crimson flame-like lines spread all over his torso.

“Ph- Phai- Phainon, i- ice” The wolf immediately carried his lover to the bathroom, helping him get rib of the remaining clothes and set Mydeimos inside the ice bath. The crimson lines had stopped spreading, Phainon knew that it was a bad time but his lover looked extremely sexy relaxing in the bath. The wolf spent quite a bit of time scanning his eyes all over Mydeimos’ naked body, taking in the crimson tattoos beautifully and sensually framing his waist, the lines that ran down his entire legs and arms, swallowing hard when he saw the ones decorating his chest. Phainon was brought out of his trance when a cold hand touched his cheek, making him flinch. Mydeimos looked tired but still gave Phainon a reassuring smile, the wolf ignoring the biting cold of the ice bath, dipped his hands in it to hold his lover’s hands. But that tiny amount of skin ship wasn’t enough for Phainon, the wolf took a deep breath, helped Mydeimos to sit up straight then climbed into the bath, flopping down behind his lover.

“Phainon! You stupid wolf, you’re gonna catch a cold!” Mydeimos scolded his lover, but Phainon didn’t take anything of them to mind. The wolf only held his lover tighter as he pressed kisses all over the expansion of the other’s neck.

“You’ll take care of me if I get sick, right? I must have been a universe saving hero in my past life to receive so many miracles and miracles in this life. You have no idea how happy I am now that you’ll be able to stay beside me for as long as we live” Mydeimos heard a small sniffle behind him, as he was able to turn around he saw tears running down Phainon’s face.

“I don’t know what I would do if you left me so early. I can’t help but keep thinking about the possibility that you’ll be gone before we even get marriage”

“Oh Phainon… Don’t cry, love. Everything will be fine, I’m stay with you for as long as you’ll have me”

“Till death do us part?” Phainon nuzzled into the hand that was wiping away his tears

“Till death do us part, Phainon. I promise I will find and love you in the next life and all the ones after that”

“Will that be part of our wedding vows?” Mydeimos chuckled at Phainon’s words, leaning in to kiss his trembling lips – none of them knew if Phainon was trembling because of the cold or because of the happiness.

“Phainon Khaslana, will you marry me?”

“You’re seriously proposing while we’re in a freezing ice bath? I don’t know if you notice but you’re naked while I’m fully clothed, sitting in an ice bath. Just because the new addition on your skin made you look like a god, doesn’t mean that you could do whatever you want. You didn’t even prepare a ring, so I won by default as a beautiful pair of rings is sitting inside my bedside table! I won the proposal race, sweet honeycakes~”

“Then, I’ll look forward to your performance, Phainon Khaslana. Will your proposal be able to convince me to have your last name?”

chapters.title: Chapter 39
chapters.html:
That morning, Mydeimos was woken up by a hand mindlessly rubbing circles on his stomach and a dog wolf licking his nape like it was a delicious piece of bone.
“Morning, princess~ or should I say future Mr. Khaslana?”
“Hmmm Phainon Strife still has a better ring”
“Really? If I recalled correctly you seemed to really like the name Mydeimos Khaslana. Aglaea and Castorice can vouch for that~” Phainon littered kisses on Mydeimos shoulder slowly working his way down his spine to teasingly lick at the chimera’s sensitive spot – his 10th thoracic vertebra. The wolf hybrid then massaged the base of his lover’s tail, replacing the hiss with a storm of purrs from Mydeimos. Taking advantaged of his lover current incapacitated state, Phainon reached his free hand over to scratch under the blonde’s chin. The day Phainon discovered that he can made Mydeimos made trilling noises like a cat, he felt like a man hitting the jackpot twice in a row.
Unsurprisingly, all that trilling from Mydeimos woke both of their little critter counterparts. Fig Stew jumped up on the bed to say hi to his mama, Pienon – who learnt that it wasn’t allow on the bed because its fur will get everywhere, bit Phainon’s pants and pulled him off the bed. The yelp and thud that followed that event made Mydeimos jump and got up to look over to see Pienon giving Phainon kisses, by licking his face. The chimera hybrid was leisurely folding up the blanket and rearranging his pillows when he remembered what happened last night as he stared at the crimson lines on his arms. Mortified at the realization that he was loudly trilling and purring with everyone still in the room, Mydeimos was about to apologize for the PDAs, but their room looked like a massive pillow fort was never built here. Even the candles in the bathroom were gone.
Mydeimos finally looked at the clock and froze when it displayed 1 P.M, he immediately grabbed Phainon and dragged him inside the bathroom to brush their teeth and wash their faces. It seemed like everyone had decided to let Mydeimos rest after the whole debacle about his medicine and took care of all the work. Fig Stew’s tail and Pienon’s fur were all taken care of and judging by their quietness they had already been fed their breakfast and lunch. So, the two critters were just napping when they were woken up. Mydeimos had to thank everyone with a fancy meal later, as they reduced his daily morning routine to just brushing out Phainon’s hair and tail.
“Stop wagging your tail, Phainon”
“That’s fiancé to you, my dear fiancé” Phainon turned around and got on one knee, in his hand was a red, heart shaped ring box with a beautiful golden ring with a shiny red ruby on it.
“Mydeimos, I know that we have only been together for a year but after 356 days of staying by your side, my love for you have grown so much that simply looking at your face had made all my fatigue and anxiety disappeared. Before that faithful day of me breaking in a mad scientist’s lab, I thought that love was something I would never be able to feel once again. Aedes Elysiae, the small farming village, my home, the place I loved so deeply was taken away in just a blink.
Yet, the moment I laid eyes on you… Everything about you reminded me of it. I see the wheat field where I used to play and nap during noon in your beautiful golden eyes, your hair reminded me of climbing onto the roof of my house to watch the sunset with my sister. Your beautiful laughter reminded me of all the windchimes in our village. Your kindness reminded me of my mother, Audata. Your strength reminded me of my father, Hieronymus. Your gentleness, patience and courage reminded me of my sister, Cyrene.
At first, I thought my attraction towards you was temporary, but I’m so so so glad that it wasn’t. As a child, I never believed in those romance stories that Cyrene had, because the thought of falling in love at first sight was something that only existed in fairy tales. Yet, the way my heart was trying to break out of my rib whenever I saw you was real. The day that you suggested that I actually had a chance to be with you, I was so happy that I spent every morning after that praying that you weren’t just a dream.
I was so miserable when you left that Cipher named the mop that she bought a few days later after me. There had been nights that I sent longing for golden eyes and strawberry blonde hair, dreaming about a happy life with you in it. Only to wake up to the reality of you not being by my side. Everyone thought my mood improved after I found Fig Stew but in reality, I was just pretending, spending hours in front of the mirror trying to create the bright smile I once wore.
The night that you returned, looking like ethereal as angel under the moonlight. My dull and empty world was once again brightening up by those beautiful eyes of yours. And all those days after that, my love for you only grow, grow, grow and grow until my heart couldn’t take it anymore and I went out to commission a pair of rings for us.
I know this is the lamest way anyone had ever proposed but I couldn’t wait anymore. Not after you had said all those things last night.
Mydeimos, will you make me the happiest man in the universe and marry me?”
Phainon had done it, he finally popped the question. The wolf hybrid waited in batted breath to hear his lover’s respond. Aglaea would probably lose her shit if she knew Phainon proposed when Mydeimos was still in his pajamas, and inside their bedroom. They say love is blind, where other sees a mediocre and simple proposal, Mydeimos saw the man he loves, the one that has showed him freedom and the beautiful blue sky, asking the question that he dreamed of hearing all these times. Phainon could’ve pulled the same stunt as him last night and Mydeimos would still say yes.
“Yes, the answer will always be yes, Phainon” Mydeimos put down the brush and jumped on his fiancé, tacking him into a hug. The chimera hybrid couldn’t stop his tears from streaming down his face as he cried into Phainon’s shoulder. The blonde didn’t understand why he felt he finally got his happy ever after.
“You know, Mydei? For some reason I felt like all my past lives was spent fighting for this moment. The burning love I feel for you might be from all of my past lives” Phainon returned his fiancé’s hug, rubbing soothing circles on his back “It must be because we’re soulmates, my love”
“Soulmates… I like the sound of that. You know, the name Mydeimos Khaslana is growing on me a little bit”
“Shall we begin our journey to repopulate Aedes Elysiae?”
“Shut up, Phainon. You’re ruining the moment”

Chapter End Notes

Update is going to be slowing down after this chapter T.T
I feel like I should made a separate fic about their marriage life and taking care of their lovechild.

chapters.title: Chapter 40
chapters.html:
The morning after Phainon and Mydei’s engagement, everyone could see the fury burning in Aglaea’s eyes when she heard Phainon propose while both of them were still in their pajamas. Naturally, after seeing his boss throwing daggers at him with her stare, Phainon immediately agreed to letting Aglaea planned their wedding from A to Z. The blonde woman was very pleased with it.

“I’m about to put Mnestia and Phagousa to shame with how fast I could plan a wedding” Castorice and Cipher stared at the blonde woman, completely in shock when they heard she said that.

Phainon’s ahoge was punished for his rash decision by Mydeimos. The chimera hybrid then came to Aglaea’s office to talk about the details of the wedding. Phainon also joined the discussion but did not contribute much as he just agreed to everything that Mydeimos said. The wolf’s mind was on cloud nine as he stared at the beautiful ring on Mydeimos’ finger. Halfway through the planning, Phainon no longer contribute his “mmhmm” and “sure”, too occupied with caressing his lover’s hand, smiling stupidly as his finger glide across the red gemstone. Can you blame the guy? He was about to get married to the soulmate he spent all of his past lives loving.

The two blondie was talking about who should be the flower girl/boy when Fig Stew and Pienon elegantly walked in, each with a flower crown that Tribbie made them earlier that morning. It seemed like the two critters were waiting for their topic of interest to come up. One had to wonder who taught the two babies about the concept of a flower boy/girl. Mydeimos was cooing at the critter’s cuteness when Phangry struck again as a low rumbling came from the wolf hybrid’s stomach.

Phainon was skipping happily after stuffing his stomach full of Mydeimos’ cooking only to sulk in their shared room when he was told that Mydeimos and Aglaea had went through their wedding suit’s design while he was snacking.

“Phainon, I love you to the moon and back, but your sense of fashion isn’t suited for people’s eyes” Mydeimos tried to comfort the Phainon shaped ball hiding under their blanket, his hand moves to pet the sulking man’s hair while trying his best to hold in his laughter. A 190 cm tall man sulking under the blanket because he didn’t get to share his opinion on the color combo of yellow and purple, if Cipher saw it she would ascend to become the next Aha due to how hard she’s going to laugh. Phainon sulked at least 7 times a week, so Mydeimos was an expert on how to deal with him at this point in their relationship.

“Phainon” Mydeimos started out with his fiancé name

“Hmpf!” A predictable sound from Phainon. Judging by how the mass under the blanket moved, the wolf must have crossed his arms and turned his head aside when making that noise. Mydeimos could confidentially bet good money that his lover was also puffing up his cheeks.

“Oh? Is that how it going to be huh? Aiyaaa I guess I’ll have to taste test all of this cake samples myself…” Mydeimos had to hold back his giggle when Phainon’s ears perked up under the blanket. The chimera began taking out small containers of different cake sample and putting in on the table, Phainon without a doubt was able to hear the sound of plastic and the smell of vanilla cake as the blonde opened one of the boxes

“Let see… No chocolate… No coffee… hmm alright none of this is bad for Phainon” Mydeimos said, ignoring the Phainon shape mass under their blanket and continue reading through the flavor. A hand shot out from under the blanket when Mydeimos got to the “black forest cake” box to stop the chimera hybrid from taste testing it.

“No alcohol cakes” Was the only thing that the wolf hybrid muttered out before eating the sample in one bite. “Mydei don’t tell me you forgot to tell the bakery what you couldn’t eat” Phainon took the cake flavor list from his fiancé’s hand and scanned through it, picking out the flavor that contained alcohol. The wolf’s determined and focused face was too cute for Mydeimos not to press a kiss on his cheek. The chimera’s tail was swaying in the air when Phainon turned to give him a kiss on his lips. The two returned to taste testing the sample after the seemingly never ending back and forth kisses.

A light pink cake with some kind of filling in between the layers caught Mydeimos’ attention. When he reached over to grab it, Phainon was faster. The wolf smoothly glided his hand under Mydeimos’ and moved it away from the box to press a kiss on it making the chimera blush. Who the hell taught Phainon such a princely move like that? Mydeimos was a man with few weaknesses, unfortunately one of them was Phainon’s stupidly handsome face. If the wolf started doing all of that sappy moves from romance movies to Mydeimos, the blonde feared that their honeymoon was going to start before the wedding. Mydeimos had to inhale and exhale slowly before turning and holding Phainon’s face between his hands, squishing his cheek between them.

“Phainon, please keep your usually puppy personality. Don’t try anything that you’ve seen in romance movies, leave that to me. If you keep doing this, your plan of having kids 3 years after our wedding is going down the drain” Mydeimos said with the most serious look on his face, the one that leave no room for questions or arguments for Phainon as the wolf hybrid tilted his head in confusion but nodded anyway.

After a bit more tasting, Phainon finally caught on that his fiancé was only noting down the flavor that the wolf hybrid liked/have a positive reaction toward. Mydeimos just waved him off dismissively when the white-haired hybrid told him to pick the flavor he liked. The love birds have a bit of a lover quarrel before finally choosing mixed berry vanilla as their wedding cake flavor.

“You indulge me too much, Mydei…”

“Cease your nonsense, I have done nothing of the sort” The chimera said as he lay on his belly, cushioning his head with his arms on the mat Phainon had put down. Signing comfortably as his lover moved his oiled hands across his back, mapping the crimson lines and massaging the muscles there. The chimera’s offer to let Phainon massage his front with a mischievous smirk on his face did not help the wolf’s rising situation down south. Both of them had taken notice of how Phainon had been much touchier towards Mydeimos after he got his crimson markings. The wolf hybrid’s hand would reach up to hold the other’s face, thumbing at the mark underneath his eyes before pressing a kiss on it. The white-haired hybrid’s fascination with Mydeimos’ chest seemed to triple with the addition of swirling crimson lines of a flame in the middle of the blonde’s chest.

For Mydeimos, Phainon lickings and love bites were normal things that bound to happen on a daily basis. After the sexiness buff, as Phainon had called his tattoos, Mydeimos woke up to the feeling of wetness on his stomach, and opened his eyes to see Phainon licking at the red line on his abs. The bold wolf hybrid had gotten even bolder after putting a ring on his chimera lover. Before the engagement, Phainon would only leave bitemarks and hickies where Mydeimos could easily cover it up, but now citizens could see a peak teeth mark on the blonde policeman’s nape.

Mydeimos truly spoiled and indulged Phainon’s antics way too much.

The day after, both hybrids walked into the HQ lounge to see Krateros and Aglaea having an argument over where the wedding ceremony should be held. The butler wanted his young master’s most important day to be celebrated in Castrum Kremnos, more specifically he wanted the ceremony to be held under the pomegranate tree that Gorgo had planted.  Aglaea agreed on the sentiment of holding the ceremony at the place of great importance but wanted to hold it near where Aedes Elysiae used to be. Phainon was touched after hearing that Aglaea wanted his most important day to be celebrated in his hometown, and he thanked her for it. But Phainon wanted the wedding to be held where his mother-in-laws tree was planted.

“My hometown is nothing but a pile of charcoal after the fire. Given how much time had passed, the place had already returned to mother nature’s embrace. I don’t want to disturb the wildlife living there with our presence. I had left all of those tragic memories back there, and I wish not to see them again.” After speaking his mind, Phainon turned and grabbed Mydeimos’ hand to press a kiss and nuzzled into it

“But all of my good memories of Aedes Elysiae is here with me. Just merely looking at your beauty helped me relive all of that happiness. My home is where Mydeimos is, so please I want to have our ceremony to be host in Castrum Kremnos”

“Krateros, get me a priest right now”

“I’m happy that you’re eager to be officially wedded, young master. But lady Gorgo will strangle me from the sea of soul if you didn’t say your vows under her tree”

chapters.title: Chapter 41: Shenanigans
chapters.html:
1.

Having internet fame had its ups and downs and after Phainon decided to announce his engagement on the Fig_Stew_Pie account (renamed to include their Samoyed baby), he was experiencing the downs of his internet famous face card. No one had said anything negative about him being with Mydeimos, all of his followers were happy for him. That was before the post about their engagement, where he revealed that Mydeimos was Kremnoan and suddenly some people had a problem with it. Castorice had to stop Cipher and Anaxa from doxxing the haters. Phainon was even more grateful that Mydeimos rarely bothered to read through the comment on their joint custody Fig_Stew_Pie account.

Hyacine and Tribios managed to talk Phainon away from the idea of storming to the haters’ house with a pitchfork. Cipher and Phainon, everyone could understand but why Anaxa decided to join the now cancelled and shut down operation was a mystery. A week before Phainon decided to flex on the entire Okhema’s population that he managed to bag a baddie like Mydeimos incident, Krateros mentioned that the Strife family had been taking care of a dormas for nearly 20 years and needed some guidance because its caretaker had retired. Anaxa just happened to be waiting for the death concoction of caffeine.

“Has something happened? Why does my fiancé and Cipher look so upset?” Mydeimos had asked after returning from his walk with Pienon, completely unaware of the whole mess that was Phainon’s announcement with the comment being disabled.

“Phainon was pouting about you going outside without him. Cipher decided to tease him about it, and he didn’t take kindly to it. The 10 times debate champion didn’t mince his words.” Aglaea said while sipping on her tea, looking over to the two troublemakers daring any of them to speak up. Mydeimos had no reason to doubt Aglaea’s words and chuckled lightly while ruffing Phainon’s hair.

“Who would have thought both of my puppies would be so clingy? Alright, I’ll whip up something for both of you” The chimera hybrid pressed a kiss on Phainon’s cheek then moved into the kitchen with Pienon and Phainon trailing behind him. Both fluffy white tails were wagging showing their excitement at the mentioned of Mydeimos’ cooking. Both cat hybrid and wolf hybrid turned to thanks Aglaea because Cipher also got a plate of tuna sandwich as Mydeimos’ apology for Phainon’s behavior.

  1.  

“Hi Cipher’s Tok followers. I’m Mydeimos, one of Fig Stew and Pienon’s parents” The blonde man said to the camera. Cipher, the one holding the teleslate turned the lens toward Pienon, who was being a good boi, sitting in front of Mydeimos’ feet waiting for the next command.

“The other Fig_Stew_Pie parent made the unfortunate mistake of eating the chimera cookies I was saving for later. Today happened to be his turn to bath our precious walking cloud here, so I’m letting Pienon try red dragon fruit” Mydeimos held up a red dragon fruit to the camera, using a knife to carefully remove the peel to reveal the deep pink flesh of the fruit. Before giving it to the Samoyed, the blonde cut of a small slice and handed to Cipher who gave a thumb up after trying it.

The cat hybrid recorded a small section of Pienon’s routine, doing a couple of tricks before Mydeimos put down his food bowl, filled with chunks of red dragon fruit. For those who are unfamiliar with red dragon fruit, it will stain anything and everything pink. Safe to say Pienon wasn’t a walking cloud after his afternoon snack. The samoyed wasn’t aware of the headache he had caused Phainon, all that’s matter was the kisses he got from his mama after finishing his snack. The visiting chimera – Vigethos, received a tiny make-up session from Cipher, the blushes was made from 100% organic red dragon fruit. The grey chimera’ patience was rewarded as Fig Stew spent an entire minute licking the fruit on its face.

All three critters were playing outside, with Mydeimos and Cipher supervising them, when Phainon returned with a new bottle of dog shampoo. The wolf hybrid dropped the bottle the moment he saw Pienon with pink dotted around its face and paws. Both Fig Stew and Vigethos ran to hide behind Mydeimos when Phainon took the kiddy pool out to bathe the Samoyed. The chimera hybrid and cat hybrid decided to take a selfie. The camera was angled to only show their eyes at the bottom, putting the love heart Mydeimos was making with his hands in the center of the photo. The heart was positioned to that the scene of Phainon massaging shampoo into Pienon’s pink stained fur was inside the shape.

The look of betrayal on Fig Stew face when Mydeimos picked him up and set him inside the kiddy pool was adorable and priceless. Vigethos was quick to run away though not quick enough to escape Cipher.

“Mydei… You’re not helping” Phainon said as he pouted at the blonde that was eyeing him without any shame. Pienon decided to shake and splash all the water in his fur onto Phainon, turning the bottom of his white shirt translucent.

“Now you’re shy? Want me to take off my shirt so you’ll feel better?” The chimera smirked at the blushing wolf, taking a sip of his pomegranate juice. The blonde attention turned to his chimera babies, trying to hold back his laughter when he saw them doing the “don’t talk to me, I’m angy” sitting pose in the corner of the kiddy pool. 

  1.  

Phainon wasn’t the only one getting bolder after putting a ring on his lover, Mydeimos had been very generous with his affection and Phainon was suffering in success because of it.

Mydeimos’ good mornings now came with a side of kisses, which only happened once in a while before the marriage patch notes.

Phainon absolutely loved it when his blonde and gorgeous lover gave him head pat and ear scritches. Phainon jr. did not hesitate to let him know how much it loved when Mydeimos caressed his arms while licking his lips. Castorice told him that he was tasting his own medicine. In his defend, his lover like to walk around in sleeveless tank tops and that fuck ass short that had been teasing the wolf hybrid with the slightest peak of his lover’s bottom.

“Mydei… I just finished my work out. Stop kissing me, I’m sweaty” Phainon said as he tried to push the very enthusiastic chimera hybrid away. Key word being tried, because anyone with a working pair of eyes could tell the wolf hybrid was soaking up all of the affection, it was a miracle that Phainon hadn’t dislocated his tail after all this time.  

“I like my food well seasoned” The chimera said, licking a stripe up Phainon’s neck. The wolf had to take a deep breath to calm himself after hearing that. Gathering up all of his restraint, Phainon hoisted his lover up by the waist and put him on the bench press. The blonde was enjoying the kiss that followed when Phainon separated and whispered an apology and made a run for the shower. Mydeimos was pouting at his lover’s reaction when Fig Stew came running towards him, with tears threatening to fall. Turned out, Cipher had put a sticker on the critter’s back and Fig Stew was freaking out because he couldn’t get it off.

Mydeimos was busy trying to soothe his chimera baby when a white blob came barreling towards him, a very damp white blob. Phainon had just taken a shower in record speed. Anaxa checked the security camera later that day and saw a shirtless Phainon running across the HQ. Owning up to his hybrid side, Phainon proceeded to shake all of the water off his hair and tail when his lover complaint about it, splashing all of it onto Fig Stew – who was known for disliking the feeling of wetness on his scales and mane. Fig Stew was a good child and a responsible chimera while working, the moment the critter is held by Mydeimos, the chimera turned into a spoiled little baby. Normally, Fig Stew would’ve just pouted or hiss at whoever splashed the water on him but now, securely and lovingly held in Mydeimos’ arms , the critter began crying.

“Aww did meanie papa splashes water on you? My poor Fig Stew… There there, let go dry you off” Fig Stew was moved to lay on its back in Mydeimos’ arms and only stopped crying when suckling onto his mama’s finger.

“Mydei that’s a grown ass chimera you’re babying” Phainon pouted. Someone was getting jealous over his own adopted child.

“Watch your language, Phainon. You speak as if you didn’t suck on my chest whenever we f---”

“Mydei! There’s a child in your arms! Do not talk about our night time activites!” Phainon whisper-yelled while covering his lover’s mouth, only removing his hand when he was given the “if you don’t stop now you’re sleeping on the couch tonight” look”.

“So now Fig Stew’s a baby to you?”

“…I’m going to go and make a cup of pomegranate milk.”

chapters.title: Chapter 42
chapters.html:
The fanfic’s love birds were enjoying their after-work cuddle, with Phainon loving the attention and the gentle petting as he squished his face further into Mydeimos’ plush thigh taking up precious couch space because of the wolf’s long ahh legs. Phainon was ready with the whine and complaint the moment the chimera hybrid stopped giving him ears scratches and head pats.

“Mydeiii pets me more! Gimme attention!” When the other didn’t heed his request, Phainon finally opened his eyes to see two familiars but rarely seen faces. A blue-haired short girl with a dark-haired lady was standing next to Aglaea, the shorter one of the three was giving him a dissatisfied look.

“This is the one that took out those “cleaners” that the old hag in the council sent?” She turned to look at Aglaea, hoping that Cipher would burst inside the room to announce that that was one of her pranks. The blonde woman only turned her attention to Mydeimos, lightly shaking her head. The orange tail that was thumping on the floor stopped; the chimera moved the frozen Phainon to a sitting position.

Mydeimos let out a trilling noise before standing up, all three women turned their heads towards the sound of pitter patter of tiny feet echoing down the hallway. The blonde man walked towards the doorway; the end of his tail slid under Phainon chin as he moved away. The blue haired girl and dark-hair woman finally saw the owner of the sound of tiny feet. Fig Stew came running the moment he heard his mama’s trilling noise, calling for him. The orange chimera made a few happy noises before running towards Phainon and jumped on his lap nuzzling and licking his face before returning to be picked up by Mydeimos.

“Let’s not waste time. Talk, boy. Who’s the informant that told you about the cleaners and how do I get in touch with them?” The blue-haired girl commanded with her arms crossed.

“Give him some time to process, Cerydra. Should I remind you that you were the one that storm into the HQ without any words and interrupted his rest during his day off?” Aglaea let out a sigh and turned to look at the other woman.

“As for you, Hysilens. I already told you; we have no secret informant. Every piece of information we had was either from the council or Cipher and Anaxa” The blonde woman then sat down on the armchair and explained the situation to the very confused Phainon.

Turned out, during one of Phainon and Mydeimos’ date nights, the wolf hybrid had punched a man that was passing by and got his hand on the “cleaner’s” dagger. More importantly, the hybrids were somehow able to use it to track down one of their hideouts and take care of them all. The “cleaner” was being stationed in said hideout to wait for the right time to assassinate Cerydra, so their leader can threatened the rest of the council into doing what they wanted if the blue-haired girl was gone.

“I didn’t punch a random passerby. He was insulting my lover, calling him a barbarian, saying that I would be better off with an Okheman just because he was Kremnoan. He was laughing and mocking our relationship, saying that a reunion between a wolf hybrid and a Komodo dragon would only result in an abomination of a child” The fury in those blue eyes were enough to tell the others that if it wasn’t for his and Mydeimos’ job, that man would have been mincemeat by the time the hybrid got his hand on the dagger. The change in his attitude was so unexpected that Hysilens unconsciously stood in front of Cerydra when Phainon directed his eyes towards them.

“No one had informed me about the “cleaner”. I have no interest in taking Lygus’ offer to join the council. I am content with staying and working for Aglaea as part of the special investigation team. I just want a peaceful life with Mydeimos” The wolf hybrid whispered the last part then excused himself with a bow and left the room to find his lover.

“Lygus? That creepy man still has his eyes on your golden boy Aglaea?” The dark-haired girl, Hysilens asked.

“Don’t prefer to Phainon as my golden boy please. I still have nightmares about his sense of fashion. As for Lygus, I honestly have no idea. He stopped visiting the HQ completely after Mydeimos joined the team. It was such a relief for everyone that they no longer had to hear about how that creepy man can help Phainon develop his potentials”

“So not only does that little lion helped you supervise the wolf hybrid, but he also helps the HQ by scaring away Lygus” The short girl, Cerydra concluded, nodding to herself while eating a piece of candy from the bowl on the table. Hysilens had to reason Cerydra away from marching to where Mydeimos was resting and demand he worked as her personal chef after she heard about what the chimera hybrid’s cooking skill. Phainon was definitely not going to take kindly to the blue-haired girl demand.

With half the council being against the existence of the special investigation team, having one less pair of eyes on them was a relief.

To help cheer the short girl up after being denied the chance of getting Okhema’s most talented chef, the blonde woman invited both of the visitors to stay for dinner. Cerydra made quite the performance of pretending to check her schedule, which Hysilens was happily playing along, in the end she accepted the invitation. The three were chatting about their personal life when Tribios returned from the academia with Pienon. The Samoyed being the friendly fluffy cloud that he is, wasn’t even scared of the two strangers sitting near aunty Agy. The dog came up to her for pets and turned to give Cerydra and Hysilens the loudest “pet me, pet me!” puppy dog eyes. The two held their ground but ultimately gave in not long after. The red-haired lady ushered Pienon out and went to find his mama and papa. Hysilens asked about the papa and mama part, both did not expect the answer to be Phainon and Mydeimos.

“…Interesting. The chimera hybrid gave birth to a chimera and a Samoyed?” Hysilens spoke up after a few seconds. Tribios quickly explained that Fig Stew and Pienon were their adopted kids. Cerydra looked amused when she realized how similar Phainon and Pienon were. Speaking of adopted kid (but not adopted yet), with Hysilens always on high alert due to her job as Cerydra bodyguard, the woman turned her body toward the doorway as she sensed something was running toward them.

“I stopped visiting the HQ for like a year and this place already turned into a petting zoo?” The blue-haired girl stared at the grey chimera with uneven horns on its head, scaring the little critter as it let out a whine. Tribios suggested they should go for a walk in the garden, saying that the place looked very beautiful thanks to Castorice’s hard work. The red-haired lady stayed inside saying that she had reports to go through, but in reality, she just didn’t want Cerydra to find out about Anaxa’s joint custody baby dromas with the pair of foreigner twins – Caelus and Stelle.

Both Cerydra and Hysilens notice that when they stepped into the garden, Aglaea waited to see which way Vigethos went and guided them in the opposite direction. Don’t get her wrong, she had no problem with Vigethos going to where Fig Stew is. It’s the two hybrids that were keeping an eye on him, its best to keep the others away from those two or else they are going to get overdosed on unsolicited PDAs.

The flower garden was beautiful as expected, even Cerydra was impressed by the beautiful flowers decorating the ground. Hysilens had heard the purple-haired girl mentioning a sea of flowers once or twice but didn’t expect her to be able to bring that dream to life. Upon a closer look, the two noticed that the garden was full of different shades of purple flowers, all of which were native to Styxia and Aidonia. The amazing thing about Castorice’s flower garden was that the flower that’s living and thriving there shouldn’t be able to even germinate, much less grow and flower, in Okhema’s tropic temperature. The weather of Okhema was not strong enough to deter Castorice from her dream flower garden. With the help of Cipher and Mydeimos, she was able to create a generation of flowers that was able to survive the heat during summer. Phainon also helped by letting Castorice use his old room as her flower nursery. Unless he really pissed Mydeimos off, the wolf hybrid rarely stepped foot inside the room.

Next, Aglaea led Cerydra and Hysilens to her orchard hoping that Phainon and Mydeimos had moved elsewhere with their hyperactive children. Luck wasn’t on her side as all three of them narrowly avoided colliding with Pienon, who was hyperfocus on the toy that Phainon thrown across the yard.

“Oh thanks Mnestia. They’re only cuddling” Aglaea let out a sigh of relief when she saw Mydeimos snuggled up on Phainon’s side with Fig Stew and Vigethos in his lap. Phainon, with his arm wrapped around his lover’s shoulder, pulled him closer to shamelessly take a whiff of the chimera hybrid’s hair and whispered something to him. Hysilens, having the unfortunate skill of lips reading, turned to inform Aglaea that Phainon was planning on pushing his parental responsibility to his teammates to join a private sleep over at a luxurious hotel. Cerydra was taken aback that the blonde lady was alright with her subordinates doing something so irresponsible.

“I like to call it youth protection rather than irresponsibility. Who knows how long there going to be doing it with their endless stamina? The team and I are grateful that Mydeimos had made it clear to his fiancé that no inappropriate noises shall be heard by the children or their friends at night.”

chapters.title: Chapter 43
chapters.html:
Chapter Notes

Let us all pretend that Vigethos name was Coconut Beagle this entire time because I really don't want to go through all those chapter just to change Vigethos into Coconut Beagle...

Happy Halloween everyone!

Halloween was something that Mydeimos had learned recently. The chimera hybrid had said to his lover that he wasn't interested in dressing up in costume but would accompany Phainon if the wolf wished to go trick or treating. Since Hysilens had been dropping by the HQ more often, the woman had managed to somehow convinced Aglaea to decorate the place. When the blonde woman mentioned it to the rest of the team, no one expected Anaxa out of all people to show signs of interest and enthusiasm for the holiday. The professor began looking at Fig Stew with the same look as Phainon when he wanted to dress the orange chimera in some ridiculous outfit he had purchased. Aglaea seemed to sense a disturbance in the force because she immediately called dips on making costume of Pienon and Fig Stew. 

"Nuh-uh. I'm not letting you take all the fun away! Mydeimos, i want to ask for permission to make costume for your kids" The mint haired man declared, his eye filled with determination. Unfortunately for Aglaea, Fig Stew's papa and Anaxa had the same idea and Mydeimos had been struggling to say no to Phainon after the wolf put a ring on him. After a few kisses from Phainon, the chimera hybrid agreed to let Anaxa make his baby a Halloween costume. 

Aglaea reassured Mydeimos that at least Pienon's costume is going to be made by a responsible adult. She said as she gave the two men that was looking at dromas pictures as references for her little nephew's trick or treating costume, the side eyes. 

"Come along now, sweet child. Let us go take your measurements" The woman motioned Pienon to follow her. The samoyed puppy let his mama gave him a few smooches before trotting over to follow Aglaea. Mydeimos let out a sigh and shook his head when he overheard the other two men discussing which shade of purple they should use. Later that day, Coconut Beagle was chimera-napped by Phainon and Anaxa as they weren't able to agree on which color would be the main color of their dromas costume. An hour after the chimeras got taken against their will, Fig Stew came running toward Mydeimos, whining about Phainon calling its tail fat. A little bit later, Fig_Stew_Pie uploaded a photo of Phainon sitting facing the wall's corner with a piece of paper on his back, that read "I call Fig Stew's healthy sized tail fat"

"C'mon Coconut, ignore that rude wolf hybrid. Let's go play in the orchard" Mydeimos turned and headed towards the door, with Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle trailing behind him. Aglaea decided not to ask questions when she saw Phainon's predicament as she stopped by their room to drop off Pienon. It didn't take long for Mydeimos to come back to comfort his pouty fiance. Poor Hysilens and Cerydra, the two were invited for some afternoon tea by Castorice and Hyacine and involuntarily became babysitters as Mydeimos dropped the chimeras and Pienon for them to look after. 

"Welcome to the club, Miss Cerydra and Miss Hysilens. We are Okhema's special investigation team, and we work part-time as babysitters. Mydeimos paid us in homecooked meals and Michelin grade desserts" Hyacine joked as she saw the children running around the two. 

While the babysitters enjoyed the sweets and pastries Mydeimos made, the parents of those babies decided to go on a shopping date or more specifically Phainon wanted to buy candies to give out to children and dragged Mydeimos along with him as the blonde hybrid folded extremely quick when faced with Phainon's teary puppy eyes and handsome face. 

Turned out, going shopping for candies was just a small part of Phainon's scheme. Unfortunately, Mydeimos only found out about it after the wolf had distracted him with his conventionally handsome face and got led to the Halloween costumes aisle. The first thing Phainon showed his lover was a couple costume of a moth and a lamp. The wolf was about to put a cat ears headband into their cart but the look on his very much not amused lover made him rethink his decision. Mydeimos had experienced firsthand how imaginative his lover was, but he didn't expect to see Phainon getting a nosebleed after staring at a sexy nurse costume for a worrying amount of time. 

"I don't know why you think I would look good in that. Your thighs muscle looked better than mine, so you probably look good in thigh highs." Phainon, of course, was not prepared for his fiancé honesty. After a few minutes of recovering from Mydeimos' attack, Phainon got hit with a follow-up of the blonde saying that he should dressed up as a mummy since the costume would be easy to take off. The statement itself was innocent, but the meaning was twisted into inappropriate stuff in Phainon's mind. 

"My beautiful fiancé, if you want to take my clothes off that badly... I'm sure Anaxa and Cipher wouldn't mind taking the kids out for trick or treating. You already have the look and body for it, why not dress as a succubus for Halloween. I have a lollipop for you to su- OW OW OW!" Phainon yelped out as Mydeimos elbowed his stomach and dragged him to the sweets aisle. The janitor got concerned about the way Phainon's tail was dragging on the floor. For such a large wolf hybrid, Phainon gave off such a convincing wet puppy dog vibes that a lady approached him wondering if he was brought here against his will. The actual victim couldn't even believe what he just heard. After a moment of consideration, Mydeimos found that he rather not has people whispering about him being a meanie and led Phainon and the rain cloud that was watering his wilted ahoge to the restroom. 

Usually, Phainon is the more active one in the relationship, always initiating their cuddle session and kisses. Once in a while, Mydeimos surprised him by simply kissing him first or snuggling up to him. Such simple act of affection was enough to get Phainon’s tail wagging to the point where no one would be surprised if the movement was fast and rapid enough to power a light bulb. A few minutes later, the two hybrids walked out of the restroom, with Mydeimos looking as his usual self while Phainon was holding covering his redden face with his hands, looking like a maiden during her first time.

“Bro, I just saw the most unbelievable thing in the restroom” An employee whispered to his co-worker.

“I saw these really tall and muscular hybrids, one was dragging the other inside the restroom. I think they were too focused on each other to notice me mopping the floor there. But… the blonde one. I think he is some kind of reptilian hybrid? He pinned this wolf hybrid to the wall, kabedon style. And whispered something to the wolf and bam the wolf hybrid tail was wagging like crazy, and his face was so red!”

“And then?! Did they… y’know?”

“Well, that the unbelievable part. Every piece of the puzzle for a good scene of steamy hot time was there, yet after giving the wolf hybrid a quick peck on his lips. The blondie just left”

Both of the staff were disappointed, but as the clock signaled break time was over. They braced themselves for the horde of people buying candies and sweets for Halloween.

“Hey Mydei…Can you say the thing that you said to me in the restroom one more time?” Phainon asked looking up at his fiancé, eyes full of expectations and excitement. The two of them were now sitting inside the limo to head back to HQ. Phainon being Phainon, immediately cozy up to the chimera hybrid the moment the door closes and made himself comfy, pillowing his head on Mydeimos’ lap.

“I love you, Phainon Khaslana” The blonde smiled at his lover squealing like a fangirl seeing their idol.

“One more time, please!”

“Love you, Phainon”

“More!”

“I love you” Mydeimos leaned down to press a kiss on the wolf hybrid’s forehead.

“Hehe love you too, Mydei~”

“Boss, I’m afraid that I’m about to throw up”

“Keep your focus on the road, new hired. You’ll need to get used to that if you want to have this job. There’s a reason why I offered to pay that much” Krateros explained to the newly hired chauffeur. Don’t misunderstand, the old guy is still working at the café. The new driver is the old chauffer’s relative.

Thankfully, the new chauffeur managed to take the two hybrids and Krateros back to the HQ safely. The old man gave him a sturdy pat on the back praising him for his iron will for not getting distracted when Mydeimos decided to grope his lover’s abs.

When the lovebirds stepped inside the lounge, what they didn’t expect to see was a familiar sight of a giant pumpkin that only one man could create while laughing maniacally afterwards. Half the reason why Mydeimos was okay with letting his chimera child be dressed up as a dromas for Halloween was so that Anaxa would be too occupy with making the costume to recreate his proud creation. The other half was because of Phainon’s face. To add more to the shenanigans, Cerydra had gotten attached to Coconut Beagle and wanted to take the chimera with her. Just because one made the law doesn’t mean she was above it, thanks to the current laws stating that getting a chimera as pet was illegal, the blue haired girl let the chimera go after petting it a few more time.

“Don’t look so down, Miss Cerydra! If you wanted to play with Coconut Beagle, you could always stop by HQ. The chimera practically live here with how often he visits Fig Stew” Hyacine tried to cheer her up. Good food, good company and with the promise of getting to play with chimera? All of those already made the HQ more enjoyable than staying at her office, so Cerydra took the offer up immediately.

A few days later, Aglaea came knocking on Phainon and Mydeimos’ room asking for Pienon. The costume she had made for the Samoyed was mostly done, she only needed the pup to put it on to see if any more details need to be added to finalize the outfit. Aglaea waved her hand dismissively when Mydeimos asked if he could do anything to repay the favor, stating that making Pienon his costume helped with her creative block. Speaking of costumes, Mydeimos turned to look at his lover who looked very excited as he picked up a wiggling Fig Stew that didn’t want to be held. The wolf mentioned needing to clip the chimera’s nail so it would poke through the socks that came with the costume. Which lead to the scene of Mydeimos holding Fig Stew over the filled bathtub and Phainon holding the pet nail clipper while laughing like a villain

“You must choose, Mr. Bond~” The wolf hybrid said as he slowly moved the clipper towards Fig Stew’s paws “Get your nail clipped…or perish in the river below~”

Mydeimos found the whole thing absolutely ridiculous. A spectacle of folly one might say.

“What will it be, Mr. Bond?” Phainon continued, laughing his ass off when Fig Stew lifted up his paws, away from the clipper. That was enough tomfoolery for the morning, Mydeimos had decided and carried Fig Stew to the kitchen to eat breakfast.

Fast forward to Halloween night, it was time for the final reveal for the chimeras and Pienon’s costume. Anaxa and Phainon, as expected, put Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle in dromas outfit, with Fig Stew being the common purple dromas and Coconut Beagle being the rarer blue variant. Anaxa, being the dromas enthusiast that he is, also made a few more accessories for Fig Stew: A tiny saddle and small carrier bags on his sides to hold the candies. Phainon made a paper bag, that Coconut Beagle could hold with his mouth, mimicking the shape and color of a chunk of red soil.

The wolf hybrid wasn’t even done there as he hopped inside the restroom and came out with a full farmer outfit, matching with Coconut Beagle as a dromas caretaker. The wolf hybrid even got a straw hat to go with his shirt and denim overalls.

“I won this Halloween costume thing! At least I won against Anaxa. I’m not only matching with Coconut Beagle, I also match with Mydei’s costume” Everyone turned to look at Mydeimos, who was wearing his usual black tank top and loose pants. Phainon tried to get their attention by clearing his throat and pulling out a small bag and handed it to his lover.

Mydeimos pulled out a cow ear headband.

“*ehem* I believe that Pienon here had the best costume. Come in sweet child, show your papa and mama your Halloween costume” Aglaea called out for the Samoyed. The fluffy cloud walked in the lounge, proudly showing off his new outfit.

“Aww. He’s a sailor! That so cute~” Tribios cooed at the Samoyed.

While everyone was distracted with recording and taking pictures of Pienon playing with Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle, in the corner of the room Mydeimos noticed there was still something else inside the bag that Phainon gave him. Phainon had the audacity to wink at Mydeimos while pouring himself a cup of almond milk as the chimera held the end of a cow tail in his hand.

Later that night, everyone that passed by them squealed at the chimeras’ costumes and compliment how Phainon was matching with them as a dromas caretaker. On Mydeimos’ side, people were snapping pictures after pictures of Pienon in his sailor outfit. Some people even gave Mydeimos some candies for his police costume.

chapters.title: Chapter 44
chapters.html:
Anaxa could feel his eye twitch as he heard the more questionable pick-up lines Phainon had uttered to “rizz up” Mydeimos. With his fiancé busy with the wedding suit fitting, Anaxa was the one being subjected to all of the cheesy lines the white-haired man came up with. The professor just wanted to go pick some mushrooms from the mountain on the outskirts of Okhema for some quite time. And Aglaea decided that his precious tranquility with nature and fungi was the perfect time to keep Phainon occupied.

Anaxa’s patience was running thin as the other kept switching yapping about how Mydeimos would react to his horrible pick-up lines and whining about his boss preventing him from seeing his fiancé. The man was acting like a puppy with separation anxiety and kept wanting to see Mydeimos, whining in front of Aglaea’s office. Aglaea, wanting to help Mydeimos with his request of not letting Phainon saw his wedding suit, kicked Phainon out and banished him to the mountain.

“Quit being such a drama queen, Phainon. You wanted to come with me to gather some mushrooms so you could surprise Mydei with mushroom hotpot. Self-exile is a more correct term since you came here willingly” The mint-haired man said while meticulously brushing the dust off the mushroom he just picked. When he turned to check out what Phainon was giggling at, Anaxa regretted his action immensely.

Phainon had found a huge porcino mushroom and with his reputation of having a not so innocent mind after bagging Mydeimos, Anaxa could see what he was thinking. The mushroom’s small cap did not go well with its tall and thick stem. Nature was torturing Anaxa and he was sure of it. Because why else would a porcino, known for having a large cap, somehow have such a suggestive cap size?

“Damn… this one is huge! Mydei would loveee this~ It’s a bit shorter than my- WOAH professor! Careful with your tranquilizer!” Phainon quickly dodged the sedative that was fired at him, questioning why Anaxa would even bring his gun on his foraging trip. The mint haired man said it was for emergency situation and lied that his hand slipped and accidentally fired the sedative at Phainon. Anaxa had half a mind to seek out Mydeimos and begged him to hurry up and marry Phainon and moved out so he wouldn’t be subjected to Phainon’s tomfoolery and bs.

The trip was packed up quickly after Phainon and his luck, to Anaxa’s dismay, found a bunch of porcinis. The wolf hybrid had very gratefully taken them as nature’s sign that Mydeimos was in need of his mushroom and ran back to the car with a arm full of porcinis. Poor Anaxa and his non-existent athleticism, having to chase after a very excited wolf before said hybrid left him behind. Mydeimos was going to receive a complaint letter from the professor in the near future.

To make matters worse, when the two had returned, Phainon immediately went to search for his fiancé. The wolf hybrid went to search for Mydeimos, leaving his pile of mushroom in Anaxa’s car, making the frail mint-haired man carried his and Phainon’s baskets inside. Fig Stew did come up to him, awo-ing at him to let it help. The mushroom basket was too big and the handle was to tall for Fig Stew to hold it with his mouth due to his short little legs. So, Anaxa gave the chimera one of the big porcinis that Phainon found.

The scene that unfolded after Anaxa walked Fig Stew to the living room had lessened the prof’s annoyance towards Phainon. The two lovebirds were up to their usual stuff, with Phainon’s happy voice telling Mydeimos about what he just done. Like an excited child that came back from a field trip. Mydeimos simply continued on with whatever he was doing before Phainon showed up, giving the wolf hybrid occasional hums and nods as the other yap about everything.

As Fig Stew proudly showed Mydeimos the mushroom he was holding with his mouth. The hybrid picked the chimera up and gave its kisses, praising the little thing for helping Anaxa. To no one’s surprise, Phainon started pouting and tightening his hold on his lover. With a single Hmm? From Mydeimos got the wolf hybrid whining about how he was the one that picked a basket full of mushrooms, yet Mydeimos was rewarding Fig Stew for carrying a single one.  

“You’re competing with a child now, Phainon?” Mydeimos sighed but still reached his hand over to pet the lock of white hair nuzzling into his neck. The wolf mumbled something intelligible into Mydeimos’ shoulder, and the chimera hybrid made the big mistake of asking about it.

“Give me 9 months after our honeymoon and I’ll show you how much I’m willing to compete with a child for your attention and kisses” That was a sentence that Anaxa did not want to hear. Phainon licking Mydeimos’ nape and biting it was also not something he wanted to see. Phainon getting smacked by Mydeimos’ tail, however, was quite amusing to the professor.

The mushroom feast that night was delightful and delicious as expected of Mydeimos’ cooking. No one even questioned Cerydra and Hysilen’s showing up to join them for dinner more and more often. The two was surprised that Mydeimos even invited them to his wedding. Cerydra had to question whether sending a letter asking the company that took the job of fixing up Eurypon’s old mansion to “hurry their asses up” was an abuse of power.

While everyone was enjoying the feast, Phainon kept trying to have Aglaea to give him a hint about what Mydeimos’ wedding suit would look like. The wolf almost got shoo’d away from the dining table because of his determination.

“It’s white. Now let me enjoy my soup in peace, Phainon” The blond woman finally had enough. The answer was technically what Phainon was asking but the wolf hybrid decided that whining about how it wasn’t what he wanted to hear would result in a few graphic T-shirts being missing from his wardrobe. The man turned to look at his fiancé, but he was already move away from the table to feed Fig Stew and Pienon. Phainon told himself that he wasn’t going to be jealous of Pienon getting praise for doing a few tricks before eating dinner, but it didn’t work out.

“Good boy!” Mydeimos gave the Samoyed another command gesture after the doggo had very eagerly sit, roll and spin for his dinner.

“Alright, one last one, Pie. Speak!”

“Awrf”

“Woof!”

The dining table was uncomfortably quiet after Phainon’s slip up and Mydeimos’ unimpressed stare was not helping the situation. So, in order not to embarrass himself more than necessary, the wolf hybrid stood up, cleared his throat then left with his plate of food. Before he could step out of the room, the wolf hybrid was grabbed by the scrub of his neck and dragged towards the kitchen.

Phainon was waiting and readying himself for a scolding from Mydeimos, but the chimera hybrid still hasn’t said anything after a few moments had passed. He finally looked up to meet Mydeimos’ eyes. The blonde grabbed the plate Phainon was holding onto and set it on the kitchen island before pulling him into a hug.

“Phainon, make me purr” It took the white-haired male a few seconds for the words to register in his brain.

“What…? M-M-Mydei?!” Phainon.exe was stuttering after Mydeimos let out a huff and took matter into his own hands. The “matter” being Phainon’s hands, the chimera grabbed them and set them on his lower back, right above the base of his tail. Once again, Phainon was the more forward one with affectionate touches between them and every time Mydeimos initiate them, Phainon brain simply fried itself.

The wolf hybrid finally snapped back to reality when he felt soft lips around his face as Mydeimos scattered kisses on it. When their lips met, Phainon’s heart melted when he felt vibrations on his chest. His fiancé was so happy from getting a kiss from him that he started purring.

“Aglaea and I have finalized our wedding outfits. My tuxedo will have a long cape, so it will look like a wedding dress. I hope you don’t mind matching tuxedos, love. Of course, yours won’t have a long ass cape being dragged behind you. Both Aglaea and I fear your energetic tail will be tangled with it” Mydeimos softly said, while nuzzling into the other’s neck, taking in the scent of a ripe wheatfield – earthy with the subtlest hint of sweetness. How lucky Phainon was to bag a beautiful, one-of-a-kind chimera hybrid that just happened to love baking. Mydeimos didn’t show it as openly as Phainon, but he love the wolf’s scent just as much as Phainon love his.

“Thank you for your hard work, baby. I’m sure you and I will look good in anything as long as we were matching!” Phainon confidently said, his hands started rubbing at the base of the blonde’s tail, intensifying the purring

“Please don’t take it as confirmation that I am willing to match your mustard yellow and purple abomination of a color combo. Come now, I’ll reheat your soup”

“Aw…”  

Chapter End Notes

The way that y'all could tell that I'm running out of brain juice lol

chapters.title: Chapter 45
chapters.html:
Everyone know that Mydeimos cares and loves Phainon a lot, that affection can be seen from his action through out the day. Making breakfast for the girlies? There is always a plate of salad on the table. Buying groceries? The first portion of the shopping list was dedicated to restocking Phainon’s favorite snacks. Hanging out with the girlies? There is always a mention of the wolf’s name in every gossiping session, mostly about positive or adorable thing that he did. Taking Pienon and Fig Stew outside for a walk? “Phainon really liked this ugly ass vase during the last time we stopped by this antique shop”. In short, Phainon was always on Mydeimos’ mind most of the day. Of course, Phainon also have Mydeimos on his mind 24/7 if it wasn’t glaringly obvious enough with how the white-haired man couldn’t shut up about the chimera hybrid.

Mydeimos also spoiled Phainon a lot – to the dismay and headache for Aglaea (she still hasn’t found the storage unit that Phainon had kissed his way into convincing Mydei to buy one so he could hide his precious clothes). The chimera might yell at Phainon for his weird purchase but in the end the wolf’s antique collections still have a display shelf to keep them safe from the babies play wrestling. Hyacine was unlucky enough to discover that Mydei still kept the cow ears headband and some cow themed “clothes” while she was looking for Fig Stew’s food delivery outfit. 

So, the sight of Phainon begging for something from Mydeimos was a rare sight. One that even Aglaea was interested in witnessing.

“Pleasepleaseplease Mydeiiii please!!!” The wolf whined out, stubbornly holding onto his fiancé’s legs even if he was getting dragged across the floor. According to the team’s shared notes about how to read a specific member’s behavior, the silent from Mydeimos was a “no” that no amount of kisses could change it.

“Soooo what kind of diabolical request did Phainon ask that even his enabler refused to do it?” Cipher, having arrived at the scene a bit too late, whispered to Castorice. The purple haired girl mumbled out the most deadpan and flat sounding awawa wiwiwi, the cat hybrid shivered as she too – like the rest of the team, was not able to get that song out of her head after the council decided to station every one of them at the opening of a new park.

“Mydeiii, my beautiful fiancé, my soulmate, the mother of my future children, the one and only owner of the most delectable chest I have ever laid eyes on, the love of my life, pleaseee. Just 20 seconds of the dance! I’ll join you and the babies! PleasePleasePlease you were so cute doing it last week! Just the first part of the dance, Mydei! I promised I won’t lick the tip your tail for a whole month!”

That last sentence managed to get a reaction from the immovable wall that is Phainon’s lover

“But I like it when you do that… You looked so at ease with it in your mouth while sleeping… Like a baby with his pacifier” Not even Janus could foresee that sentence coming out of Mydeimos’ mouth let alone the very mortal Phainon. In hindsight, everyone that wasn’t Phainon should have left after hearing that because the next thing that Mydeimos said was something that none of them wanted to know.

“No sniffing at the base of my tail for a month, not even the underside of it”

“But… that’s where-“ Phainon’s mouth was covered up to stop him from spilling private information.

“Keep your mouth shut, darling. The one on my neck work perfectly fine and no I don’t believe for a second that my tail gland had “a sweeter note” bs that you kept saying, honey”

“Ooo the little lion is on his period today ack-“ Cipher hunched over as Castorice pinched her side and she got whack at the back of her head by Aglaea. Unlike Phainon, Mydeimos only used pet names when he was either drunk or angry. Phainon had his reasons for not taking that deal and stopped pestering the chimera hybrid that was getting increasingly annoyed – judging by the way his tail kept flicking to hit Phainon.

Seemed like Mydeimos was more irritated that day, for reason unknown to Phainon and the rest of the Chrysos team. Not even Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle could cheer the chimera hybrid up with their usual cuteness.

“Sorry babies, mama isn’t really feeling great today so go play with Pienon alright?” The blonde gave the chimeras a few scritches before ushering them out of the kitchen to resume his baking. Phainon prayed to the titans that his Mydeimos wasn’t stress baking as he waited for him to finish putting the batch of pastries inside the oven to bake.

“Mydei…” Phainon came up to him and hugged him from behind “What’s wrong, love? Is there something bothering you? You usually aren’t this… irritated” The wolf hybrid pressed himself again his fiancé, giving his nape comforting kisses and licks. Phainon then left a trail of smooches from Mydei’s nape along his shoulder blade then grabbing the blonde’ hand to continue kissing towards the sapphire ring.

Phainon could tell his comforting attempt was working as Mydei’s tail moved to loosely wrapped around his leg. This was one of those time that the wolf hybrid wished that he could purr to better soothe his troubled lover. Instead, he settled for kissing the side of the chimera hybrid’s head.

“Is it because it had been getting colder lately? Talk to me, Mydei. I’ll even fight the weather for you” Phainon’s tail began wagging and his ears perked up at the sound of laughter from his fiancé. The wolf let go of the other when he felt taps on his arms. Without the hold around his waist, Mydeimos was able to turn around to pull his lover into a proper hug. The tension in the chimera’s body slowly eased out as he stayed in Phainon’s arms, a safe and comforting space for Mydeimos where he could let his vulnerability shown.

“It’s not the weather, Phai… Some people were being difficult, that’s all” Mydeimos finally spoke up after spending some time in Phainon’s embrace, bathing in the sweet earthy scent of wheats from the wolf hybrid.

“Who do I need to kill then?”

“No, Phai. We talked about this. You can’t randomly off someone just because they did something wrong to me” Mydeimos grabbed a hold of Phainon’s face, kissing between his creased eyebrows and squishing his face to stop him from growling and bearing his fangs. The wolf might have gotten away without troubles when he punched a man, but Mydeimos doubted that the general contractor that is working on rebuilding Eurypon’s old mansion had any connection with “the cleaner”

The chimera then led Phainon toward the lounge, making himself comfortable on the new extra large sized beanbag then motioned for Phainon to lay next to him. The wolf immediately understood what his lover wanted and lay down on his side, letting Mydeimos snuggled up to him, chuckling when an orange tail hooked over his torso to pull him even closer to the chimera. If Phainon ever complaint about being smushed against Mydeimos’ chest, that dude is an imposter as the real Phainon would gladly be suffocated between his own personal stress balls.

It was funny how much Mydeimos loved Phainon. So much so that simply grooming the tuffs of the wolf hybrid’s ears was comforting to Mydeimos. Cartoon flowers were floating around Phainon as he enjoyed the attention from his fiancé while surrounded by the light scent of pomegranate and lilies.

When the pastries were done, Mydeimos had already fallen asleep from the comforting pats on his head. Now that Phainon managed to get some information about the source of his fiancé’s irritation today, he contacted Krateros right after making sure that the chimera snoozing in his arms wouldn’t wake up.

“Focus on taking care of the young master, he shouldn’t be stressing about any of this. I’ll deal with that money hungry general contractor. The bastard tried to charge double the amount of money that we had originally agreed on after knowing that the mansion was Eurypon’s. Pay me more or I’ll delay the project, kind of bastard”

Phainon knew way too well why Mydeimos tried his best to plan the perfect wedding for them. He knew why the chimera hybrid wanted the ceremony to happen as fast as possible. In Mydeimos’ vision, the perfect time to be wedded to Phainon was when his mother’s tree was in full bloom, coloring the canopy with flashes of red. Peak blooming time for pomegranate tree is in late spring, around May and they’re currently in the second week of November. From what Krateros had provided, the construction company wanted to delay the project till mid-summer with the contractor using the intricacy and ancient design from way back in the time of the last Kremnoan dynasty of the mansion’s basement as an excuse for the delay. In the height of capitalism, doubling the payment somehow magically made the restoration easier for the building team.

Mydeimos didn’t even know that the mansion had a basement until Krateros told him about it after Phainon’s proposal. Even in prison, Eurypon still managed to piss his son off.  And it was just Mydeimos’ luck that he inherited the mansion that was bought during the scientist’s hyper fixation of ancient Kremnoan dynasty.

After Phainon hang up the call with Krateros, his ears shot up at the sounds of tiny paws pitter pattering on the floor.

“Mimime!”

“Awo!”

“Woof!”

Phainon immediately shushed the trio of cuteness, gesturing at a sleeping Mydeimos. All three of the critters quite down, looking at the wolf hybrid with guilty eyes. Before he could ask them to go play elsewhere, a tattooed arm reached up to hold on to his shoulder. If the trio was guilty before they now looked like they were about to cry, thinking that they had ruined their mama’s precious napping time.

“Hey gorgeous. I’ll take Fig Stew and Pienon with me on afternoon patrol today. You can go back to sleep. My hardworking fiancé deserves a break from the kids too, you know?” Phainon softly whispered while stroking Mydeimos’ soft hair.

“Kids…” Mydeimos mumbled out. The chimera used the hold on Phainon’s shoulder to push himself to sit up. Fig Stew after seeing his mama opened his eyes, jumped on the beanbag to curl up in his lap, with Coconut Beagle jumping after him.

“Yes, kids. Pienon, Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle” The wolf held up his hand, raising one finger after naming one member of the trio. The couple enjoyed the comfortable silence between them, which wasn’t long lasted as the critters caught onto the smell of the pastries in the oven. The two hybrids watched the small animals ran toward the kitchen, making all kind of excited sound.

Before Phainon could suggest they followed the critters to stop them from causing trouble, Mydeimos moved to straddle his legs. Like second nature, Phainon’s hand landed on the other’s waist as he tilted his head, wondering what the blonde was up to. Mydeimos had to hold back his laughter when he heard the rapid sound of a fluffy wolf tail slapping against the beanbag. Phainon reached his hand up to hold his lover’s face, smiling when he nuzzled into it. The nuzzling made it easier to hint at what the wolf wanted, thanks to Mydeimos’ cheek squished up against his hand it was easy to thumb at the blonde’s bottom lips.

Phainon pulled his lover into a loving kiss, which quickly turned into a make out session. While the lovebirds were tasting each other’s lips, Cipher was stuck with baby sitting duties.

“I swear that little lion is doing this on purpose!” The cat hybrid angrily munched on her pastries.

“You think that the little sea lion made a generous batch of your favorite pastries to lure you into looking after these three?” Hysilens said as she crotched down to pet Pienon’s fluffy coat.

“And you’re sure that Phainon and Mydeimos are probably doing some debauched thing during this time?” Castorice joined in, picking Fig Stew up.

“Wow, this is the first time I have ever heard of such a thing” Cerydra chimed up, sarcasm dripping off every word, as she held a tube of chimera treat for Coconut Beagle to lick.

Chapter End Notes

How did your Phaidei pulls went? I already have their E2S1 on their release banner. No E1 Tribbie for me... Shout out to Blade for giving me a guaranteed for his new form!
[No shade to my favorite stellaron hunter but Bladie... babygirl you're E2 is really... mediocre]

chapters.title: Chapter 46
chapters.html:
