There is a proverb in another country that said “Even god doesn’t smite at mealtime” [translated words for words]. But it seemed that didn’t apply to the Titans that they worshipped, Phainon had learned that recently.

By recently, he meant like not even a minutes ago. Phainon was where he always wanted to be, head between his lover’s legs, when he received an emergency call from Aglaea. Begrudgingly Phainon had to stop enjoying his meal and picked up the call. From Aglaea’s words, the emergency case needed Phainon and Pienon specifically as Cipher had managed to track down the location of where the dog-nappers had been keeping all of the stolen pets.

Mydeimos did sent Phainon on his way with a loving kiss and a promised that the wolf hybrid was extremely interested in, making him even more determined to find all the missing pets and potentially caught the pet-nappers. The two went their separate ways after the kiss, Phainon heading towards the door while Mydeimos made his way into the bathroom for a quick shower.

After a quick refreshing shower, Mydeimos sat down and opened his laptop and began working on his little project. The chimera hybrid had been distracting himself from the mansion issue by focusing on the little things for the wedding. Mydeimos was quite interested in using hyacinths to decorate the small flower vase on the guest tables. The blonde went in to a short rabbit hole and found out the myth behind the flowers. The flower carried the meaning of sorrow and mourning and in an alternative version of the myth, it even had the meaning of jealousy.

“Ah… so different color also carried different meanings” Mydeimos mumbled to himself as he continued scrolling through the website that Castorice had recommended him to check out. Purple hyacinths symbolize regret and sorrow, served as a reminder of the tragic tale of a god and a mortal. Yellow ones represent jealousy while pink carry a happier meaning – playful joy.

What had caught Mydeimos’ interest was blue and white hyacinths, as they reminded him of Phainon both color wise and symbolism-wise. Blue hyacinths symbolized sincerity and faithfulness, Phainon had always been genuine with his love and devotion towards Mydeimos. White hyacinths, the same color of Phainon’s fluffy hair and tail, convey purity, innocent and honesty. Phainon had always been an honest wolf hybrid, so much so that Mydeimos had forbid his lover from complimenting him in public. Not because he didn’t like them, but because he liked it and knew Phainon meant every word of it. It was impossible for Mydeimos to keep a serious face when his cheek was as bright as a tomato whenever Phainon compliment him. The chimera chuckled to himself as he read the word “purity and innocent”. If you associate Phainon with the word “innocent”, pre-relationship Mydeimos would believe it. However, now that the blonde was preparing for their wedding, Phainon was anything but innocent after Mydeimos gave the wolf all his firsts and the chimera had the bruises and hickies to show for it.

“Then again… I also couldn’t keep my hands and tail to myself whenever I saw him flaunting all those delicious biceps and abs” Mydeimos whispered to himself, unconsciously licking his lips as he recalled when Phainon indulged him on the half-naked apron during the time his tail was injured. His mind wandered off to that time where Phainon effortlessly lifted him up so he could grab something off the library shelf. Mydeimos broke out of his daydreaming when he heard a camera shutter going off.

“Ooh~ The wolf is going to pay a hefty sum for this adorable face. C’mon don’t pout at me little lion thinks of it as payment for taking care of the kids last time!” Cipher said with a cheery grin on her face then made herself at home in Mydeimos’ room. The cat hybrid grabbed a seat cushion and flopped down next to the blonde hybrid, checking out what he was looking at. It seemed like they both shared the same thought on how Phainon does not have a single drop of innocent in him, not after he managed to bag a Kremnoan baddie.

“You should ask Cassie about all this flower language stuffs. She had some notes tucked away under her bed” Cipher suggested, reaching over to steal a piece of rabbit shaped apple slice.

“You seem to be quite knowledgeable about what Castorice have in her bed” Mydeimos answered with a knowing smirk on his lips.

“Hey! It’s common knowledge in HQ that Cas loves flowers! Of course, she would have stuffs about their language in her room” Cipher immediately said, her tail moving around wildly as its owner was getting a bit flustered.

“You just happen to know that they’re stored under her bed. No wonder you’re the best informant in Okhema, not even Aglaea knew about what anyone have in their room. Well, Phainon’s wardrobe is a exception” The chimera continued his teasing, chuckling when the older girl punched his shoulder. It took Mydeimos a few minutes of looking through flower arrangement with Cipher next to him that he realized something was missing

“Cifera. Where’s my kids?” What was missing was the two chimeras that supposed to be with Cipher now that Phainon had dropped by to take Pienon. Everyone in the HQ had unanimously agreed that Coconot Beagle is a phaidei’s child after he came to visit the family every day.

“Oh shit… so that’s why I was looking for you!”

Mydeimos made a mad dash toward the HQ gate, frantically looking around for grey and orange. He let out a sign of relief when he spotted the two playing on the other side of the road. The two babies had sneaked off to follow Pienon and their papa. They successfully wandered off while Cipher was talking on the phone with her underling but failed to join Pienon on his mission as the car drove away faster than their little feet could ran.

“Fig Stew! Coconut Beagle! Do you know how much trouble you’re in right now? What did I tell you about wandering off? Just because your papa is on his way to recuse all the missing animals doesn’t mean that you’re safe from being kidnapped. Not when the criminals are still out there” Despite the gentle tone of Mydeimos’ voice, the two chimeras could tell that he was very upset. That was the first time Fig Stew was yelled at by Mydeimos. The critter not knowing how to react began crying despite his mama’s effort to keep his tone as soft as possible. Chimere see chimera do, after seeing the orange chimera cried, Coconut Beagle started sobbing too.

“Mimimi… mi me…” Fig Stew made a lot of sound, which Cipher assumed was sorry in chimera sounds as Mydeimos let out a sigh.

“The team often joked that I birthed you myself yet here you are… being a crybaby like your papa” The blonde picked Fig Stew up, taking out his handkerchief to wipe away the tears rolling down it face. He turned to thank Cipher when he saw her trying to soothe Coconut Beagle, who was confuse-crying because he saw Fig Stew cried. Mydeimos then check the time on his phone and made a humming sound. Cipher blinked confusedly when the blonde told her he knew why his baby was being a crybaby but followed him inside nonetheless.

As someone who rarely had the chance to see Mydeimos in his male wife glory, Cipher for once agreed with Phainon about her little brother simply oozed aura of domesticity and tradwife vibe. She watched as Mydeimos expertly balanced Coconut Beagle on his shoulder while Fig Stew was comfortably settled on his arm. The blonde hybrid moved around the kitchen with well-practiced steps, opening the cabinet door with his empty hand, grabbing the babies’ food then closing it with his tail as he stepped towards the fridge to grab whatever vegetable in there.

The chimeras were given a piece of carrot as a snack while their mama carefully cut the rest into cube with his one empty hand. Despite knowing that Mydeimos knew exactly what he was doing, Cipher still stepped in to help with the chopping. When it was time to put together the chimera’s food bowl, Cipher then learned a few more things that Fig Stew and Coconut had in common with Phainon.

The two chimeras loved beef bone broth. It was a given that Phainon and Pienon loved it since one was a wolf hybrid and the other was a dog but Cipher was surprised to learn that the two chimeras loved it too. The moment the two critters saw Mydeimos pouring the broth into their food bowls, Coconut Beagle jumped down to sneak a lick but Cipher was faster and caught him. That was when the cat hybrid learned now loud a chimera could whine. The grey chimera quiet down immediately after Mydeimos gave him chin scratches and a smooch on top of its head.

“Gosh… you’re sure this is your kids and not Phainon’s? The longer I stood her the more they act like that wolf” Cipher joked as she held Coconut Beagle up by its armpits(??).

“If we go by the team’s logic. If Fig Stew is my kid, then Coconut is Phainon’s… so, you need to start calling him your mama Coconut” Thankfully, Phainon wasn’t there to be offended that Coconut Beagle was on the verge of tear after Mydeimos told him that. The chimeras seemed to not vibe with the concept of calling Phainon “mama”, because Fig Stew was grimacing after hearing it too.  

“What did that boy even do to create this kind of reaction?” Cipher asked after catching her breath from the laughing fit she just had. Mydeimos looked at the chimera in his arm and asked him about it. Turned out, it was because Phainon kept stealing their cookies and hogging their mama’s cuddle time. Fig Stew even complaint that when Mydeimos started wearing the ring, he stopped giving him “dry bath time”. Which resulted in Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle being brought to the bathtub.

“Cipher… I’m starting to think Fig Stew is actually Phainon’s kids” The reason why Mydeimos stopped giving Fig Stew his “dry bath” was because the orange chimera and Coconut Beagle bathe each other daily. So, it was quite redundant for the hybrid to bathe him again a few hours later. Now here Mydeimos stood, frozen as Fig Stew wanted to bathe twice a day. As much as the two hybrids wanted to joke around with who being whose kid, the small stomach grumbling from Fig Stew reminded them about what they were doing.

A few minutes later, the chimeras’ food was prepared, packed full with all the necessary nutrients that the pellets at the Garden of Life but way more delicious than them.

“Y’know now that I think about it… Pienon is more like you, little lion. He loves napping, always taking care of his brothers and even the babysitters too” Cipher recalled that one time she and Castorice were playing with them, weaving flowers crown where Cas accidentally pricked her finger after trying to weave a branch of roses into her crown. Pienon noticed it, ran off and magically returned with a med-kit. The girls till this day still have no idea where the Samoyed got it.

“Phainon also loves to take care of others… The only thing Pie takes after me is the napping… Do I nap around that much for it to be part of my personality trait?” Great Cipher was continuing the joke earlier up but instead of joining in Mydeimos was now insecure about his nap times.

“It’s a feline thing. Don’t worry too much about it, little lion. Phainon is going to be very upset if you stopped taking naps” Mydeimos tilted his head at that statement. Cipher didn’t have the heart to tell the chimera hybrid that he’s grumpy whenever he didn’t get to take his cat-nap.

Thankfully, the topic was dropped when Coconut Beagle and Fig Stew finished their lunch and started yawning. Now that’s was something that the chimeras took after Mydeimos, but Cipher was sure that isn’t something she should tell him. Mydeimos picked up the two bundle of cuteness and walked towards his and Phainon’s room. Cipher took the opportunity to start recording the wholesome routine.

The video showed Fig Stew sleeping face as he was draped over Mydeimos’ shoulder. When they entered the couple’s shared room, the chimera hybrid walked toward the giant dog bed at the foot of the bed and set the two chimeras down on it. Fig Stew was already out like a light when he was set on Pienon’s bed while Coconut Beagle took some time to find a comfortable position to snuggle up to the other. The two formed a cuddle ball and it was the cutest thing the internet had ever seen.  

Mydeimos was reminded about what he was doing earlier. Picking out flower for his wedding bouquet and for the vase at guest tables. After a bit of staring at the blue hyacinths, the blonde decided to include it in the flower arrangement for the guest table. As for his bouquet, he wanted a simple mix of blue and red roses. Why roses some might ask. Mydeimos simply like them because they reminded him of the gift that Phainon had been working different jobs to save up for.

///

During that anniversary, the wolf had given him a beautiful sapphire earing. The very same one that he had been wearing on his right ear. Phainon also gave him a matching sapphire necklace with the pendant having the same design as the earing. Given how expensive sapphire is and factor in how high quality the ones on the necklace and earing, no wonder Phainon had to work extra jobs. But that wasn’t all of it. A few months before their anniversary, Phainon had been talking and noting down advices from Castorice about flower language, and shown quite the interest in roses. Then came the highly anticipated day of their relationship, Phainon had gifted his boyfriend the very same flowers that he was researching about.

A bouquet of pink roses to symbolize for Phainon’s undying love and graditute towards Mydeimos for loving him and continued to love him despite all the wolf’s flaws. A bouquet of white roses to show his sincerity, it was also the color of roses that was recommended for him to get as an anniversary gift. A bouquet of lavender roses to symbolize love at first sight. And one bouquet of burgundy and one of coral roses to convey Phainon’s passion, desire and attraction towards Mydeimos. When the blonde thought that was the end, Phainon reached out for his hands to press a gentle kiss on it. Then, he pressed another kiss on Mydeimos’ shoulder, then his neck, his ear and finally gave him a French kiss that took the blonde breath away. When Mydeimos opened his eyes again after the passionate kiss, behind Phainon was a giant bouquet of red roses. What Phainon had said next was engraved into Mydeimos’ mind

“My love, my Mydeimos, my Mydei… I wanted to gift you all 999 of these red roses to say that my love for you will last till the end of time” Phainon then reached up to remove the flower crown that he had given the blonde earlier during their date, turning it to show two more red roses that was hidden from Mydeimos’ eyes on purpose.

“1001 red roses, to show a faithful and undying love that will live on forever. I, Phainon Khaslana swear to you Mydeimos, that I will always love you in every lifetime and in every universe” That night Mydeimos had cried tears of absolute joy and happiness as he jumped into Phainon’s arms.  

///

While Mydeimos was lost in land of daydreaming, Phainon had finished up his work and with Pienon’s help they even managed to track down the pet-nappers. As rewards for their hard work, Aglaea sent Pienon to a pet spa to get him professionally clean and trim his coat while Phainon was given a few days off to spent with the rest of Mydeimos’ paid vacation.

“Oh my. Someone’s happy today” Phainon said as he effortlessly caught the blonde hybrid that jump on him, supporting his butt with one arm. A light blush crept on the wolf’s face as his fiancé’s tail slithered down to wrap around his leg.

“I love you, Phai”

“Wow you’re really happy today! Love you too Mydei~” Phainon happily reciprocate the kiss that Mydeimos gave him after his words. The wolf hybrid set the other man down on the bed then climbed on top of him. After all the time spent indulging and loving Phainon, Mydeimos knew immediately what his lover wanted and titled his head aside. The wolf gave him a chaste kiss as thank, then dove down to inhale the sweet pomegranate scent that he had definitely got addicted too. They spent a few moments staying like that, with Phainon recharging his Mydei battery while Mydeimos enjoyed the comfortable weight and warmth on top of him.

Phainon was really excited to tell Mydeimos what happened during his mission. The chimera had such a love-struck smile on his face while watching and listening to the wolf hybrid’s expressive face as he told his story. Thanks to their heighten senses, Phainon and Pienon managed to find one of the underground storages that was keeping a dozen of missing pets.

“Pienon was such a big help today! That puppy has your calming aura, Mydei. The moment he stepped into the temporary shelter all the small size dogs and puppy immediately quiet down and ran towards Pie for licks and snuggles” The Samoyed was being such a good helper, staying by the puppies to keep them calm while the veterinarian checked on their health.

“I asked Aglaea to let Pie help at the shelter while I went back in the forest to scout for any more clues or traces of the criminals” Mydeimos’ heart dropped when Phainon opened his shirt to show him his bandaged torso. The wolf was ambushed when he was checking out the suspicious slash marks on the trees. Phainon looked away too happy when he confidently said that his Mydei lucky charm had given him the luck to only got graze by a bullet.

“I don’t know whether to be happy that you not severely injured or be mad that you not only stole my undergarment but you have the audacity to bring it with you and called it your lucky charm”

“You can have my boxer! That way we’re even and I can keep your panties!”

“I don’t want your boxer!!”

Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle woke up from their nap after Phainon’s shirt fell on the floor. With Phainon still in it. Mydeimos was happy to see Phainon home, enough to jump into his arms and said those three-magic words. But not happy enough to let Phainon see which color was his undergarment that day.

chapters.title: Chapter 47
chapters.html:
The planning for the wedding is going swimmingly well and quick. All thanks to Phainon showing Mydeimos a picture of him laying on the ground with a bunch of puppies and kittens snuggling and licking at his face. The girls seemed to understand what had caused the chimera hybrid to lock in and speed up the wedding plan. Meanwhile, Phainon had no idea why some of Krateros’ underlings decided to gift him Zinc and D-aspartic acid supplements. Naturally, Phainon went to ask Hyacine and Anaxa about the supplements. The pink haired girl was hesitant to tell him but the professor was not.

“The retired bodyguards want grandkids”

“Oh” Was all Phainon could utter out as he listened to the mint-haired man explained what those supplements could help with. The wolf didn’t know whether to be thankful that Mydeimos’ retired bodyguards were looking out for him or be offended that they were doubting his Dawn Maker.

On the bright side of the ordeal, Mydeimos got a pretty good laugh after hearing about what Krateros’ underlings had done. Phainon was certainly not complaining about the kisses to help wipe away the pout on his face.

“It seemed like you’re not the only that forgot about your own words” Mydeimos said while trying to get comfortable in Phainon’s lap. The wolf saw what his lover was trying to do and reached over to grab a pillow to cushion the orange tail, preventing it from pressing against his stomach, so both could be comfortable. Phainon was about to play some videogame on his phone but quickly gave up because of Mydeimos’ well-gifted pecs blocking his view as he looked down.

“Sometime I wonder how you managed to see what’s under you with these blocking the way” Phainon gave his lover’s chest a generous squeeze, pressing against the fat to show how much space they were covering.

“Any who, what was that about me forgetting my own words?” The white-haired hybrid asked, his hands still hadn’t stopped fondling his lover’s chest. What’s worse was that Mydeimos didn’t even stop his fiancé’s inappropriate behavior. The chimera even started purring as he tried to jog Phainon’s memory.

[“Want another one?” Mydeimos teased his lover, grabbing Phainon’s hand to put it on his stomach.

“Tempting. Ask me about that a few more years later, preferably 3 years after we’re married. I still haven’t had my fill of your attention” Phainon moved the hand that was on Mydeimos’ stomach to hold his lover’s chin, pulling him into a kiss.]

Phainon had completely forgot about that. To no one surprise. The wolf hybrid began whining, telling Mydeimos that he shouldn’t listen to past Phainon aka pre-fiancé’d Phainon. The hybrid leaning against Phainon’s chest began purring even louder as he listened to Phainon babbling about how he would want them to move out of the HQ so the future mini-Phainon and mini-Mydei could have their own bedroom and playroom. He also wanted to get a house that have a patio that get a lot of sunlight for Mydeimos to sunbathe in the morning. Waxing poetry about how beautiful and soft the chimera would look at the early morning sun shine down on his gorgeous face. Future Phainon would take a picture of that scene everyday then walked over to give wifey Mydeimos a kiss then joined him. The two of then enjoying the warmth of the sun together, Phainon spending that time licking and inhaling Mydeimos’ sweet scent. Both of them enjoying the quite morning in each other embrace before the mini-PhaiDeilings woke up and demanded their mama and papa’s attention.   

“Seeing how you care for Pienon, Fig Stew and Coconut Beagle, I know for sure that you’re going to be such a wonderful mama” Not to mention the chimera already have the body perfect for having babies, Phainon’s hands could vouch for it. Mydeimos being a good mother was an undeniable truth, the “M” in Mydeimos stands for mother/mama after all.

Tribios could tell that the chimera hybrid would be a wonderful partner and parent the moment she saw how lovingly and meticulously he had groom Phainon’s ears and tail. She believed that Mydeimos had inherited Gorgo’s gentleness and kindness because there was zero to no chance a child that was taught how to kill his entire life could be that gentle to a stranger he met not even a month ago. 

Hyacine, the chimera caretaker and expert at the Garden of Life, had seen how Mydeimos interacted with the chimeras. And the chimeras, being the smart creature that they are, warmed up to the giant intimidating chimera that walked on two legs after they saw him being his usual motherly self toward baby Fig Stew.

Mydeimos had mothered so hard that he even managed to get Anaxa to eat proper food and Cipher to join everyone at the dinner table. Aglaea had told Hysilens and Cerydra that the blonde man was a miracle bestowed upon the special investigation team.

“And you, Phainon, will be the best papa for our future little ones” Mydeimos pressed a kiss to the underside of his lover’s jaw. He happily reciprocated the kiss that Phainon gave him. Their little lovely dovely time ended after that quick kiss as both could hear the pitter patter of clawed paws from the hallway. Mentioned little ones and the little ones showed up, Mydeimos chuckled at the timing of the trio of cuteness. The blonde patted the empty space between his legs and Pienon happily laid down on his lap. The Samoyed was getting a little bit too big to fit on Mydeimos’ lap.

After Pienon had settled comfortably, he gave the other two a quick bark and Coconut Beagle and Fig Stew joined their family cuddle pile.

“How did your little day trip with Castorice and Hyacine went? Have all of you been good bois?” Phainon asked the critters and received a lot of positive sounds. Fig Stew was telling his mama that auntie Cassie took them to the flower market and they were allowed to sniff a lot of new smells. Coconut Beagle joined in saying that one of the vendors even gave him a spoonful of honey. Hyacine told them that the honey was a monofloral one. Pienon even remembered her explanation, which Phainon was more than happy to translate. All of them remembered the name of the plant that the bees were pollenating – Chestnut.

The two chimeras were getting a little too excited, jumping and running around as they enthusiastically recreated the puppet show that Hyacine took them to see. The two quite down with a guilty look in their eyes when Mydeimos’ tail caught them, stopping the two from rolling into Phainon’s injured side. Pienon being a responsible big brother, herded Coconut Beagle and Fig Stew outside to burn off all of their sugar induced energy. Since the kids were off to play, Mydeimos decided to use the time to chance Phainon’s bandages. Who would have thought that the wolf hybrid that didn’t even notice he got grazed with a bullet was the same hybrid as the one whimpering every time Mydeimos tried to clean his wound with disinfectant. If you asked Hyacine and Anaxa, who had been treating Phainon’s wound prior to Mydeimos’ arrival, they would say that Phainon was fishing for kisses and praises from Mydeimos.

“Just bear it for a little bit more, okay?... I know sweetie it stings but you’re a good boy, right? Just a few more dabs and I’ll bandage it up” Mydeimos, blinded by love, shushed the wolf hybrid. He even gave him kisses as reward for being so brave and good for sitting still. If any of the girls were there, they would have the most judgmental look on their face after seeing how Phainon acted. After asking Mydeimos to “kiss his booboos away”, Phainon picked him up bridal style and headed to the HQ’s kitchen so his fiancé could make him some afternoon snack.

As they walked by the lounge area, conveniently Aglaea was on her way to look for them. The wolf hybrid immediately dashed to her office after she said that the wedding suits were done. The woman did try to uphold Mydeimos’ wish of not telling Phainon about his suit. But seeing that the man himself spoiled it to his very spoiled fiancé, she did not stop the wolf hybrid from seeing the final product.

Phainon was extremely happy about his suit. He really loved that blue cape had the embroidery of his fiancé’ chest marking on the back, the little dash of gold here and there was also a nice touch. The wolf was making finger guns at his reflection while waiting for Mydeimos to put on his suit.

“How lucky you are Mydei! Look at how handsome your future husband is~ Imagine waking up to this every day!” Phainon said as he winked at himself, whistling at his own handsome face. Aglaea wanted to strangle him. All that confident about his looks was immediately washed away when Mydeimos walked out of the changing room.

The chimera hybrid was gorgeous in his suit. The two hybrids were matching, just like Mydeimos had told Phainon. The blue accents on the wolf’s white suit were replaced by red on Mydeimos’. And instead of a cape draped over one shoulder, the blonde’ suit’ tail extended past his hip and down to his feet. The extended fabric was then tailored into a ball grown skirt that split and parted down the middle to show of the blonde’ long legs.

Phainon was positively speechless and could only dumbly walked up to his fiancé and held both his hand in his.

“Mydei… I… Titans… Is this real? I’m not dreaming right?”

“You look as handsome as you were saying to yourself, Phai. Thank you Aglaea. Thank you for bringing my vision to life”

“It was my pleasure, Mydeimos. The two of you look gorgeous together. How about you do a twirl for your future husband, Mydeimos? I’m sure he wouldn’t want to miss out on the detail that you personally added” Mydeimos was as red as his own tattoos as Aglaea said it. After some encouragement and puppy dog eyes from Phainon, the chimera relented and turned around to show the back of his suit.

“Titans… How are you real, Mydeimos…” Phainon was awestruck as he saw the backless design of the suit. More importantly, Mydeimos was wearing body jewelry and there was an adorable bow at the tip of his tail. The wolf didn’t care that his boss was in the room with them, he grabbed Mydeimos and twirled him around into a dip. As his hand was supporting Mydeimos’ back, Phainon leaned down for a kiss before catching his fiancé off guard by slipping his free hand down to lift him up in a bridal carry.

“Would you like a free trial of your honeymoon, Mydei~?”

“I’m glad that you both like your wedding suits but change back into your normal clothes before leaving this room please”

[I'm not by any mean an artist or designer but I saw this https://offbeatwed.com/gay-groom-fashion/ and couldn't stop thinking about Mydeimos in that garment]

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 48
chapters.html:
On this chapter of “thing Mydeimos learn after being free from the lab”, Mydeimos came across a devastating news that related to Phainon. One that he couldn’t even bring himself to believe the words written on the wolf’s ID card.

It started with Mydeimos walking in on their co-worker complaining about how bad their photo looked on their new ID cards. One of the co-workers gathered in the breakroom asked how they managed to lost their ID card and was given the classic reply of “Idk”. Another reassured the one the lost their ID card that everyone’s picture on their ID looked terrible and took out his to show the rest of the crew. All the attention suddenly turned towards Mydeimos and the newly arrived Phainon, thanks to the wolf’s calling his lover’s. Phainon had called out for Mydeimos in such a specific happy sing-song-y voice that some of the student at the police academy used it as a vocal stim.

They got roped into showing their ID cards to prove how bad the photos were taken. The co-workers thought that the couple were hesitant because they didn’t want people to see a bad picture of their faces but that wasn’t the reason why. You see, thanks to their job in the special investigation team, all the Chrysos members got special treatment. Said special treatment was that Aglaea was the on in charge of the final step of making their ID cards. Which naturally mean that their picture had to meet the designer’s standard.

“Gods and Titans have their favorites…” One of the girls said after she take a look at Phainon and Mydeimos’ card. The chimera hybrid got curious and glanced at the other’s ID photo. Phainon looked relatively similar to when he got his picture taken.

“What do you think Mydei? I’m still as handsome at my younger self, right?” Phainon being Phainon started fishing for praises from his lover whenever he felt like it. After hearing the word “younger”, curiosity spiked in Mydeimos’ mind and his eyes glanced towards Phainon’s birth year. After seeing the number, the chimera excused himself and Phainon then grabbed the other’s arm and dragged him away. The sergeant saw the serious look on Mydeimos face and allowed him to take the rest of the day off. After listening to one of Cipher’s story, everyone at the station was already ready with an excuse in the mind to get the two male hybrids out of the place. The last time those two have a lover quarrel, they destroyed the training room. With the everyone working at the station knew how Mydeimos could tear open a truck and Phainon’s breaking their reinforced steel cell bar without a sweat, safe to say that no one want their power couple to have their lover quarrel in the office.

“What’s wrong, love? Don’t tell me that my handsome early twenty face did something to you” And just like that Phainon had confirmed what the chimera just learned. The two sat down inside the limo and the wolf started to get worry when he saw those furrowed brows.

“Phainon… you never told me that you’re…” The chimera took a quick pause seemingly thinking about something

“Mydei… please tell me what’s wrong. I never hid anything from you on purpose” Mydeimos felt guilty for making his lover worry so much over this matter.

“Phainon, you never mentioned that you’re 4 years older than me…” The wolf was panicking and sweating bucket after he heard that. The chimera could feel how clammy the wolf’s hands were as they grabbed his.

“Baby- wait no that probably not a suitable petname for this situation. *Ehem* Sweetcake, I’m sorry for not telling you that. Please don’t cancel our engagement and wedding because of our age gap” The situation de-escalated quickly as Mydeimos couldn’t hold off his laughter. The chimera climbing onto his lap and giggling into his shoulder helped Phainon calmed his nerves immensely. The wolf had a pout on his face when his lover kept laughing without telling him why. Phainon being the genius that he is, decided that the best way to stop Mydeimos’ laughter was kissing.

The chauffer opened the door to the sight of Phainon pining his young master down on the seat. Phainon pulled away immediately after he saw the driver but Mydeimos wasn’t done with what the wolf had started and pulled him down by his choker and shoved his tongue back inside his lover’s mouth.

“I see that you haven’t read through the instruction book. On page 12, it is stated that when this happened you shouldn’t stare at either Phainon or the young master and the best course of action is to close the door” Krateros grabbed the door handle and closed it while showing the new chauffer why his uncle gave him an instruction book.

If you caught the lovebird mid make-out, you shouldn’t stare and close the door. Because 1. It’s rude to intrude on the young master’s private time with his boyfriend, the words fiancé/husband was added in using a pen. And 2, both Phainon and the young master are extremely possessive and does not like other looking at the sight that only they should see.  If you had made the mistake of igniting either hybrids’ possessiveness, prepared the necessary items depend on who you had accidentally looked at.

If you accidentally made eye contact with the young master and Phainon noticed it, close the door and go grab a med-kit. Reassured the one needing it will not be you but the young master. Phainon likes to bite when he gets jealous and his fangs aren’t small.

If you looked at Phainon and the young master saw it, close the door and contact Krateros to get the limo clean. Don’t let the young master’s demeanor fool you, 9 out of 10 times that he and Phainon decided to do it in the limo was initiated by him.

“I can’t believe that the old chauffeur has an instruction book specifically for us…” Phainon said after Mydeimos finally let him breathe again. He gave the chimera hybrid’s tail a firm smack to get him to behave. It’s not safe to be moving about like that while there’s a great sword under his butt. Thankfully the smack managed to get Mydeimos to actually behave himself rather than start something else. Phainon finally got his answer as to why his lover was laughing at him earlier.

“I find it funny that you think that there’s even a chance that I would call off our wedding. I was just surprised to know that you’re 4 years older than me, it was hard to believe it given how you act”

“Hey! What’s that suppose to mean!?” A pout formed on Phainon’s lips, further proving his fiancé’s point.

“You act more like a puppy rather than a wolf” Mydeimos chuckled as he reached up to scratch the wolf’s ear, his eyes softening when Phainon leaned into the touch. It would have been a romantic scene when Mydeimos decided to bridal carry Phainon out of the limo, if the blonde didn’t joke about his fiancé’s age. Phainon had taken a mental note to show his lover who is going to have a back problem tomorrow morning.

The next day, Cipher was having her morning coffee when Phainon and Mydeimos returned from their little night out.

“Morning, lil lion! Someone is glowing today and damn Phainon… you looked like you’ve been pffft mauled by a lion”

Whatever happened last night had left Phainon with bitemarks all over his body, not to mention the red lines on his back. Meanwhile, Mydeimos looked extremely pleased with himself. Cipher could hold back her laughter after Mydeimos told her what happened.

“I took Phainon out for a test ride. He did offer a free trial of the honeymoon. So, while we’re at it I wanted to see what’s the deal with biting and now I understand why he likes it.”

chapters.title: Chapter 49
chapters.html:
Phainon woke up in a bed that wasn’t his. It wasn’t an unfamiliar one as he had had trouble leaving the comfy bed before. The wolf hybrid went to bed with his lover and woke up in Castrum Kremnos, somehow.

First thing Phainon noticed was the lack of an orange tail coiled around his leg. Second was the lack of a purring chimera hybrid snuggling against his body. After stumbling out of bed sleepy and confuse, Phainon finally noticed that he had more clothes on compared to the single boxer he wore to sleep last night. The wolf hybrid made his way into the bathroom, hoping to catch his fiancé while he was moisturizing his tail, but there was no one in the connected room. Except for his own toothbrush and the brushes for his hair and tail. Phainon decided to complete his daily hygiene first before leaving the room. Mydeimos made it very clear about the no kisses until after they brushed their teeth.

“Look who decided to finally wake up” Mydeimos said without looking at the wolf hybrid that just entered the kitchen. After spending so much time inhaling Phainon’s scent, Mydeimos had developed the ability to sniff it out amid all the mouth-watering aromas from his cooking. If was also thanks to spending much time with Phainon, the blonde knew exactly what his fiancé wanted and quickly turned off the stove. Mydeimos was then swept off his feet and set on the kitchen island. The chimera’s arms were opened to let his lover buried his face into his chest.

“Morning to you too, my handsome wolf. What would you like for breakfast? I made honeycakes, hashbrowns, bacons and-“ Mydeimos was cut off by the kiss Phainon pressed on his lips. The wolf pulled back with a grin on his face.

“You. Please~”

“You sure you can keep it in your pants for 3 years, boy? Cause from what I’m seeing now, I’m afraid the young master would be with child after the first day of your honeymoon” Krateros, who had been sitting at the dinning table, spoke up. He then took a long sip of coffee while staring at Phainon slowly turning into a tomato. The butler also pointed out that the wolf’s excited tail was going to knock over the pan on the stove behind him.

Phainon then realized that the reason why Mydeimos made so much dishes was because Krateros and his men was also there. The bodyguards plus both new and old chauffeur didn’t say anything, only gave Phainon a knowing smile before turning their attention back to their breakfast. The wolf was about to retreat back to the master bedroom but an orange tail got a hold of his wrist. Mydeimos then pulled Phainon back to standing between his legs, caged him in with them and kissed the life out of him. There were definitely snickers from the men when Phainon’s legs turned into jelly after the kiss and he slowly slid down to sit on the floor.

“Anything else to go with your breakfast? Dear future husband~?”

“Honeycakes… and sunny side up eggs please…” Phainon could only dumbly nodded when Mydeimos asked if he wanted some salad and apple juice with those food items. It was Krateros that was the one unable to hold back his snort when he heard Phainon’s drink of choice for breakfast. Seeing the heart shaped eggs bounced Phainon right back into a happy simp for Mydeimos. His tail-icopter was back in operation after the first forkful of honeycakes that his lover fed him.

“Leave the plates, Krateros will take care of them. Let’s go see what Aglaea and the girls had in store for the venue” Phainon didn’t expect to be blindfolded outside of their bedroom. With Mydeimos holding both his hand and leading him, the wolf made it outside without bumping into anything. The rest of the way was simple as they only needed to head inside the limo to get to mama Gorgo’s pomegranate tree. The chimera hybrid took advantaged of Phainon sightless state to tease him, blowing puff of air at his ears, poking his cheeks and pressing kisses all around Phainon’s face while the victim had no idea what would come next.

The walk uphill was short and the blindfold was removed but Phainon was keeping his eyes closed as his arms waved around to feel for Mydeimos. When he finally grabbed onto the blonde, his arms patted it way up until he was able to hold Mydeimos’ face. The wolf hybrid only opened his eyes when he pulled his lover’s face close enough so that the first thing he see was the chimera’s beautiful eyes.

“Sorry, love. I just wanted to make sure you’re the first thing I see after opening my eyes the second time today. I was missing my daily dose of waking up to my beautiful fiancé. *sigh* the only thing missing from my daily dose of waking up to your pretty face was you being naked in bed” Phainon had such a way with ruining a romantic moment. Mydeimos rolled his eyes so hard that Phainon was afraid that they were going to fall off.

Phainon finally laid eyes on the ceremony venue after Mydeimos squished his face and tilted his face toward the side.

The first thing that caught the future groom’s eyes was the floral archway positioned right under the pomegranate tree. The archway was decorated in red, white and blue flowers. When Phainon got close and took a closer look, he noticed some of the blue was from the bunches of forget-me-nots. There were also blue Hydrangeas and blue Anemones in with purple ones dotted here and there. The florist had incorporated some bunches of white hydrangeas and daisies mixed with the red and blue. Speaking of red, even though there was only a few but Phainon was able to spot some red pomegranate flowers that was added in next to the bunches of red roses. The red was also made of other red flowers to add more variety into the archway, such as carnations and red tulips.

The pomegranate tree is decorated in warm fairy lights, coupled with the lanterns dotted here and there in the venue Phainon slowly came to the conclusion of their wedding theme. The guest chairs were decorated with similar flower arrangement as the archway, draping down the back. The lush green grass helped brought the whole venue together.

“Mydei… This look like…”

“Like it’s from a fairytale?” Mydeimos finished the thought, softly smile at Phainon’s awe struck face. The chimera took hold of his lover’s hand again and lead him to stand in front of the pomegranate tree.

“Mother… There’s someone I would love for you to meet” He turned to Phainon, that warm and soft smile that the wolf loved so much still on his lips

“This is Phainon. The one that broke down the walls of my prison, the one that accepted me flaws and all… And the one I fell in love with”

Chapter End Notes

chapters.title: Chapter 50
chapters.html:
Spring arrived bringing with it a new breath of air, indicating a new page of life. Under the tree that Gorgo had planted more than two decades ago, a memorable and lifechanging ceremony was being held. Thanks to the weather change, The grass turned into a more vibrant color, a perfect touch to create the suitable picture of an enchanted forest straight out of a fairytale. The seats were filled with the ones that were close to both the grooms: everyone from the Chrysos special investigation team, all of the workers at the coffee shop.

The small orchestra that Hysilens had brought together and was also a part of, took in the cue and changed the music to the songs for the processional. The change mark the official start of the ceremony. As the soft music danced through the air, the official made his way towards the pomegranate tree.

One of the main stars of the day slowly made his way down the aisle. Phainon Khaslana, the soon to be wedded hybrid was escorted by Aglaea and Anaxa. Behind him was Cipher and Hyacine, both dressed in a beautiful white flowy dress made of satin. Following them was Tribios and the maid of honor – Castorice. The flower boy, who was none other than Pienon, was doing a phenomenal job, shaking his head to scatter the petals.

After the groom took his place at the altar, the ring bearers made their way down the aisle. Coconut Beagle and Fig Stew walked side by side, each were wearing a cute little bowtie on their tail. On the chimeras’ backs was a plush cushion, with a ring embedded on each one.  The two critters made their way towards the person that they were taught to go to, Fig Stew walked towards Cipher while Coconut Beagle made his way to Castorice. The two girls quickly untied the small ribbon holding the cushion to their back, picked them and the cushion up in their arms. Without messing up the dresses, Coconut Beagle and Fig Stew climbed over the girls’ shoulder and draped themselves there, hooking their tail on the girls’ arm to secure their places.

The moment everyone saw Phainon’s eyes lit up, his well-groomed tail began wagging and a blindingly bright smile appeared on his face, they knew to turn their eyes toward the entrance of the venue.

“You looked just as beautiful as Lady Gorgo was during her wedding” Krateros whispered to the young master.

“Thank you Krateros… for taking care of me and walking me down the aisle” The chimera hybrid smiled at the man, the butler who had stepped up and cared for him when his father was serving his consequences.

The suit Aglaea had designed was stunning, hugging Mydeimos’ waist just right to give off the air of elegance. As the blonde walked down the aisle, escorted by his butler, he couldn’t hold his chuckle when he saw Phainon and his excited tail. Thankfully all eyes were on the gorgeous Mydeimos, so no one noticed how the officiant was struggling to hold Phainon by the end of his cape, trying to stop him from running toward his soon-to-be-husband. The only one that notice his struggle was Cipher, who was also struggling to hold back her cackle, not wanting to ruin her lil’ bro moment.

Sunday, who was the officiant, was not built to hold back a wolf hybrid that could body slam opened a reinforce door. As such the moment Krateros stepped aside to take his seat, Phainon almost yanked the priest with him when he ran over to Mydeimos. Thank the titans for Castorice and Cipher or that would have been a very embarrassing moment.

When it was time to exchange vows, many emotions were in the air. Laughter was heard; tears were also shed. A few chuckles here and there when the grooms wanted to one up each other in the vows.

“Mydeimos, I promise that my heart will always belong to you and only you. No matter how long time had passed be it 3 decades or 30 million years, my heart will only have space for you in it, and my tail will only wag at the sight of you”

“Phainon, I promise that only one that I will entrust my heart to will only be you. The moment you gave me that uniquely distinguish looking vase as a courting gift, my heart was already placed in your hand. Even if a billion lifetimes had passed, I would still entrust my heart to you because it seek to be one wolf hybrid and one wolf hybrid only. Even if he, more often than not, acts like an adorable puppy.”

To everyone’s surprise, it was Mydeimos that could hold back his tears the moment Phainon put the wedding ring on his left ring finger. Castorice, living up to her role of Maid of honor, was well-prepared and quickly handed Phainon a tissue. Aglaea had a proud smile on her face when she saw Phainon dapped the tissue on Mydeimos’ face, not just wiping away the tears to smudge the blonde’ make-up. As Phainon was done helping Mydeimos, a gentle gush of wind blew through the tree’s canopy, rustling the leaves and rained down a few petals of pomegranate flowers.

Krateros eyes widened as a perfectly intact pomegranate flower landed on Phainon’s and Mydeimos’ intertwine hands. Seemed like this marriage had mama Gorgo full support and blessing.

Phainon, do you take Mydeimos to be your lawfully wedded husband? Do you promise to love and cherish him, in good times and in bad, in sickness and in health, for richer for poorer, for better for worse, and forsaking all others, keep yourself only unto him, for as long as you both shall live?

“I do”

 

Mydeimos, do you take Phainon to be your lawfully wedded husband? Do you promise to love and cherish him, in good times and in bad, in sickness and in health, for richer for poorer, for better for worse, and forsaking all others, keep yourself only unto him, for as long as you both shall live?

“I do”

By the authority vested in me by the City of Okhema, I now pronounce you husband and husband and what the titans hath joined together, let no man nor woman put asunder. You may now-

Sunday didn’t even get to finish his words as Phainon swept Mydeimos up into a bridal carry and kiss him. He’s starting to believe that Cerydra wanted him to be the wedding officiant instead of the one from the council was solely because of this. Well, he was thankful that he’s from Penacony because who in their right mind would turn down the invitation to the wedding reception? The old geezers at the Okhema’s council might, not Sunday. The food served there was phenomenal.

“Congratz lil’ lion! Soooo what’s the plan for the honeymoon~” Cipher asked as she wiggle her eyebrows. It was a bait, one that Phainon took without hesitation as he listed out all the places, he wanted them to visit. If the newly weds really went with Phainon’s plan, their honeymoon would last for weeks.

“You just listed almost every country recommended as a perfect place to have your honeymoon on the latest magazine. Surely you could come up with something more interesting than that” Cipher continued with her mission, leading Phainon towards the surprise that Mydeimos had been preparing ever since their 1st anniversary. The wolf took a moment to think before mentioning that he always wanted to visit the Kremos Arena when he was a child. A perfect segway to the surprise.

“Phainon, how about-“

“Husband” Phainon cut the blonde off, pointing to the ruby ring on his finger then turned around and gestured toward the entire venue.

“Pfft. Of course, how could I forget. Husband, how about we visit somewhere more familiar to you. I already have my wish to have our wedding here. Now it’s your turn” Mydeimos said as he led his husband to where Cerydra and Tribios were talking. As he gave them a nod, the red-haired lady brought out a tablet. The device was showing the footage of a security camera, and Phainon was understandably confused. His little head tilt was too cute for Mydeimos not to kiss, which resulted in Phainon affectionately cling onto him and shamelessly kissing and licking at his nape.

“I’ll allow this unsightly scene this time, as it is your wedding day. Since you still haven’t notice it, let move to a different camera angle”

Then it finally hit Phainon. The dock in the footage was the very same one in his childhood. Cerydra then once again move to a different camera, this time showing a plaza with a statue of Oronyx. Another clicks, and the tablet showed the scene of endless golden wheatfield. Then Mydeimos took out his teleslate, to show his husband the surprise that he had been working on for so long.

Mydeimos’ teleslate was showing a picture of him sitting at the edge of the dock with his legs in the water.

“I tried my best to restore what Aedes Elysiae once looked like. My men had been working tirelessly since trying to track down and locate any survivor from the fire had burned down everything. Does the name Galba ring any bell, Phai- *ehem* husband?”

“Galba… our village hunter?” Phainon asked in disbelieved, his eyes started watering as he listened to his husband.

“He tried his best to save what he could. But was only able to save a girl named Livia and his son Piso. Of course, he also didn’t escape the fire without injury, but from what Krateros had told me, the man had said that he is willing to trade his leg for the lives of two children”

“Mydei… baby you didn’t have to… I- I don’t know h-how I could ever repay you”

“You could start with loving him and cherishing him♪~”  Phainon turned to see the owner of the voice. A pink haired lady had approached them, smiling and waving at the others. It seemed like she had met the other three members of the Chrysos team. As she stood next to them, Phainon noticed a burn scar on her delicate face, covering the area from under her eyes towards her neck.

“Hi~ We finally meet again, Phainon. Remember me?” Said wolf hybrid was having trouble processing, his brain shut down when the girl walked over to hug Mydeimos and the blonde returned the hug.

“Oh my! I knew you were pretty from Miss Tribios’ picture. The camera doesn’t do your gorgeous hair and eyes any justice! Even though we’ve talked through texts and calls before but~ Why don’t you introduce this beauty, Phainon?”

“C-Cyrene? I- you… how?” The wolf managed to stammer out.

“Geez~ Thanks for introducing me to your husband, Phainon. Now let get to the good part! How long do you plan on staying at Aedes Elysiae for your honeymoon?”

“Apologies, Miss Cyrene. I think my husband need sometime to take it all in. Please excuse us for a moment”

“Just Cyrene is fine!” The pink haired girl waved at the couple as Mydeimos led Phainon to somewhere more private.

Mydeimos was expecting tears and questions from his husband. He was not expecting to be pin against the car and kissed within an inch of his life, not this early at least. When he was able to catch his breath, all he could hear was Phainon sobbing into his shoulder, mumbling out muffled “I love you” and “thank you” over and over again. The chimera hybrid let out a chuckle and relaxed his body. His hand reached up to stroke Phainon’s hair while the other rubbed soothing circles on his back.

“Phainon… you have given me so much. You brought me my freedom, you taught me how to make bread, showed me how to love and reciprocate. You’ve made me so happy simply by staying by my side and loving me. So, it was natural that I wanted to make you happy to… The current Aedes Elysiae paled in comparison to what it once was but it is there for us to stay for our honeymoon. We could build a vacation home there, so we have more opportunity to visit. Phainon, I don’t want you to think of this as something that need to be repay. Just having you as my husband is more than enough”

“*sniff* How about we forget about what I said about having kid after 3 years and made one during our honeymoon?”

“Husband, I suggest you say that again after wiping off all that tear and snot” Mydeimos giggled as he took out a handkerchief to clean his husband’s face.

“Does that mean we can-“

“No. We’re not repopulating Aedes Elysiae”

“Aww”

“But I do want us to have a big family… now that we have another babysitter in the rooster”

In the distance, Castorice, Cipher, Hyacine felt a disturbance in the force as they were looking after Coconut Beagle, Fig Stew and Pienon. Meanwhile, Cerydra was slowly but surely convincing Cyrene into joining the investigation team.

- The end but it is really the end?
